The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's largest and most complex customers. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.



You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will help prioritize customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth.



You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching.



This role is based in Bangalore.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, creating an environment of technical excellence, sound judgment, continuous learning, accountability, and strong customer stewardship.

 - Define and continuously refine the strategy and operating model for Applied AI Architecture teams, aligning company priorities with the evolving needs of strategic customers and the regional go-to-market.

 - Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production.

 - Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.

title: Senior Manager, Accounts Payable - Compute
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Procurement team makes working with the world easy, fast, and safe. We connect supplier readiness, purchasing, invoicing, and payment so teams can move with confidence as OpenAI scales. Accounts Payable and Supplier Master Data Operations provide the trusted data, dependable execution, and financial discipline behind that experience.

About the Role

OpenAI’s compute infrastructure depends on controlled execution of significant supplier spend. As Senior Manager, Accounts Payable — Compute, you will own payment readiness and material exceptions across large-value, business-critical obligations. Complex agreements evolve through amendments to pricing, capacity, service credits, billing mechanics, legal entities, and payment schedules. You will translate approved obligations into accurate, timely payments while navigating supplier disputes, late approvals, close deadlines, and cross-system dependencies.

We’re looking for a hands-on technical and operational leader who can interpret complex payment terms, reconcile financial data, diagnose system failures, and build scalable workflows. Coordinating across multiple Compute Finance and Accounting teams is a core responsibility: you will establish decision owners, align deadlines, and move interdependent work forward in parallel. You will set the compute AP operating plan and lead delivery with Procurement, Treasury, Tax, Finance Systems, and existing processing teams, with measurable improvements in controls, service, and capacity.

Location: This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the compute invoice-to-payment operating plan, prioritize material exceptions, and lead supplier escalations across complex, high-value obligations and tight payment deadlines.

 - Interpret executed contracts and approved amendments affecting pricing, capacity, credits, billing mechanics, entities, and payment schedules; translate them into invoice-validation, PO/change-order, approval, control, and payment requirements.

 - Personally investigate discrepancies, supplier disputes, missing credits, duplicate risks, and PO coverage gaps. Trace records, field mappings, approval statuses, and sync failures across procurement and ERP systems; resolve root causes with accountable Finance, Procurement, supplier, and Systems partners.

 - Lead a payment-readiness cadence across Compute Finance and Accounting teams, consolidate the complete obligation and payment view, and resolve dependencies across charge validation, PO coverage, approvals, funding, and close. Track decision owners, deadlines, blockers, and escalation paths so material payments move forward as approval lands.

 - Confirm supplier, site, entity, tax, payment-method, and approval readiness with the relevant owners before payment release.

 - Coordinate funding forecasts and close-period payments with Treasury; reconcile invoice aging, payment registers, and bank/settlement evidence to support Accounting’s completeness and cutoff conclusions.

 - Design matching tolerances, validation rules, exception routing, evidence requirements, and escalation thresholds with control and accounting partners, preserving independent verification and segregation of duties.

 - Map compute workload and usable capacity by task and complexity, assign eligible work across employees, contractors, and shared-service teams, and maintain trained backups and close coverage. Coach task owners and backups, strengthen execution standards, and build greater team autonomy.

 - Set a prioritized improvement roadmap tied to compute business needs. Own requirements and acceptance criteria for workflow and AI improvements; lead operational testing and adoption with Finance Systems and Enablement, verify reconciliation and fallback, and measure service, risk, and verified capacity outcomes.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring 8+ years in AP, payments, or related finance operations, or equivalent experience, with personal ownership of complex, high-value supplier obligations and material exceptions from executed contract through invoice approval, payment, and settlement.

 - Bring strong judgment on controls, segregation of duties, supplier verification, reconciliations, and close support in an audited environment.

 - Can interpret complex pricing, capacity, credit, billing, and payment terms and translate contract amendments into executable workflows, matching rules, and clear decision ownership.

 - Have led coordination across multiple finance and accounting teams on material payments, reconciled competing priorities and deadlines, and established clear decisions, handoffs, and escalation paths with suppliers and partners.

 - Have independently led cross-functional operating improvements and delivery teams, built demand-and-capacity plans, maintained peak and backup coverage, and demonstrated measurable results while staying close to execution.

 - Can independently reconcile large financial datasets using advanced spreadsheets or comparable analytical tools, establish complete populations and control totals, and diagnose ERP workflow, data, and integration failures. Oracle Fusion and Zip experience is helpful.

 - Have demonstrated practical application of AI in finance or operations, with measurable gains in accuracy, speed, or capacity. Can translate business and control requirements into testable workflows and lead UAT, with human review, exception handling, reconciliation, fallback, and ongoing monitoring.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, compute, data centers, or similarly complex supplier arrangements is required.

title: US Congressional Lead
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and - in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders - seek to further regulation, industry standards, and safe and beneficial development of AI tools.

About the Role

As a US Congressional Lead on the Global Affairs team, you will help develop strategies and advance OpenAI’s engagement with the U.S. Congress across a range of legislative and policy priorities. You will develop and manage relationships with House and Senate lawmakers and staff, with particular attention to committees shaping technology and emerging policy issues. You will support OpenAI’s U.S. Global Affairs team in meetings, briefings, hearings, and other engagements, and collaborate with civil society and industry partners in alignment with OpenAI’s mission.

OpenAI releases industry-leading research and tools. You will face new challenges as the impact of cutting edge generative AI technologies continues to be explored and as the needs of the organization evolve. Day-to-day work may encompass tracking emerging congressional policy issues, coordinating complex cross-functional engagement with legal, policy, and communications teams, developing briefing materials, preparing our leaders for congressional hearings and other government engagements, and representing OpenAI in private and public forums.

We are looking for a self-directed and creative individual with substantial Capitol Hill experience, strong congressional relationships, experience managing private sector and civil society relationships, and an understanding of AI-related legislative and regulatory issues and processes.

This role is based in Washington, DC and may require frequent travel to participate in meetings and events with key stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Are well versed in the issues around emerging AI technologies, particularly as they relate to congressional policymaking.

 - Are an enthusiastic and effective coalition builder who thrives as a member of a high performing, peer-led global team.

 - Are highly organized, and are used to working as an accountable individual contributor as well as a team player.

 - Are passionate about the promise of technology and the future of artificial intelligence but thoughtful about its potential risks.

We're looking for a blend of:

 - Demonstrated experience (8+ years) and credibility working with the U.S. federal government, particularly the legislative branch.

 - Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of the U.S. government, its institutions and legislative processes, and the key policy issues and debates related to AI.

 - The ideal candidate will have substantial experience working with Congress, with a strong preference for experience working with the House or Senate Judiciary Committees, the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee, or other relevant congressional committees.  - Track record of effectively working with cross-functional teams, especially communications, policy and legal teams, and aligning a diverse range of internal and external partners

title: Pricing Operations Lead
description:
About the Team

The Pricing & Monetization team is responsible for how our products create and capture value. We partner closely with Product, GTM, Finance, and Systems teams to design pricing models, packaging, and commercial strategies that support adoption, growth, and long-term scaling of the business.

To thrive in this team, you need to be a proactive problem-solver who excels at bringing structure to ambiguous challenges. Our work demands strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and precision in execution. Team members succeed when they are analytical, detail-oriented, skilled at balancing multiple priorities, and passionate about driving high-stakes projects forward to deliver meaningful results.

About the Role

We are looking for a Pricing Operations Lead to help translate pricing and packaging decisions into clear, scalable execution. You will work closely with pricing leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Billing, Finance, and GTM to ensure pricing changes are implemented accurately, system requirements are well managed, and launch decisions move from strategy to reality with discipline.

You should be comfortable operating at the intersection of business judgment, systems thinking, and program management. This role will help shape the operating backbone for pricing implementation, support teams developing billing and related monetization systems, and ensure the pricing team's needs are represented clearly in cross-functional planning and execution.

title: ITAV Event Technical Producer
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s IT organization supports the mission of deploying artificial general intelligence (AGI) for the benefit of all. Our team is committed to providing seamless technological support and solutions to ensure that all OpenAI employees are well-equipped and connected. This enables them to contribute effectively towards our AI research, corporate operations and product initiatives.

About the Role

As an ITAV Event Technical Producer at OpenAI, you will lead technical production for complex internal and external events across multiple sites, from early planning through rehearsal and live delivery. You will partner with internal stakeholders and technical teams to translate event requirements into clear production plans. You will coordinate internal and external crews, direct large, distributed shows and coordinate cross-site handoffs, and use your technical expertise to resolve production challenges and make informed tradeoffs. You will also build reusable production practices and AI workflows, improve how teams deliver events, and mentor peers and junior crew members.

This is a full-time, onsite role requiring five days per week in San Francisco. Travel to other OpenAI locations is required as needed for assigned events.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead technical production for complex internal, hybrid, and distributed events from early planning and scoping through rehearsal, live delivery, and debrief.

 - Align Internal Comms, Marketing, Brand Experience, and Workplace on audience goals, requirements, scope, dependencies, and decision owners. Turn ambiguous or competing needs into an agreed production plan and readiness criteria.

 - Configure and operate live audio, video switching, cameras, playback, conferencing, streaming, and recording systems for the agreed production.

 - Integrate the run of show across sites and lead multiple crews globally for all-company events. Align technical cues, rehearsals, content handoffs, schedules, and contingencies with partner teams to deliver one cohesive event.

 - Lead rehearsals and validate the complete audience experience, including remote contribution, playback, recording, and tested backup paths.

 - Independently prioritize technical production tradeoffs and lead risk reviews and incident response. Resolve ambiguity within your scope, and seek guidance for complex situations or decisions owned by event, staffing, budget, or engineering partners.

 - Build reusable production plans, show files, runbooks, and change-control practices. Coach peers and junior crew members to use them independently and verify improvements in readiness, troubleshooting, and execution.

 - Set a prioritized roadmap for production improvements using audience feedback, debriefs, and recurring failures. Lead workflow changes across teams and define permanent-system improvements with AV Engineering.

 - Identify repeatable production work and build AI and agentic workflows with partner teams. Validate results, establish operating and maintenance ownership, support adoption, and measure preparation effort or reliability improvements.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - Experience leading complex live or hybrid productions across multiple teams, from ambiguous requirements through rehearsal, delivery, and debrief.

 - Advanced expertise in multiple live-production domains, such as audio, video, conferencing, streaming, or AV-over-IP, and the ability to diagnose complex interactions across the complete signal path.

 - Experience configuring and operating professional production systems and creating reusable show files or control workflows.

 - Practical AV-over-IP and networking knowledge sufficient to troubleshoot live media, timing, and connectivity with engineering partners.

 - Experience independently resolving ambiguous production problems, setting detailed plans, and prioritizing tradeoffs while seeking guidance when complexity or decision authority requires it.

 - Demonstrated ownership of rehearsals, technical readiness, failover testing, and calm incident response for high-priority productions.

 - Ability to lead crews and influence partner teams without reporting authority, with clear boundaries for content, brand, budget, staffing, and engineering decisions.

 - Experience working with communications, marketing, brand or creative experience, Workplace, and technical partners on complex events, including sensitive planning and late changes.

 - Experience building reusable production frameworks and validated AI workflows, guiding team adoption, and mentoring peers or junior staff with measurable improvements in their capability.

 - Experience with multi-space or multi-location productions and sensitive executive events is a plus.

 - Experience with systems such as Q-SYS, Dante, Ross, Vizrt, or comparable production platforms is a plus.

title: Deal Operations, EMEA
description:
About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a senior individual contributor to support revenue growth across EMEA by helping sales teams structure and close commercially sound deals. You will balance speed and responsiveness with pricing discipline, consistent processes, and appropriate financial and commercial controls.

In this role, you will be the day-to-day Deal Operations partner for EMEA account teams, reviewing pricing, discounts, and commercial terms across new business, renewals, and expansions. You will guide sellers through deal requirements, evaluate non-standard requests, and coordinate the approvals needed to move opportunities through contracting and closure.

You will also develop scalable workflows, guidance, and tools that improve deal turnaround times, documentation quality, and consistency across the region.

This role partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations, with Product and other teams engaged as needed, to resolve deal issues and support accurate execution from quote through contract and booking.

In this role, you will:

 - Serve as the primary Deal Operations contact for EMEA account teams, managing deal intake, prioritizing requests, and guiding sellers through pricing, review, and approval processes.

 - Review quotes and proposed commercial terms, including discounts, payment schedules, contract duration, and customer commitments, for accuracy and alignment with pricing guidelines and commercial policies.

 - Build financial analyses and deal models to assess revenue, margin, discount impact, and profitability, and explain the tradeoffs of proposed deal structures to decision-makers.

 - Partner with Sales to structure deals that meet customer needs and OpenAI’s commercial objectives, recommending alternatives when proposed terms fall outside established guidelines.

 - Coordinate deal reviews and required approvals across Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations. Prepare clear recommendations, document decisions, and escalate exceptions to the appropriate stakeholders.

 - Identify risks in non-standard terms and work with Legal and Finance to resolve contractual, billing, and revenue recognition considerations before execution.

 - Maintain complete deal records and approval documentation in CRM, CPQ, and contract management systems, and partner with Revenue Operations to align approved terms, executed agreements, and booking information.

 - Help develop and maintain deal approval policies, escalation paths, pricing guidance, and standardized templates. Improve workflows to reduce bottlenecks while maintaining appropriate controls.

 - Equip sellers with practical guidance and training on deal requirements and approval processes. Apply AI and automation to improve deal intake, knowledge retrieval, and self-service support.

 - Track Deal Desk metrics such as turnaround time, approval bottlenecks, exception trends, and quote accuracy. Use recurring deal patterns to recommend improvements to commercial policies, processes, and tools.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, commercial finance, pricing, sales operations, or a related function, preferably in a high-growth technology environment.

 - Hands-on experience reviewing and structuring complex enterprise deals and supporting quoting, commercial approvals, and contracting processes.

 - Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, including experience assessing pricing, discounts, revenue, margins, and deal profitability.

 - Knowledge of enterprise software commercial terms and subscription or consumption-based business models, with the judgment to identify issues that require Legal or Finance review.

 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain commercial tradeoffs, make clear recommendations, and coordinate timely decisions across teams.

 - Experience with CRM systems, configure-price-quote (CPQ) tools, and contract management platforms, along with strong spreadsheet skills.

 - Attention to detail and a track record of improving approval workflows, documentation, and operational processes as a business scales.

 - Sound commercial judgment and the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines while maintaining accuracy and appropriate controls.

 - A collaborative, hands-on approach to supporting sales teams and familiarity with using AI and automation to improve deal workflows and productivity.

title: People Technology Analyst, Workday PATT & Benefits
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s People team helps us hire, support, and retain the people who will safely build and deploy artificial intelligence that benefits humanity.

The People Technology team brings together our enterprise people systems and the engineers building new internal products and AI-powered tools. We work across the People organization to improve the employee experience, simplify operations, and build technology that supports OpenAI’s global growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a People Technology Analyst with deep expertise in Workday Absence, Time Tracking, and Benefits. You’ll independently own configuration, ongoing support, and improvements across these areas, including benefits for our US and international employees, from day one.

You’ll work closely with Benefits, People Operations, Payroll, Finance, and Engineering to translate complex requirements into reliable systems and straightforward employee experiences. You should be comfortable configuring Workday yourself, tracing issues across modules and integrations, and owning improvements from the first conversation through launch and ongoing support.

As part of our combined People Technology team, you’ll also help identify where automation, AI, and custom tools can improve how we work. You’ll bring the domain expertise needed to make those solutions useful and dependable.

In this role, you will:

 - Own Workday configuration and improvements across Absence, Time Tracking, and Benefits, including the connections between leave, time worked, and benefits eligibility.

 - Design and maintain absence plans, accruals, eligibility rules, leave processes, time entry rules, calculations, validations, and approvals for a growing global workforce.

 - Partner with the Payroll systems owner to ensure absence, time tracking, and benefits data flows accurately into payroll. Investigate source data issues and test downstream impacts of changes in your areas.

 - Independently own US and international benefits configuration, including benefit plans, eligibility rules, enrollment events, life events, coverage levels, and rates.

 - Lead open enrollment systems readiness, including configuration, testing, launch, and support. Partner with technical teams and benefits vendors to maintain and troubleshoot integrations.

 - Lead Absence, Time Tracking, and Benefits systems work for new countries and entities, policy changes, and evolving employee needs. Partner with functional owners to translate local requirements into configuration.

 - Own projects from discovery and prioritization through configuration, testing, release, documentation, and adoption. Stay accountable for how the solution performs after launch.

 - Partner with engineers to improve integrations and build automation or AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and make employee support easier.

 - Maintain system security, data quality, reporting, and change controls. Resolve production issues and address their underlying causes.

 - Create clear documentation and training that helps employees, managers, and People teams use our systems effectively.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - Deep, hands-on Workday expertise across Absence and Time Tracking, with experience designing, configuring, testing, and supporting connected workflows across both.

 - Demonstrated experience independently owning Workday Benefits configuration for US and international programs, including open enrollment, eligibility, life events, and connections to benefits vendors.

 - An understanding of how time, absence, and benefits data flows into payroll and other downstream systems, with the ability to test changes and troubleshoot issues with the relevant system owners.

 - Experience translating complex policies and business requirements into maintainable system designs, including country-specific configurations.

 - Strong Workday technical skills, including business processes, calculated fields, reporting, security, and data loads, along with the ability to troubleshoot integrations with technical partners.

 - Ownership of systems through implementation and ongoing operations, with a record of improving reliability and the experience of the people using them.

 - Good product judgment. You ask questions, understand the underlying problem, prioritize thoughtfully, and evaluate whether a change made things better.

 - Clear communication and the ability to work across People, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and Engineering.

 - Comfort working through ambiguity, balancing urgent operational needs with longer-term improvements, and following through on details.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Global Absence, Time Tracking, or Benefits implementations and new country or entity launches.

 - Collaboration with software engineers on internal products, integrations, or workflow automation.

 - Practical use of AI to improve systems work, documentation, testing, or employee support.

 - Relevant Workday certifications or Workday Pro credentials.

title: Integrated Marketing Manager, Hardware
description:
About the Team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to help translate our products, their value propositions, and our broader brand strategy into audience-specific, globally relevant marketing programs. You’ll shape how people discover, understand, adopt, and engage with our products across markets and stages of the customer journey. You’ll connect product narratives, audience insight, cultural context, and business goals into strategies that make advanced technology feel clear, useful, and human.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for a marketer who understands how product marketing, brand strategy, audience research, and international growth work together. You’ll develop segmentation frameworks, lifecycle and go-to-market programs, regional insights, and partnership opportunities; then work across product marketing, growth, creative, partnerships, analytics, and regional teams to bring them to life. Your work will connect launches, product education, customer engagement, and ongoing storytelling into a coherent journey from awareness to advocacy.

To us, creativity is a team sport. Ideas get better when you talk them through and build on each other’s thinking. We value curiosity over certainty, kindness over ego, and the ability to balance craft with decisiveness.

In this role, you will:

 - Translate complex product capabilities, use cases, and value propositions into clear, differentiated messaging that is relevant to distinct audiences without losing accuracy, nuance, or the product’s ambition.

 - Develop audience segmentation frameworks based on customer needs, behaviors, use cases, regions, industries, and stages of the customer journey.

 - Create audience-specific messaging and campaign strategies for groups such as creators, builders, professionals, students, consumers, and emerging-market users.

 - Lead cross-functional marketing programs end to end for defined audiences or initiatives, with minimal oversight, setting priorities across awareness, acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and advocacy.

 - Lead research efforts including customer interviews, surveys, social listening, competitive analysis, market trends, and behavioral data.

 - Turn research and performance signals into actionable audience personas, messaging frameworks, briefs, campaign recommendations, and market insights.

 - Identify cultural, regional, and language-specific opportunities across global markets, and help adapt global campaigns for local audiences while maintaining a consistent brand voice.

 - Develop go-to-market plans for new campaigns, product features, audience programs, partnerships, and market expansions.

 - Identify partnership opportunities with creators, developers, communities, platforms, industry groups, and other audience ecosystems.

 - Align partners across product marketing, growth, CRM, creative, analytics, partnerships, and regional marketing; resolve tradeoffs and shape creative direction to deliver coordinated customer journeys.

 - Measure campaign and audience performance, using data to improve messaging, segmentation, customer journeys, regional strategies, and future marketing investments.

 - Build reusable campaign processes and playbooks, and coach peers and junior teammates to improve planning, creative collaboration, and execution.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 5–8 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, audience strategy, partnerships, or related fields.

 - Bring deep familiarity with AI products, foundation models, generative AI capabilities and limitations, and common user workflows; this is a critical qualification for the role.

 - Have experience translating complex technology and technical product capabilities into clear, compelling, differentiated customer value propositions.

 - Are a strategic thinker who can turn audience insight, cultural context, product strategy, and business goals into a compelling point of view and an actionable marketing system.

 - Can move fluidly between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution: building the framework, writing the brief, launching the program, and reviewing results.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience working with creators, developers, communities, partnerships, or other distinct customer segments.

 - Experience working across cultures, regions, or international markets.

 - Experience with experimentation, performance measurement, social listening, and translating signals into strategic recommendations.

 - Experience in consumer technology, emerging products, developer tools, enterprise products, or other fast-changing categories.

title: Dedicated Support Engineer - London
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements.

In this role, you will:

 - Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.

 - Provide end-to-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.

 - Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and systems, serving as a critical escalation point and a technical backstop for our most strategic customers.

 - Own the customer-specific response to high-impact incidents. You’ll assess severity and business impact, initiate the appropriate response path, coordinate cross-functional responders, maintain clear ownership, and ensure issues move through mitigation, resolution, and post-incident follow-through.

 - Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners.

 - Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams.

 - Partner with Go-to-Market and Technical Success teams to understand the business importance of customer workloads and ensure that relevant commercial context informs severity, prioritization, and communication without bypassing established support processes.

 - Represent Support Engineering in relevant customer meetings, including QBRs, and partner closely with account teams to communicate technical health, surface risks and blockers early, coordinate follow-up, and provide customers and internal stakeholders with clear, proactive updates.

 - Monitor customer integrations and support trends to identify emerging risks, recurring failure patterns, and readiness gaps before they become major escalations.

 - Prepare for important launches, migrations, traffic increases, and business events by developing account-specific runbooks, validating escalation paths, coordinating support readiness, and providing heightened monitoring where needed.

 - Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure.

title: Software Engineer, Shop/Feed Ads
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Monetization team is a new cross-functional group spanning engineering, product, research, and design. We are building the foundational systems that will help OpenAI scale access to intelligence responsibly.

Our mission is to create user-first, privacy-preserving monetization products—including next-generation ads experiences—that strengthen trust, expand economic opportunity, and support OpenAI’s long-term innovation. We believe monetization should deliver clear user value, uphold rigorous privacy and safety standards, and sustain a healthy ecosystem for developers and businesses.

The team operates in a greenfield environment, moving quickly through prototyping, experimentation, and iterative deployment. We partner closely across Product, Design, and Research to bring new capabilities into real-world systems at global scale.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer to lead the design and development of the systems that turn advertiser feeds (eg. retail feeds, travel feeds etc.) into relevant, reliably delivered ads. In this foundational role, you will build across the full ads lifecycle—from ingesting and organizing retailer or travel catalogs into efficient retrieval systems, supporting ranking models, and serving ads at scale.

This role is well suited to an engineer with direct experience in product ads retrieval, ranking, and delivery, along with a strong understanding of merchant feeds and shopping systems such as Google Shopping, YouTube product ads, or Amazon. We also welcome engineers with Senior Staff-level or greater scope who have deep ownership of large-scale catalogs, search and indexing, ads serving, or closely related distributed systems.

You will independently own complex systems, make sound technical tradeoffs, and help define the architecture and roadmap for Shopping/Travel/Feed Ads. You will collaborate closely with Ads ML, Ads Delivery, Product, Design, and Research to connect accurate, fresh advertiser feed information with useful ads experiences in ChatGPT.

This role is based in San Francisco and Mountain View. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.



IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Design and build pipelines that ingest, validate, normalize, and refresh merchant product feeds, keeping catalog information accurate and available for serving.

 - Develop scalable catalog storage and indexing systems that make large inventories searchable and reflect changes in product availability, pricing, and attributes.

 - Build search and retrieval systems that efficiently identify relevant, eligible products across merchant catalogs.

 - Partner with Ads ML to connect product retrieval with ranking models through dependable interfaces, features, and serving infrastructure.

 - Engineer low-latency, high-throughput ads delivery systems with strong reliability and correctness guarantees.

 - Design real-time event pipelines and distributed storage that support catalog freshness, serving decisions, and downstream feedback.

 - Build observability and quality controls to detect feed errors, stale inventory, indexing delays, and serving issues.

 - Define technical direction and drive complex projects from early prototypes through production deployment and operation.

 - Operate systems with high engineering rigor through testing, monitoring, privacy and security reviews, and strong operational practices.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have extensive experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with direct ownership of product ads retrieval, ranking infrastructure, or delivery.

 - Understand merchant feeds and shopping systems, including how catalog quality, product availability, and freshness affect relevance and ads performance.

 - Have built systems for shopping or product ads at platforms such as Google Shopping, YouTube, Amazon, or a comparable environment.

 - Alternatively, have operated at Senior Staff-level scope or above, leading the architecture and delivery of large-scale catalogs, search and indexing platforms, ads serving, or related backend systems.

 - Have built low-latency, high-throughput services and data pipelines with demanding reliability and correctness requirements.

 - Can reason across ingestion, storage, indexing, retrieval, ranking, and serving, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between freshness, relevance, latency, and cost.

 - Are comfortable partnering with machine-learning teams to bring ranking models and signals into dependable production systems.

 - Can define technical direction in an ambiguous 0→1 environment and independently drive complex work across teams.

 - Communicate clearly and make technical decisions grounded in user value, merchant experience, and long-term system health.

title: Product Manager, Financial Services
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI is building AI products for serious professional work. We’re going deep on finance with a committed team focused on unlocking the potential of AI in this vertical: working closely with industry experts and users to build bespoke solutions that help finance professionals do real work.

OpenAI’s Financial Services team works closely with customers to understand where AI can improve the economics and quality of financial work: faster diligence, broader research coverage, sharper client materials, more accurate models, and better investment analysis. Our work spans workflows across investment banking, equity research, private equity, asset management, wealth management, insurance, and other parts of finance. We bring together OpenAI’s models, financial data, and enterprise knowledge to build products that fit how financial professionals work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help define and build OpenAI’s financial services products. Reporting to the GM of Financial Services, you will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for key experiences, taking them from customer discovery and early prototypes through launch, adoption, and iteration. This is a hands-on role. You will spend time with bankers, investors, analysts, and other finance professionals; build and test early product experiences; and work closely with Engineering, Design, Research, and customer-facing teams to ship. You should have strong judgment about both the product experience and the work it produces. You will also form a vision for how AI can change the financial services space and can translate that into product execution.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Own product strategy and priorities. Work with the GM to identify the most valuable customer problems and translate them into a clear roadmap. Make decisions about what to build, what to defer, and where partners or shared OpenAI capabilities can best meet the need.

 - Go deep on financial workflows. Sit with customers, observe how they work, and understand the documents they create, data they trust, tools they use, and standards they apply. Use those insights to design experiences that customers return to in their daily work.

 - Build and ship. Create working prototypes, demos, example outputs, and product requirements using Codex and other OpenAI tools. Partner with Engineering and Design to turn early concepts into reliable products, resolve dependencies, and drive delivery through launch and iteration.

 - Raise the bar for quality and trust. Work with Research and Engineering to turn real finance tasks and product failures into evaluations, datasets, and model feedback. Define what good looks like across accuracy, source traceability, completeness, and ease of review, while making practical tradeoffs across quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

 - Make products work inside financial institutions. Translate integration, data-access, privacy, security, and review requirements into product decisions. Work across Legal, Security, Partnerships, and core product teams to address deployment barriers and determine which needs require finance-specific solutions.

 - Measure results and drive adoption. Define success through task completion, output acceptance, repeat usage, time saved, and business impact. Combine product data, evaluations, and customer feedback to guide investment. Partner with GTM and customer-facing teams on pilots, onboarding, and launches, then use what you learn to improve the product.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have a track record of taking complex products from discovery through launch and sustained adoption, as a product manager, founder, or builder with substantial product ownership.

 - Understand financial work well enough to earn credibility with demanding practitioners. You may have built products for financial institutions or worked directly in investment banking, investing, equity research, corporate development, or related fields.

 - Combine strong product taste with attention to detail. You care about making complex workflows feel simple and can judge both the experience and the quality of its outputs.

 - Work comfortably with engineers and researchers on model behavior, data quality, integrations, and evaluations. You can distinguish a model limitation from a data, workflow, or product-design problem.

 - Use AI deeply in your own work and build prototypes to test ideas. You are willing to teach, onboard, debug, and inspect outputs alongside customers.

 - Know how to choose useful goals and metrics, test assumptions, and change priorities when the evidence changes.

 - Bring sound judgment about privacy, trust, and accuracy in consequential professional work.

 - Take ownership in ambiguous situations, drive decisions across teams you do not manage, and communicate clearly. You can set direction and stay close to the details required to ship.

The Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. You will own the market’s SMB growth strategy and revenue outcomes across acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion—translating a deep understanding of Japanese businesses into programs that help advertisers succeed. You will also partner with Sales and global marketing teams to support large-advertiser engagement through events, activations, and coordinated market initiatives. You will bring local insight to global teams and adapt global capabilities to the needs of the Japanese market.



In this role, you will

 - Own SMB revenue and growth goals in Japan, translating market opportunities into a focused strategy and measurable marketing programs.

 - Build acquisition, onboarding, activation, and lifecycle programs that help SMBs launch successfully, see value, and grow their advertising investment.

 - Identify priority customer segments, verticals, and growth opportunities through customer insight, market analysis, and experimentation.

 - Recruit, engage, and grow SMB-focused agencies and partners through education, enablement, co-marketing, and scalable programs.

 - Build awareness and consideration through locally relevant case studies, webinars, events, and educational content, amplified through influencer marketing, owned channels, and paid media.

 - Partner with Sales to connect marketing programs with customer opportunities and improve handoffs across self-serve and sales-assisted journeys.

 - Coordinate with Sales and global marketing teams on large-advertiser events, activations, and market engagement.

 - Adapt global campaigns and programs for Japan, balancing local customer needs with shared resources and capabilities.

 - Measure commercial impact, test new approaches, and scale programs that improve advertiser acquisition, retention, and revenue.

 - Bring customer and agency feedback to Product, Ads Engineering, and global teams to inform the advertiser experience and future growth opportunities.
   
   
   

You might thrive in this role if you have

 - Experience in digital advertising, growth marketing, or advertiser marketing, with a track record of delivering measurable business growth.

 - Deep understanding of Japan’s advertising market, including SMB needs, agency relationships, and local customer behavior.

 - Experience building and launching programs from scratch, setting priorities in ambiguity, and moving from strategy to hands-on execution.

 - Strong knowledge of self-serve advertising and performance marketing, with experience improving acquisition, activation, retention, or expansion.

 - Experience working with agencies and partners to reach, educate, and grow advertisers.

 - Strong analytical judgment and the ability to connect customer insight, funnel performance, and experimentation to revenue outcomes.

 - A track record of working effectively with Sales, Product, and global or regional marketing teams.

 - Strong communication skills in Japanese and English, with the ability to engage local customers and collaborate across global teams.




Experience that would be especially valuable

 - Experience at an advertising technology platform such as Google, Meta, or a comparable business.

 - Experience taking global programs into Japan and using local insights to improve the broader approach.

 - Experience delivering advertiser events or activations with sales teams, alongside scalable SMB growth programs.

title: Android Engineer, Plugin Developer Platform
description:
About the Team

The Plugin Developer Platform team builds the APIs, SDKs, and tools that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, connectors, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and interactive apps.

We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work covers plugin creation and publishing, the systems that run plugins across our products, and open standards that developers can build on.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Android engineer to bring plugins, connectors, and interactive apps to life on mobile. You’ll build the Android experiences and platform foundations that help developers extend ChatGPT and help users discover and use those capabilities from their devices.

You’ll work across native Android interfaces, developer-facing APIs, and the systems that support extensibility on mobile. You’ll collaborate closely with product, design, and platform engineers, owning features from early exploration through implementation, launch, and iteration.

You’ll also engage directly with developers and partners to understand how their workflows translate to Android. Their experience will inform the interfaces and abstractions you build, the problems you prioritize, and the tradeoffs you make.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


In this role, you will:

 - Build Android experiences for plugins, connectors, and interactive apps within ChatGPT.

 - Develop reusable Android components and interfaces that support a growing ecosystem of developer-built experiences.

 - Partner with platform engineers to connect native mobile experiences with APIs, SDKs, and backend systems.

 - Work with developers and partners to identify integration challenges and improve the experience of building for mobile.

 - Improve app performance, reliability, architecture, testing, and developer tooling.

 - Own projects from initial requirements through release, measurement, and iteration.
   

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have deep experience building Android applications using Kotlin and modern Android development frameworks.

 - Have shipped consumer-facing mobile products at scale and care deeply about performance, quality, and user experience.

 - Bring a platform mindset and enjoy designing reusable interfaces and abstractions that other developers build on.

 - Enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, and design, and working directly with developers and partners.

 - Are excited about bringing AI-powered tools and extensible experiences to mobile.

 - Thrive in fast-moving environments where you help define both product and technical direction.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

This role is based in Sydney, Australia. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you'll:

title: Legal Contract Manager, Public Sector
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Legal team plays a crucial role in advancing our mission by tackling innovative and fundamental legal issues in AI. The team includes professionals from diverse legal fields—technology, AI, government contracting, privacy, IP, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation—who collaborate closely with colleagues across the company.

If you are passionate about helping bring cutting-edge AI technology to the public sector while navigating complex legal and regulatory landscapes, you’ll thrive here.



About the role

We’re seeking a Legal Contracts Manager to support OpenAI for Government’s growing public sector business. This role will manage a wide range of contracting activities with U.S. federal, state, and local government customers and partners.


This role will partner closely with our legal, go-to-market, capture/proposals, and other teams to negotiate agreements, administer existing contracts, establish compliance mechanisms, and generally support the full lifecycle of contract performance. This role requires deep familiarity with government contracting, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to operate with speed and sound judgment in a fast-moving environment.

This position reports to our Associate General Counsel, Head of Public Sector Legal and is based in Washington D.C.



This role will:

 - Manage the full contract lifecycle for government agreements, including NDAs, services agreements, teaming agreements, subcontracts, and order forms.

 - Negotiate contracts with federal, state, and local agencies and government integrators, balancing risk management with business objectives.

 - Ensure ongoing compliance with contract requirements, including flow-down clauses, reporting obligations, and government-specific certifications (e.g., FAR/DFARS, FedRAMP, CMMC, NIST 800-171).

 - Support contract pursuits and proposals, including review of RFP/RFQ terms, development of compliance matrices, and coordination of required representations and certifications.

 - Coordinate with internal stakeholders—Legal, Finance, Security, Capture/Proposals, and Product—to ensure contract terms align with OpenAI’s technical capabilities, pricing structures, and security/compliance frameworks.

 - Maintain contract records and manage data related to key terms, renewals, and deliverables.

 - Develop scalable contracting processes and playbooks to streamline government sales while managing legal and regulatory risk.

 - Monitor regulatory developments and advise on implications for government contracts and compliance programs.



We're seeking someone with experience including:

 - 7+ years of experience in government contracting, contract management, or technology transactions, with significant exposure to U.S. federal acquisition regulations (FAR/DFARS).

 - JD, law degree, or relevant contract management certification (e.g., NCMA CPCM/CCCM) preferred but not required.

 - Active U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance.

 - Strong background negotiating and managing agreements with U.S. government agencies or prime contractors.

 - Familiarity with public sector compliance frameworks (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST 800-171, CMMC, ITAR/EAR, government data rights).

 - Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy and sound judgment in highly technical, fast-moving environments.

 - Demonstrated experience using artificial intelligence tools to automate legal and compliance workflows.

 - Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with experience managing complex contract portfolios.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to distill complex regulatory requirements into actionable guidance for business teams.

 - Experience working in a high-growth technology company or government integrator is a strong plus.

title: Internal Communications Lead,  Enterprise & Growth
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity.

Our Communications team supports OpenAI’s mission and goals by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, values, and approach to safely building powerful AI. The Internal Communications team aims to create clarity, trust, and shared understanding that inspires our employees to do their best work. We partner across the company to craft clear, compelling narratives about what’s being built, why it matters, how it aligns to our strategy, and most importantly, how it advances our mission.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced internal communications leader to own the strategy for our Enterprise & Growth portfolio, spanning B2B, Revenue, Partnerships, Marketing, Enterprise Engineering, Ads, Commerce, and Consumer Verticals. These teams are changing how businesses operate, bringing AI into working life, and expanding access to its benefits. This work is central to our mission of ensuring AGI benefits all of humanity: helping people and businesses everywhere put AI to use in ways that improve their lives and livelihoods.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with executives to help employees understand where the business is going, why decisions are being made, and how their work ladders up. You will draw on a deep understanding of the teams you support and leverage strong relationships across the company to shape the communications approach and deliver the writing and programs that bring it to life.

A central part of this role is helping employees understand how our technology reaches people and businesses – and what we learn when they use it. You will bring user and customer experiences into companywide conversations, help employees understand the products and capabilities we’re building for businesses and the problems they solve, and help leaders communicate through rapid growth and change.

We’re looking for someone with sharp editorial instincts, boundless creative ambition, and the sound judgment to handle sensitive, confidential, and consequential work with care. You should be equally comfortable setting the communications direction, writing an executive message that addresses what’s on employees’ minds directly and transparently, and hosting a live conversation that invites candid questions and open discussion.

OpenAI is a unique and fast-moving working environment. Priorities can shift quickly, and important work often begins before every detail is settled. You will often need to get up to speed on unfamiliar topics, recommend a path with incomplete information, and adjust as decisions evolve. We’re looking for a pro who takes initiative, understands what matters to employees, and anticipates tough questions and pain points early enough to help leaders address them.

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Set and deliver the communications strategy for Enterprise & Growth. Understand the portfolio’s priorities, identify where communications can make a difference, and lead programs from initial recommendation through execution and evaluation.

 - Advise senior leaders and shape their communications. Develop leadership updates, narratives, and presentations. Offer clear recommendations on framing, timing, and delivery, holding a high bar for accuracy, clarity, and transparency with employees.

 - Guide communications through complex and sensitive changes. Develop plans for leadership transitions, organizational changes, and evolving business priorities. Work with People, Legal, External Comms, and XFN partners to explain decisions, prepare leadership, and address questions employees are likely to have.

 - Lead company-wide user and customer storytelling. Build programs that show how people and organizations use our technology, how it benefits them, and what employees can learn from their experiences. Develop creative formats that bring these stories to life, encourage engagement, and spark new ideas for what we could build next.

 - Bring employee perspectives into communications decisions. Synthesize questions and feedback from Slack, leadership forums, and other channels. Help leaders understand where employees need more context, recommend responses, and assess whether communications are improving understanding, morale, and trust.

 - Keep work moving as priorities change. Move quickly, adapt as new information comes in, and keep everyone involved informed about decisions and next steps. Respond to feedback, adjust course without losing momentum, and bring a constructive, collaborative attitude to challenging moments.

 - Strengthen the broader Internal Communications function. Contribute to shared priorities, provide thoughtful ideas and feedback, and turn successful approaches into practices others can use.




YOU WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

 - 10+ years of relevant experience in internal or executive communications, marketing communications, operations, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex communications programs. People Management experience (1-2 years minimum) is required.

 - Experience advising senior leaders. You have built trust through preparation, discretion, and thoughtful and strategic recommendations, and can navigate disagreement with confidence and utmost respect.

 - Excellent writing and editorial judgment. You can explain business strategy and complicated decisions clearly, adapt to different leadership voices, and identify the details that make a message trustworthy and credible. You can produce strong work on a short timeline and incorporate detailed feedback without losing the purpose/“the why” of the message.

 - Curiosity about how businesses grow and how people use technology. You can connect commercial priorities, product developments, and customer experiences to our mission and the questions and themes employees care about.

 - Strong program leadership, ownership, and adaptability. You bring structure to ambiguous work and carry it through with limited direction. You can move between strategic planning and hands-on execution, learn an unfamiliar part of the business quickly, and revise your approach when new information changes the picture.

 - Sound judgment and resilience under pressure. You stay constructive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented through compressed timelines, candid feedback, and changes in direction. You can rethink a draft or plan quickly, raise concerns early, and make thoughtful decisions about when to move and when to pause for more context. Your partners have deep trust in your judgment and look forward to working with you on the most challenging projects.

title: Deployment Lead, FDE - SF
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.



About the Role

You will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to customers. You will own how they are built, shipped, and adopted. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.

You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.

Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires deep technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.



In this role, you will:

 - Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent work streams. Translate business objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

 - Run day-to-day engineering execution. Track and drive delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path.

 - Embed with customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan. Lead onboarding, adoption, and change management.

 - Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research work streams land in time to support deployment goals.

 - Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models.

 - Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors.

 - Shape how we engage Financial Services customers


You’ll thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring 7+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership 

 - Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI.

 - Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work.

 - Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems.

 - Think strategically and pattern-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognise broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions.

 - Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Confident discussing technical details, pressure-testing architectures, and making trade-offs.

 - Have shipped AI/LLM systems. You understand solution patterns, integration basics, and production pitfalls.

 - You’re a translator with executive presence. You make complex technical trade-offs legible to business leaders and convert strategy into day-to-day technical execution.

title: Strategy and Operations, OpenAI for Government
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The OpenAI for Government team is a dynamic, mission-driven group leveraging frontier AI to transform how governments achieve their missions. Our team works to empower public servants with secure, compliant AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT Enterprise in custom configurations) and mission-aligned deployments that meet government technical requirements with strong reliability and safety.

As part of the OpenAI for Government team you will work across governments and public institutions, helping to accelerate adoption through hands-on support, tailored training, and early insights—so civil servants can spend less time on red tape and more on meaningful work. If you're passionate about responsibly deploying frontier AI to uplift public institutions and transform how the government serves the American people, we want you on our team.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced strategy and business operations professional to help OpenAI for Government decide where to grow and how to build the capabilities needed to serve government customers. You will shepherd ambiguous, complex work from problem definition through execution.  The majority of the role will focus on business strategy and operations, from market and revenue planning to workforce, financial, and secure facility initiatives. You should be skilled at both developing a compelling recommendation and doing the detailed work to make it happen.

This role has four key buckets of responsibilities:

 - First, you will support the growth and maturation of a business operations and revenue strategy function within the OpenAI for Government. You will help OpenAI for Government four vertical leaders develop annual business strategies that define target customers, priority projects, partners, and support needed from other matrixed teams including Technical Success, Engineering, Capture and Proposal, Global Affairs, and Product Policy.

 - You will build and maintain the intelligence picture for our key territories: mission priorities, budget lines and program timelines, incumbents and competitive positions, and the people who actually shape awards.

 - You will act as a thought partner to the business verticals by participating in weekly team discussions to understand the business, test assumptions, and identify risks. You will run quarterly reviews to track progress, reassess goals, and adjust priorities.

 - Second, you will partner with OpenAI’s industrial security team to forecast secure-space needs, plan SCIF buildouts, coordinate personnel access nominations, and track contract-specific security requirements and restrictions.

 - Third, you will support OpenAI’s Government Innovation Network, OpenAI for Government’s advisory board, throughout the entire lifecycle of the program, including advisor outreach and selection, independent-contractor agreements (1099s), conflict reviews, payment, and high-touch onboarding.

 - In partnership with OpenAI for Government’s leadership team, you will help design and run regular advisor meetings, quarterly strategy sessions, and targeted convenings, with clear agendas, materials, and decisions.  You will execute follow-through, and ensure advisor insights are integrated into OpenAI for Government’s strategy.

 - Finally, you will own and drive special projects that do not yet have a clear home. You will define the problem, develop options, build consensus, and lead early execution.
   
   


YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have experience in strategy consulting, business operations, a growing technology company, or comparable work combining analytical problem-solving with ownership of execution.

 - Can build financial models, size markets, assess competitive positions, and translate incomplete data into recommendations with clear assumptions and tradeoffs. Are comfortable interpreting government budgets and using market intelligence sources such as Janes to inform long-term investment decisions.

 - Create compelling executive presentations and write concise memos that connect the numbers, strategic choices, and recommended actions.

 - Can define an unfamiliar problem before solving it, learn new technologies and markets quickly, and make progress without a fully formed brief.

 - Enjoy a broad remit and move comfortably between strategic analysis, business operations, and detailed project delivery.

 - Build trust with executives, government stakeholders, advisors, and technical specialists, and influence across functions without formal authority.

 - Bring strong judgment and discretion to sensitive relationships, personnel matters, compensation, and security-related work.

 - Are comfortable managing budgets, vendors, contractors, and competing deadlines, and take responsibility for carrying work through to completion.

 - Are curious about government missions, procurement, policy, and funding. Direct public-sector, defense, or national-security experience is valuable, alongside strong business and analytical skills.

 - Are willing to travel periodically for advisor convenings, agency or customer engagements, and operational projects.

 - Care deeply about the mission and want to help build a durable government business grounded in the responsible deployment of frontier AI.

title: Software Engineer, Life Sciences

ABOUT THE TEAM

Life sciences is one of the clearest areas where advances in intelligence can meaningfully benefit the world at large. The OpenAI Life Sciences team works at the intersection of advancing frontier life sciences model capabilities and building products to help scientists accelerate their research and leverage the full potential of AI for scientific work.

We’re building platforms that connect model intelligence with practical scientific workflows. Our work covers workflows from next-gen sequencing analysis to designing new drugs, helping scientists run computational workloads as well as access laboratory services. By making these capabilities more accessible and useful, we aim to improve early discovery and support downstream progress in drug development.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for experienced full-stack product engineers with strong backend skills to join our growing Life Sciences team.

This is an individual contributor role with substantial ownership. You’ll help define products, design systems, and ship experiences that connect scientists with AI capabilities and laboratory workflows. You’ll work across the stack, partnering with researchers, scientists, and infrastructure engineers to turn complex needs into reliable, intuitive products.

We value strong engineering fundamentals, product judgment, and experience shipping to large user bases. Life sciences experience is helpful, but you don’t need a scientific background to make a meaningful contribution.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Design backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect users with models, scientific tools, and laboratory services.

 - Create intuitive interfaces that help scientists navigate complex workflows.

 - Own projects from problem definition and technical design through launch, operation, and iteration.

 - Work with scientific and research partners to identify user needs and prioritize valuable product improvements.

 - Partner with dedicated infrastructure engineers on performance, reliability, and scaling.

 - Make thoughtful engineering decisions that balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong software engineering fundamentals and depth in backend development, alongside the ability to build across the stack.

 - Have shipped and operated products used by large user bases.

 - Bring strong product sense and can translate ambiguous needs into useful software.

 - Work autonomously, make sound technical decisions, and drive projects forward with limited direction.

 - Enjoy hands-on building and taking ownership within a lean team.

 - Are excited about advances in AI and how they could change scientific work.
