InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

What will you be doing? 

Microsoft Advertising and InMobi have entered a partnership. As per which, InMobi will be the exclusive partner for Microsoft’s Advertising solutions in various regions. Microsoft Advertising empowers the largest advertisers around the world to reach their maximum potential through paid search, display, native & CTV on the Microsoft Ads platform. InMobi will be responsible for complete management / transaction across Microsoft Ads.   

We are seeking an Account Manager with search advertising experience, attention to detail, customer obsession and passion to learn and adapt in an evolving environment. The individual will be coordinating with a team of Account Strategists and supporting Account Management Head to achieve customer satisfaction and revenue objectives. As an AM, you will be serving corporate customers and/or agencies, by applying customer obsession to what clients care about and need, and building and maintaining strong, trusted-advisor relationships with day-to-day practitioner contacts at advertiser/agency/tool provider. The AM will be responsible to manage an assigned set of clients focused on attaining revenue targets, feature adoption and client driven goals  

Role requirement & expectation:  

  • Shared culture of diversity and respect: Create a collaborative, trust-based work environment where differences in communication styles are considered, and the perspectives of others are respected and valued. Always Demonstrate Microsoft Advertising’s culture of inclusiveness and diversity. Contribute to the success of others by promoting mutual learning  
  • Strong customer relationships and account health: Own the day-to-day management for newly onboarded & existing customers. Flawless execution of campaigns. Strong coordination with internal resources for execution of core tasks. Awareness and understanding of all required billing and compliance requirements. Contribute to quality and actionable Customer Plan.  
  • Pursue optimizations to deliver quota expectations: Drive campaign-level budget upsell and optimization opportunities that align to ROI goals of client and drive incremental revenue. Leverage internal tool-directed tactics to inform and prioritize upsells and optimizations, seeking to drive swift implementation. Drive tactic improvement by providing thoughtful feedback to make opportunities more relevant to client goals. Leverage self-serve tools and community forums to deliver insights for non-Insights enabled clients.  
  • Fluent advocate of the Microsoft Advertising Story: Educate clients on how the MS Ads platform and existing features help them to reach their business goals and execute on budgets. Ensure regular client engagement with the Microsoft Ads platform and aim to reduce customer reliance on AM for routine tasks. Utilize all available readiness and insights to ensure you are a fluent advocate of the Microsoft Advertising story. Develop and demonstrate an intermediate level knowledge of emerging products/features.  
  • Collaborative and high-performing account team:  Ensure timely and proactive customer escalations by effectively leveraging Account Executive and internal partner network to resolve day-to-day escalations & revenue blockers. Partner with account team to submit actionable feedback on product, tool and processes through relevant channels. Own and effectively execute the customer transition process and operational excellence in execution of change management (Book of Business update).   
  • Continuous business learning and professional growth: Continuously, strengthen your Microsoft Advertising and Search Industry expertise, take personal accountability for your career and personal development; create, update and regularly check in on your career development plan. Complete required and recommended trainings and apply what you learn to further your growth in role and career progression.  

What is expected out of you?  

  • Minimum 4 years Search Engine Marketing or Online Media and Service experience required   
  • Strong knowledge of Digital advertising: CPA, CPM, CPC, search marketing, lead generation, direct response, etc.  
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving tools with a 'can do' attitude and the ability to partner collaboratively with other functional areas within the company in support of the sales process.  
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed revenue goals or targets   
  • Proven ability to understand customer needs, create and deliver customized, customer-focused pitches and solutions  
  • Effectively navigate through ambiguity and complexities related to client management  
  • Talented in storytelling and delivering engaging presentations   
  • Solid knowledge of the search industry, trends, and customers needs  
  • Passion for technology as an enabler for customer and company growth  
  • Bachelor’s degree required. MBA preferable  
  • Critical thinker who is organized and can make decision based on clear priorities  
  • Collaborative teammate who can build successful team relationships with partners; and can prioritize multiple tasks  
  • Flexible and able to quickly adapt to changing business needs and processes  
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
  • Willingness to travel

Preferred  

  • Microsoft Ads Certification  
  • Experienced using Excel to analyse information, including data manipulation, V-Lookups, creating and using pivot tables, and data analysis  

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.

Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to join our algorithmic and research science team. You'll work on mathematically rigorous, research-driven problems at production scale, while owning problems end to end. This role sits at the intersection of theory and application, designing algorithms that combine elegant modeling with measurable business impact. Specifically, our scientists tackle challenges across traffic shaping, fraud detection, ad quality, pricing strategies, and auction theory, along with their practical applications. We leverage the latest deep learning models alongside classical machine learning techniques to build innovative solutions.

As the heart of the InMobi Exchange, our team optimizes the company's core business functions and creates the strategic moat that sets us apart in the market. As an Applied Scientist, you will not just "use models"—you will formulate them, evaluate their assumptions, tailor them to our problem domain, and bring them to life in production. Many of our challenges have no off-the-shelf solutions; we require scientific creativity to bridge research and reality.

If you thrive on solving complex, high-impact problems and want to see your ideas shape the future of a global exchange, this is the place where your work will truly make a difference.

The impact you'll make:

  • Formulate, analyze, and implement algorithms that power real-time auctions, dynamic pricing, bid shaping, pacing, and traffic allocation across a massive-scale ad marketplace.
  • Design and experiment with methods in online learning, reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, forecasting, game theory, and Bayesian modeling—in non-stationary, adversarial environments.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy your models in production and run real-world experiments with rapid feedback loops (measured in hours, not weeks).
  • Participate in scientific design reviews and contribute to raising the methodological bar of the team.
  • Contribute to the scientific community by publishing high-quality research, conducting internal seminars, and staying abreast of advances in machine learning, algorithms, and applied statistics.
  • Evaluate the long-term dynamics of deployed algorithms, incorporating feedback, exploitation-exploration trade-offs, and incentives within multi-agent systems.
  • Help identify new areas for innovation by translating business challenges into research questions and proposing novel, high-impact methodologies.
  • Translate mathematical ideas into practical, high-performance algorithms that operate at scale in production environments.
  • Explore and close the loop between model predictions and real-world outcomes, refining algorithms based on system behavior.

The experience we need:

  • A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline is strongly preferred. A degree is not a hard requirement—demonstrated research depth and production impact count.
  • 4–7 years of experience working on algorithmic or applied research problems, including significant production deployment experience. Candidates with more or less experience are welcome to apply—we hire across Applied Scientist II, Applied Scientist III, and Staff Applied Scientist levels.
  • Deep grounding in one or more of:
    • Statistical learning theory, mathematical optimization, discrete algorithms, probability theory, and information theory
    • Causal inference, decision theory, game theory, auction theory
    • Online learning, bandits, RL, Bayesian methods
  • Strong publication record (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, AISTATS, KDD, UAI, WSDM, EC, SODA, COLT) is a strong plus—even if not recent.
  • Proficient in scientific computing with Python, including packages such as NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  • Comfortable working with big data platforms like Apache Spark, distributed computing, and large-scale datasets.
  • A researcher's mindset: questions first, implementation later. You are thoughtful about assumptions and rigorous about validation.
  • End-to-end ownership: you can go from idea to production and thrive in applied settings.

Prior experience in ad tech, marketplaces, or dynamic pricing is helpful but not required.

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.

Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

  • Experience building brand systems that work across digital and physical formats
  • Comfortable holding several workstreams at once and making your own calls on priority
  • Production-ready file prep for digital, print, and large format
  • Comfortable integrating AI tools into a modern design workflow

  • Consumer, retail, beauty, or lifestyle brand experience

What is the role about?

You own three integrated pillars: Sales Technology, SalesOps, and Compensation. This role directly supports the global revenue organization, partnering with sales and services teams across every major global market.

You are accountable for ensuring the right people chase the right accounts, with the right tools, measured against the right goals. You will also lead AI transformation across the revenue organization, identifying where AI and automation create meaningful operational leverage and driving adoption end-to-end. The right candidate brings a bias for action, a 1:1 say/do ratio, and a demonstrated track record of holding teams accountable to their commitments.

RevOps Area of Ownership

  • Sales Technology: Own the end-to-end GTM technology stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Einstein, Fireflies, Slack), ensuring system integrity, data accuracy, and a single source of truth. Own vendor relationships, tech-stack audits, the technology budget, and new employee onboarding across all revenue systems.
  • SalesOps: Own the operating system of the sales organization – sales process design, territory planning and segmentation, quota modeling and allocation, pipeline management and forecasting, and velocity and churn/retention analytics.
  • Compensation: Own compensation policy design, quota structure, performance measurement, the GTM scorecard, and commission administration (accelerators, SPIFs, exceptions). Ensure on-time delivery of actualized performance data to HR for payroll and model incentive scenarios each quarter.

AI Transformation

  • Own the AI transformation roadmap for revenue operations: identify the highest-impact opportunities across all three pillars, and drive initiatives from proof-of-concept through full-scale implementation.
  • Lead adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows – intelligent lead scoring, automated deal analysis, pipeline forecasting, and customer health monitoring.
  • Drive AI fluency across the revenue organization through structured enablement and change management.

Operating Cadence

  • Annual: goal-framework design, territory planning, tech-stack audit, compensation policy refresh, vendor reviews, and budget.
  • Quarterly: run the Actualize → Plan → Deliver cycle across all three pillars – close prior quarter, finalize forecasts and incentive models, and deliver quotas, comp plans, and system builds before quarter start.
  • Weekly: pipeline reviews with sales leaders, activity reviews, hygiene enforcement, adoption monitoring, and support triage.

Team Leadership

  • Lead a multi-function team spanning Sales Technology, SalesOps, and Compensation. Build a high-performance culture where commitments are honored and outcomes take precedence over activity.
  • Set quarterly OKRs for all team members with clear accountability for deliverables and timelines. Report on outcomes with measurable business impact.
  • Be a leader within the Bangalore HQ office, leading cross functionally and using influence to drive outcomes.

What is expected from you?

  • 10–15 years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or business operations within digital advertising, B2B SaaS, or technology.
  • Demonstrated success leading a multi-pillar revenue operations function spanning sales technology, sales operations, and compensation.
  • Experience owning the full revenue lifecycle: sales process design, territory planning, quota modeling, pipeline management, forecasting, velocity analytics, churn/retention, and compensation administration.
  • Track record leading AI or automation transformation initiatives within a revenue or go-to-market organization, from evaluation through adoption.
  • Deep working knowledge of Salesforce, HubSpot, Looker, and revenue intelligence platforms (Einstein, Gong, Clari, Fireflies).
  • Proven leadership of cross-functional teams at a global scale with documented business impact and a track record of holding teams to deliverables.

Skills & Attributes

  • Bias for action: You move decisively, prioritize execution, and course-correct as needed.
  • 1:1 say/do ratio: Your commitments are reliable. You deliver what you promise, when you promise it.
  • Accountability-driven: You set clear expectations and hold yourself and your team to them as an operating principle.
  • Solution-oriented: Every problem comes with a proposed path forward.
  • Analytical rigor with the ability to translate complex data into business decisions.
  • Strong project management discipline across multiple concurrent functional areas.
  • Excellent communication skills with an emphasis on clarity, directness, and follow-through.

You will define how IX becomes the most performant, transparent, and measurable environment for commerce advertisers across the full funnel.

Your depth in ad tech and retail media, combined with your ability to lead through complexity and ambiguity, will directly shape what IX becomes in the commerce era.

Glance operates one of the world’s largest owned-and-operated mobile surfaces, reaching hundreds of millions of users across US, India, LATAM, Japan and Southeast Asia. 

As Director – Programmatic Monetization, you will own the programmatic business end-to-end — from revenue and yield to demand partnerships, auction strategy, new monetization capabilities and the team that drives them. 

This is a global leadership role with direct accountability for building the next phase of Glance’s programmatic monetization engine. 

What will you be doing?

  • Revenue & Growth: Own global programmatic revenue, growth strategy, annual plans and forecasts across markets. 
  • Global Demand Partnerships: Build and manage senior relationships with SSPs, exchanges and agencies, including commercial terms, strategic partnerships and supply commitments. 
  • Deals & Auction Packages: Drive growth of PMP, PG and curated auction packages, increasing their contribution to overall programmatic revenue. 
  • Programmatic Capabilities: Define and build new auction, bidding, yield and monetization capabilities that expand what Glance can monetize. 
  • Format Innovation: Identify, develop and scale new ad formats and placements across Glance’s surfaces while balancing monetization with user experience. 
  • AI-First Monetization: Establish AI as a core operating layer for the monetization function — using AI to forecast, detect anomalies, optimize yield, automate reporting and improve decision-making, while applying judgment on where AI adds real value. 
  • Policy & Platform Readiness: Ensure compliance with platform, privacy and industry policies, while driving Glance’s approval, onboarding and readiness across major demand platforms. 
  • Industry Representation: Represent Glance with global demand partners, industry forums and relevant advertising bodies, shaping conversations around programmatic, publisher monetization and emerging standards. 
  • Team & Organization: Build, structure and scale the programmatic monetization organization, establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms and strong functional depth. 

What is expected out of you?

  • 12+ years of experience in ad tech, with senior ownership of programmatic or publisher-side revenue at a large publisher, SSP, exchange, app developer or similar ecosystem. 
  • A proven track record of owning revenue metrics with experience building plans, forecasts and growth strategies. 
  • Deep hands-on understanding of the programmatic stack, including auction mechanics, bidding architecture, ad serving, measurement, identity and yield optimization. You should be able to go deep enough with engineering and partners to challenge assumptions and identify the real constraint. 
  • Strong publisher-side monetization expertise, including pricing, yield management, demand optimization and the trade-offs between revenue, fill, latency and user experience. 
  • Leverage AI to drive efficiency and performance — use AI models and tooling to forecast performance, identify anomalies, optimize yield, automate workflows and reduce manual reporting, while applying human judgment where it adds the most value. 
  • Experience operating across multiple global markets, with a strong understanding of how programmatic strategy, demand dynamics, pricing and user behavior differ by geography. US market experience is a strong plus. 
  • A demonstrated ability to build, lead and level up high-performing teams, with experience hiring strong talent, developing leaders and creating scalable operating structures. 
  • Strong commercial and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across product, engineering, sales, finance, legal and external partners. 
  • A strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between long-term business strategy and the technical details of an auction happening today.

description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

About the Role 

We are looking for a creative, tech-savvy and ambitious Creative & Communications Intern to join our Talent team for a 3-month internship. 

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys turning ideas into great visuals, videos, stories and experiences. You could be designing a campaign one day, shooting an employee story the next, editing a reel, creating a handbook or experimenting with AI to find a better way to bring an idea to life. 

We are looking for someone who doesn't just execute a brief, but can think creatively, figure things out independently and push the quality of the final output. 

What You'll Do 

  • Create posters, digital creatives, presentations, emailers, infographics and campaign assets. 
  • Shoot and edit videos, reels, interviews, employee stories and events. 
  • Use a DSLR/professional camera for photography and videography. 
  • Create engaging content across different formats, from static design to short-form video. 
  • Develop digital and physical handbooks, guides and toolkits. 
  • Experiment with AI and emerging creative tools to improve the speed, quality and range of your work. 
  • Help build a repository of reusable creative assets, templates, photographs, videos and content. 
  • Work across different Talent, employee and employer branding initiatives. 

What We're Looking For 

  • A strong portfolio/showreel is essential. We want to see what you have actually created. 
  • Strong skills in graphic design and visual communication. 
  • Experience with Canva and Photoshop. Knowledge of other design/video tools is a plus. 
  • Experience with video editing and creating reels/short-form content. 
  • Comfortable shooting with a DSLR or professional camera. 
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling, composition, typography and branding. 
  • Curious and highly tech-savvy, with an interest in AI and new creative tools. 
  • Comfortable using tools such as Claude, Canva, Photoshop and other AI/design platforms to experiment and create. 
  • Able to take an idea from concept → creation → final output with limited hand-holding. 
  • Someone who thinks beyond the obvious and can say, "There's probably a better/more interesting way to do this." 
  • High standards for your own work. Ambition and quality matter to us. 

Who Would Thrive Here? 

You might be a design, communication, media, film, visual arts or related student — but your portfolio matters more than your degree. 

You may have built content for college clubs, events, communities, social media, freelance projects, startups or your own personal projects. 

If you are someone who enjoys designing, shooting, editing, experimenting with technology and building things from scratch, we'd love to hear from you. 

Internship Details 

  • Duration: 3 months 
  • Work arrangement: Work from office, 5 days a week 
  • Eligibility: Students who are in college and are available for a 3-month internship 
  • Portfolio/showreel: Required 

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.

Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

InMobi Advertising is a global technology leader helping marketers win the moments that matter. Our advertising platform reaches over 2 billion people across 150+ countries and turns real-time context into business outcomes, delivering results grounded in privacy-first principles. Trusted by 30,000+ brands and leading publishers, InMobi is where intelligence, creativity, and accountability converge. By combining lock screens, apps, TVs, and the open web with AI and machine learning, we deliver receptive attention, precise personalization, and measurable impact.

Through Glance AI, we are shaping AI Commerce, reimagining the future of e-commerce with inspiration-led discovery and shopping. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI transforms every screen into a gateway for instant, personal, and joyful discovery.  Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences. With rich first-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi’s global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high impact, performance driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company’s Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.

At InMobi Advertising, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit www.inmobi.com

 

What will you be doing? 

Microsoft and InMobi have entered into partnership. As per which, InMobi will be exclusive partner for Microsoft’s Advertising inventory. Microsoft Advertising empowers the largest advertisers around the world to reach their maximum potential through paid search engine marketing on the Microsoft Ads platform. InMobi will be responsible for complete management / transaction across Bing.  

We are seeking a Lead Account Manager with search advertising experience an attention to detail, customer obsession and passion to learn and adapt in an evolving environment. The individual will be coordinating with a team of Account Strategists and supporting Account Management Head to achieve customer satisfaction and revenue objectives. As an AM, you will be serving Corporate customers by applying customer obsession to what clients care about and need, and building and maintaining strong, trusted-advisor relationships with day-to-day practitioner contacts at advertiser/agency/tool provider. The AM will be responsible to manage an assigned set of clients focused on attaining revenue targets, feature adoption and client driven goals 

Role requirement & expectation: 

  • Shared culture of diversity and respect: Create a collaborative, trust-based work environment where differences in communication styles are considered, and the perspectives of others are respected and valued. Demonstrate Search Advertising’s culture of inclusiveness and diversity at all times. Contribute to the success of others by promoting mutual learning 
  • Strong customer relationships and account health: Own the day-to-day management for newly onboarded & existing customers. Flawless execution of campaigns. Strong coordination with internal resources for execution of core tasks. Awareness and understanding of all required billing and compliance requirements. Contribute to quality and actionable Customer Plan. 
  • Pursue optimizations to deliver quota expectations: Drive campaign-level budget upsell and optimization opportunities that align to ROI goals of client and drive incremental revenue. Leverage internal tool-directed tactics to inform and prioritize upsells and optimizations, seeking to drive swift implementation. Drive tactic improvement by providing thoughtful feedback to make opportunities more relevant to client goals. Leverage self-serve tools and community forums to deliver insights for non-Insights enabled clients. 
  • Fluent advocate of the Bing Story: Educate clients on how the Bing Ads platform and existing features help them to reach their business goals and execute on budgets. Ensure regular client engagement with the BingAds platform, and aim to reduce customer reliance on AM for routine tasks. Utilize all available readiness and insights to ensure you are a fluent advocate of the Bing story. Develop and demonstrate an intermediate level knowledge of emerging products/features. 
  • Collaborative and high-performing account team:  Ensure timely and proactive customer escalations by effectively leveraging Account Executive and internal partner network to resolve day-to-day escalations & revenue blockers. Partner with account team to submit actionable feedback on product, tool and processes through relevant channels. Own and effectively execute the customer transition process and operational excellence in execution of change management (Book of Business update).  
  • Continuous business learning and professional growth: Continually strengthen your Bing Ads and Search Industry expertise, take personal accountability for your career and personal development; create, update and regularly check in on your career development plan. Complete required and recommended trainings and apply what you learn to further your growth in role and career progression. 

What is expected out of you ? 

  • Minimum 7 years’ in Search Engine Marketing Sales or online media and Service experience required in Philippines 
  • Strong knowledge of Internet advertising: CPA, CPM, CPC, search marketing, lead generation, direct response, etc. 
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem solving tools with a 'can do' attitude and the ability to partner collaboratively with other functional areas within the company in support of the sales process. 
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed revenue goals or targets  
  • Proven ability to understand customer needs, create and deliver customized, customer-focused pitches and solutions 
  • Effectively navigate through ambiguity and complexities related to client management 
  • Talented in storytelling and delivering engaging presentations  
  • Solid knowledge of the search industry, trends, and customers needs 
  • Passion for technology as an enabler for customer and company growth 
  • Bachelor’s degree required. MBA preferable 
  • Critical thinker who is organized and can make decision based on clear priorities 
  • Collaborative teammate who can build successful team relationships with partners; and can prioritize multiple tasks 
  • Flexible and able to quickly adapt to changing business needs and processes 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
  • Willingness  to travel 

Preferred 

  • Bing Ads Certification 
  • Experienced using Excel to analyze information, including data manipulation, V-Lookups, creating and using pivot tables, and data analysis 

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the Role:

As our Administration and Workspace Lead, you’ll own the day-to-day administration and facilities operations of our San Mateo, CA office. You'll make sure employees have a safe, well-maintained workplace and office services they can count on, while keeping expenses, vendor documentation, and operational reporting accurate and within approved budgets.

You’ll be the primary local contact for all workplace matters, coordinating service providers and partnering closely with our global Workspace team, HR, IT, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and building management. This is a hands-on lead role that calls for independent judgment, proactive follow-through, and a strong service mindset.

If you take pride in creating a workplace where everything runs smoothly, and people feel taken care of from the moment they walk in, this role is for you.

Location: This position is based onsite in our San Mateo, California office.

The Impact You’ll Make:

Office Operations & Facilities

  • Lead daily office operations, conducting regular walkthroughs and maintaining an action tracker for repairs, employee requests, and service issues
  • Coordinate preventive maintenance and repairs with building management and qualified vendors, covering facilities, furniture, lighting, air conditioning, plumbing, pantry equipment, and other workplace assets
  • Keep workstations, meeting rooms, reception areas, and shared spaces ready for use, and coordinate room bookings and office arrangements for meetings and leadership visits
  • Maintain the visibility and condition of InMobi signage, logos, and approved branding throughout the office
  • Keep stationery, office supplies, and pantry items well stocked through inventory checks, reorder levels, and consumption tracking

Vendor & Landlord Management

  • Serve as the local point of contact for the landlord, building management, and vendors supporting cleaning, catering, maintenance, security, pest control, transportation, and other office services
  • Obtain and compare quotes, recommend the right service providers, and coordinate onboarding through the company’s approval and procurement processes
  • Ensure signed agreements are in place for every engaged vendor, and maintain accessible records of contracts, service scope, pricing, contact details, and supporting documents
  • Track lease and vendor contract obligations, renewal dates, notice periods, and service commitments, escalating upcoming decisions to Workspace leadership and Legal well in advance
  • Review vendor performance, address recurring service gaps, and arrange approved backup options to minimize disruption

Payments, Budgets & Expense Reporting

  • Coordinate timely payment of rent, maintenance charges, utilities, and approved vendor bills by securing accurate invoices and required approvals and following up with Finance
  • Maintain complete payment records for audit and reconciliation, including invoices, approvals, purchase orders where applicable, receipts, and payment acknowledgments
  • Prepare monthly office expense reports and forecasts, track spending against the approved budget, explain variances, and obtain approval before making additional commitments
  • Tag expenses clearly by location, purpose or occasion, category, and budget owner, and partner with HR and Finance to distinguish HR expenses from Workspace expenses
  • Reconcile office credit card transactions with receipts and business purposes, submit documentation on time, and follow up on missing or disputed transactions
  • Identify practical savings through vendor reviews, demand planning, and reduced waste, while maintaining agreed service standards

Meals, Pantry & Employee Experience

  • Manage employee breakfast and lunch arrangements, including headcount planning, vendor coordination, delivery schedules, food quality, and employee feedback
  • Coordinate dietary requirements and allergen information with meal providers, and ensure meals are handled and served appropriately
  • Keep drinking water, coffee machines, snacks, and pantry essentials available, replenished, and maintained, monitoring expiration dates to avoid unnecessary waste
  • Gather employee feedback on facilities and services, respond to concerns, and keep people updated until issues are resolved

Travel, Visitors & Events

  • Assist employees and visiting colleagues with approved hotel bookings, car services, and other local travel arrangements in line with company policy
  • Plan monthly employee engagement activities with HR and the Workspace team, reflecting local culture and employee interests within approved budgets
  • Coordinate local and international celebrations, office events, and leadership visits once the required admin and budget approvals are in place
  • Communicate approved regional holidays and relevant office service changes to employees by email, in coordination with HR

Safety, Security & Emergency Readiness

  • Maintain a safe and secure workplace through regular checks, prompt reporting of hazards, and coordination with building management, Security, and relevant internal teams
  • Coordinate fire drills, evacuation readiness, emergency contact lists, and employee awareness of emergency procedures, keeping exits and emergency access routes clear
  • Track inspections and servicing of fire safety equipment with building management and qualified providers, arranging refills or replacements when due and retaining service records
  • Keep a well-stocked first-aid kit available, check expiration dates regularly, arrange replenishment, and coordinate with designated trained responders when assistance is needed
  • Maintain an emergency escalation plan covering employee safety incidents, building issues, and major service disruptions, documenting incidents and tracking corrective actions
  • Provide after-hours emergency coordination, including weekends and holidays when required, under an agreed escalation and coverage arrangement, escalating promptly and coordinating backup support

Cleaning, Hygiene & Pest Management

  • Supervise routine housekeeping and weekly deep cleaning, using checklists that cover work areas, meeting rooms, restrooms, pantry areas, and shared spaces
  • Monitor hygiene standards, waste collection, and housekeeping quality, following up promptly on deficiencies and maintaining cleaning records
  • Coordinate pest-control inspections or service visits every two weeks, and arrange treatment or fumigation when qualified providers assess it as necessary, with appropriate approvals and employee communication
  • Schedule disruptive cleaning or treatment activities to minimize interruption, and follow the provider’s instructions for safe access and re-entry

Onboarding & Offboarding Support

  • Partner with HR to prepare welcome kits, workplace access, seating, and local office orientation for new hires
  • Work with IT and HR to coordinate laptop delivery and setup before each new hire’s start date, tracking readiness and escalating delays to the responsible team
  • Support HR with meeting room bookings and office arrangements for induction sessions
  • Coordinate with HR and IT to collect laptops, access cards, and other company assets from departing employees, maintaining handover records and obtaining confirmation from the responsible teams

Policy Compliance & Operational Reporting

  • Follow company policies and coordinate with relevant internal specialists and vendors to meet applicable local requirements for office operations
  • Maintain organized records of contracts, expenses, inventories, safety checks, and service schedules, handling employee and business information confidentially
  • Share regular updates with Workspace leadership on service performance, budgets, employee concerns, risks, and outstanding actions, recommending improvements and tracking their implementation

The Experience We Need:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification; an MBA or a qualification in hospitality, facilities management, or business administration is preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in office administration, workplace operations, facilities management, or hospitality
  • Experience independently managing office services and coordinating multiple vendors, with prior lead or supervisory experience preferred
  • Experience supporting a US corporate office, including working with local vendors and building management, is preferred
  • Hands-on experience with expense tracking, invoice documentation, budgets, contract administration, and employee service requests

Skills & Working Style

  • Strong written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate clearly with employees, vendors, leadership, and global teams
  • Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, including the ability to maintain expense trackers, analyze spending, and prepare clear operational updates
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing requests without losing follow-through
  • Sound judgment in prioritizing urgent issues, making decisions within delegated authority, and escalating risks early
  • A professional, approachable service style, with discretion when handling confidential information
  • The ability to guide service providers, negotiate practical solutions, and hold vendors accountable for agreed standards
  • Availability for on-site office support and coordination across time zones, with flexibility for planned events and emergency coverage under agreed arrangements

At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…

  • Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks 

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location. 

The base salary (fixed) for this role ranges from $105,500 to $120,000 USD (min to max of base salary). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*.

*Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the roles, in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of ESOPs (Employee Stock Option Plan). We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stock to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company’s best interests. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.

A quick snapshot of our U.S. benefits:

  • Competitive salary and ESOP grant (where applicable)        
  • High-quality medical, dental, and vision insurance (including company-matched HSA)       
  • 401(k) company match 
  • Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays   
  • Substantial maternity and paternity leave benefits and compassionate work environment 
  • Flexible working hours to suit everyone 
  • Wellness stipend for a healthier you!      
  • Free lunch is provided in our offices daily   
  • Pet-friendly work environment and robust pet insurance policy - because we love our animals! 
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)   

If this sounds like the kind of team, role, values, benefits, and challenges that excite you, we’d love to hear from you. Go for it!

InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Who are we and What do we do? 

InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. Its businesses across advertising, marketing, data and content platforms are shaping consumer experience in a world of connected devices. InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s 2018 World’s Most Innovative Companies. 

What’s the InMobi family like?   

Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun loving, take ownership and are results focused. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion. 

What do we promise? 

We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups. At InMobi, you get food for your body, soul, and mind with daily meals, gym, and yoga classes, cutting-edge training and tools, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work. 

Team Overview

InMobi’s Programmatic Buying team works to manage revenue operations and is focused solely on buying media for the company globally. We are focused on winning new business, growing InMobi’s market share, and developing our reputation of being an industry leader.

What will you be doing : 

As part of the Programmatic Buying team, you will be playing a critical operations and revenue management role at InMobi. You would be completely responsible for setting campaigns, managing and delivering revenue on the “DSP Platform” and you are expected to work closely with all stakeholders (regional sales, supply, product, engineering, marketing and ad ops teams) to drive cross functional support to maximize revenue delivered. He/ she would have to drive revenue reporting and tracking, data analytics and develop insights into supply needs, pricing optimization, product/ tech liaising exercises.

We are looking for sharp, analytical and growth oriented professionals who can solve complex problems in a structured manner, have experience of working in cross functional roles and develop close strategic relationships with stakeholders, while proactively and clearly communicating data and insights to sales, supply, product teams and to global leadership.

You are expected to work for growing the Revenue and Margin for the region/pod allocated by actively collaborating with Customer Success/ Sales teams by understanding the capabilities of the DSP Platform. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • End to End Ownership of Campaign Delivery (Onboarding, Campaign creation, Optimization, Reporting and insights etc) and Strategizing for Revenue growth for both tactical and long-term opportunities.
  • Drive conversations with Sales/Customer Success teams for the smooth Campaign Delivery, handling the challenges and adopting collaborative workstyle.
  • Derive Insights on various Revenue, Product, and Supply metrics, to collaborate with Product/Supply teams for feature improvements
  • Meet and exceed campaign goals through campaign strategy and optimization.
  • Work with huge volumes of data to arrive at meaningful insights and strategies about the campaigns.
  • Own weekly exec level revenue/ margin reporting for the portfolio of accounts.
  • Ability to take ownership and getting things done in the stipulated time.

What do we require from you?

Ideal candidates must possess: 

  • 5-6 years of experience in a Digital Native / Startup companies, involved Data Analysis with actionable insights / Revenue Management 
  • Exceptional analytical skills, entrepreneurial, and a creative approach to problem solving, with the ability to understand key metrics and apply these to performance optimizations. 
  • Strong, robust MS Excel skills and proven competency in numeracy and logical reasoning 
  • Effective and proactive communication skills

Nice to have: 

  • Outstanding teamwork, organizational & interpersonal skills, with tremendous attention to detail. 
  • Ability to work across different global cultures and in a matrix style environment 

InMobi provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.

Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

location: New York, NY or San Mateo, CA
description:

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the Role:

The Lead Client Growth Manager - Performance will join our rapidly expanding Performance team in the Americas region — a group at the forefront of innovation within the mobile in-app advertising ecosystem. In a fast-moving and ever-evolving landscape, this team delivers differentiated, high-impact performance solutions powered by market-leading SKAN capabilities, one of the world's largest in-app mobile exchanges, and uniquely advantaged inventory through global telco and OEM partnerships.

At InMobi, our culture is our true north. It empowers us to think boldly, solve complex challenges, and unlock meaningful growth opportunities for our clients and our business. InMobians are passionate, driven, creative, and ownership-minded — and we are deeply results-focused. Your work in this role will be highly visible, with direct impact across the organization. You'll collaborate with an ambitious, high-caliber peer group that is invested in your success, while benefiting from a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development through both internal and external resources.

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping client growth strategy within one of the most dynamic and strategically important areas of digital advertising.

The Impact You'll Make:

  • Own and deepen client relationships with the goal of becoming a top strategic partner, driving maximum campaign ROI by understanding advertiser objectives, KPIs, and operational nuances (technical integrations, creative strategy, supply dynamics, delivery optimizations).
  • Lead in-depth campaign analysis and performance reviews; provide consultative, data-driven guidance in weekly and bi-weekly discussions, and confidently drive Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
  • Track account-level revenue and delivery priorities on a weekly basis, contributing insights to CXO-level reporting and strategic planning conversations.
  • Drive quarterly account retention, revenue, and margin targets, while identifying opportunities for upsell and cross-sell to expand the overall book of business. Partner closely with Sales on strategic account planning and execution.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (traders, ad operations, and cross-functional partners) to optimize day-to-day campaign performance and implement high-impact strategic improvements.
  • Work alongside Sales Engineering to coordinate with third-party partners such as MMPs, viewability providers, data platforms (DMPs), and attribution solutions.
  • Serve as an in-market product expert, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to provide feedback, drive adoption, and elevate AM-region execution standards.

The Experience We Need:

  • 8+ years of professional experience, including 3–4+ years within the programmatic, demand-side advertising space — ideally in performance or growth marketing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-facing roles with a track record of delivering measurable business outcomes. Experience working with DSPs and/or MMPs is strongly preferred.
  • Strategic mindset with a strong focus on revenue growth and retention; demonstrated success in driving account expansion and long-term client partnerships is highly valued.
  • Proficiency with standard business tools, including Salesforce, Microsoft Office Suite, and reporting/visualization platforms such as Power BI and Tableau.
  • Ability to manage multiple clients and campaigns simultaneously with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and disciplined time management.
  • Comfort collaborating with global teams across time zones and planning work accordingly.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required; background in advertising, marketing, business, or STEM fields is a plus.

At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…

  • Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location. 

The base salary (fixed) for this role ranges from $109,500 to $148,000 USD (min to max of base salary pay range). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*. In addition, an InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.

*Our ranges may vary based on the final location and region of the role in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of a stock grant known as ESOPs (Employee Stock Option Plan). To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we believe that our employees should have the ability to own a part of the organization. Furthermore, as you contribute to the growth of the company, additional stock may be issued in recognition of your contribution over time.

A quick snapshot of our benefits:

  • Competitive salary and ESOP grant (where applicable)        
  • High-quality medical, dental, and vision insurance (including company-matched HSA)       
  • 401(k) company match 
  • Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays   
  • Substantial maternity and paternity leave benefits and a compassionate work environment 
  • Flexible working hours to suit everyone 
  • Wellness stipend for a healthier you!      
  • Free lunch provided in our offices daily   
  • Pet-friendly work environment and robust pet insurance policy - because we love our animals! 
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

If this sounds like the kind of team, role, values, benefits, and challenges that excite you, we’d love to hear from you. Go for it!

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer      

InMobi is a place where everyone can grow. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to work.

The InMobi Story 

We like big challenges. Building a new company in 2007 was no ordinary task. As the recession hit, the iPhone was born and launched a revolution. Mobile advertising wasn’t yet a thing, other than SMS, and venture capital funding was hard to come by for four guys in India.     

Yet with passion, foresight, and conviction – InMobi charted its own course, helping to transform the way consumers engage with their phones and create today's booming app economy wherein consumers now spend 4.2 hours per day.   

After fourteen years of innovation, our end-to-end advertising software platform, connected content and commerce experiences have formed a powerful engine for growth that activates audiences, drives real connections, and diversifies revenue for companies around the world.   

Our global organization of InMobians are excited to continue discovering and developing impactful technologies that will continue to transform people, businesses, and society. 

Title: Manager - Executive Assistant

Position Summary:

We are looking for a highly experienced and proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative and strategic support to senior leadership. This is a high-visibility role that demands exceptional discretion, sharp organizational instincts, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment.

The ideal candidate will bring at least 7-8 years of EA experience, ideally supporting C-suite or senior leadership, and will be comfortable managing competing priorities while maintaining confidentiality at all times. Experience working directly with Founders and/or CEOs is a strong advantage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Calendar & Schedule Management

  • Own and manage complex, multi-time zone calendars for one or more senior leaders
  • Proactively anticipate and resolve scheduling conflicts
  • Coordinate internal/external meetings, calls, and events across time zones and departments

2. Communication & Correspondence

  • Draft, review, and manage professional correspondence and memos on behalf of leadership
  • Act as primary point of contact — screening and triaging high-volume email and requests
  • Liaise confidently with internal stakeholders, external partners, clients, and senior executives

3. Administrative & Operational Support

  • Prepare, format, and organize reports, presentations, and business documents
  • Maintain organized filing systems for sensitive records and correspondence
  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers, tracking key deliverables and timelines

Role overview

We are looking for a Lead – Workspace Transportation to manage employee transportation for our Bangalore office. As the service expands, this role will own daily operations, vendor performance, route planning, employee communication, and cost control, with a strong focus on safety and reliable pickup and drop services.

The lead will be the primary contact for transportation matters and work closely with Workspace leadership, transport partners, Security, HR, Finance, and Procurement. The role requires hands-on operational ownership, sound judgment during disruptions, and a practical understanding of Bangalore traffic and employee commuting needs.

Key responsibilities

Daily operations and capacity planning

  • Oversee daily pickup and drop operations, including trip scheduling, vehicle allocation, driver readiness, dispatch, and completion tracking.
  • Plan service capacity using employee demand, office attendance, shift timings, new joiner requirements, and approved service coverage.
  • Coordinate route planning and pickup points to balance employee convenience, travel time, vehicle occupancy, and cost. Review routes regularly as demand changes.
  • Account for Bangalore traffic, rain, road closures, and peak-hour congestion when setting schedules. Arrange approved backup vehicles and vendors for disruptions.
  • Monitor live trips through the transport platform and vendor control teams. Respond promptly to delays, missed pickups, vehicle breakdowns, and last-minute changes.
  • Maintain clear operating procedures for bookings, cancellations, no-shows, route changes, exceptions, and escalation handovers.

Vendor and driver management

  • Manage transport partners against agreed service levels, fleet commitments, pricing, and response times. Conduct regular reviews and document corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with vendor supervisors and dispatch teams to ensure sufficient vehicles, qualified drivers, and operational support for each service window.
  • Assess proposed vendors with Procurement and relevant teams, compare quotations, and support commercial discussions and onboarding.
  • Monitor driver conduct, punctuality, route adherence, and complaints. Require vendors to address inappropriate behaviour and recurring performance issues.
  • Track vendor contracts, renewal dates, rate cards, and service commitments. Maintain an updated contact directory and escalation matrix.

Safety service quality and financial ownership

Employee safety and transport compliance

  • Coordinate verification of driver identity, licences, background checks, and required vehicle documents through approved company and vendor processes.
  • Track validity of applicable vehicle permits, insurance, fitness, pollution certificates, and other required records with vendors and the relevant internal teams.
  • Ensure vendors follow company-approved transport safety procedures, including applicable requirements for late-hour travel and women employee safety.
  • Monitor the availability and functioning of required vehicle safety features, tracking systems, emergency contacts, and communication arrangements.
  • Coordinate periodic vehicle and service checks with vendors. Escalate unsafe vehicles or drivers promptly and arrange replacements before service resumes.
  • Handle employee location, contact, and trip data confidentially, with access and sharing limited to approved business needs.

Escalations and emergency response

  • Act as the primary operational escalation contact for employee transport concerns and coordinate timely resolution with vendors and internal teams.
  • Maintain response procedures for accidents, breakdowns, safety concerns, severe weather, and service disruptions. Coordinate with Security and emergency services when needed.
  • Keep employees informed of delays and alternative arrangements through approved channels, with clear updates until the issue is resolved.
  • Prepare contingency plans for vehicle shortages, vendor outages, and driver availability issues, including approved alternate providers.
  • Document incidents, investigate causes with the responsible teams, and track preventive actions. Escalate material safety or service failures to Workspace leadership.
  • Provide support during critical service windows and after-hours emergencies under an agreed coverage arrangement, with documented backup and handovers.

Budgets billing and cost control

  • Prepare transportation budgets and demand forecasts. Monitor monthly spending and highlight variances or additional funding needs before commitments are made.
  • Validate vendor invoices against completed trips, approved rate cards, kilometres or hours where applicable, and authorised additional charges.
  • Maintain supporting trip records, approvals, purchase orders where applicable, invoices, and reconciliation reports for payment and audit.
  • Work with Finance and Procurement to resolve billing discrepancies and ensure approved payments are processed within agreed timelines.
  • Improve vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, reduce avoidable empty runs and no-shows, and assess savings without compromising safety or agreed service standards.

Employee experience reporting and candidate requirements

Employee communication and continuous improvement

  • Explain transport eligibility, booking processes, pickup schedules, cancellations, and service changes clearly to employees.
  • Coordinate with HR and Workspace teams to support new joiner transport onboarding and changes in employee commuting requirements.
  • Collect employee feedback, track complaints to closure, and identify recurring issues requiring route changes or vendor action.
  • Maintain an operational dashboard covering punctuality, completed and missed trips, occupancy, complaints, incidents, vendor performance, and costs.
  • Share regular updates with Workspace leadership and recommend service improvements supported by operational data. Establish measurable service targets with leadership and vendors.

Education and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. A qualification in operations, logistics, supply chain, hospitality, or business administration is preferred.
  • Preferably five to eight years of relevant experience in corporate employee transportation, fleet operations, or transport vendor management, including experience independently leading operations.
  • Experience managing multiple transport vendors, service escalations, route planning, billing validation, and operational reporting.
  • Strong understanding of Bangalore commuting patterns and practical experience managing services during traffic congestion and operational disruptions.
  • Experience using employee transport management platforms such as RouteMatic or similar systems is preferred.

Skills and working approach

  • Strong English communication and stakeholder coordination. Working knowledge of Kannada or Hindi is helpful for local vendor coordination.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including expense trackers, data reconciliation, and service dashboards; working knowledge of Word and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to prioritise live operational issues, make decisions within delegated authority, and escalate risks early.
  • Strong negotiation, attention to detail, and follow-through, with a service mindset and a firm approach to safety and vendor accountability.
  • Ability to guide vendor supervisors and transport coordinators, maintain clear handovers, and support onsite operations across required service windows.

Measures of success

  • Pickup and drop punctuality and trip fulfilment against agreed service targets.
  • Timely resolution of employee concerns and fewer recurring vendor failures.
  • Complete and current driver and vehicle verification records, with safety actions tracked to closure.
  • Accurate billing reconciliation, timely monthly reporting, and spending within approved budgets.
  • Improved vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, supported by a tested contingency and escalation plan.

We're moving fast and deep into architectural research, generative AI adoption, compute scaling on the latest accelerators (GPUs/TPUs), and advances in reinforcement learning.

You'll join a team of experienced researchers and engineers who have been pushing the boundaries of ad science research for over a decade, working closely with data and platform engineering to build solutions that scale and serve the needs of every science team across the organization. This is a chance to shape the infrastructure and models behind ad intelligence operating at truly massive scale.

  • Leverage the breadth of data features across our product portfolio to strengthen our data pipelines and unlock new features for training and inference
  • Explore new platforms and ecosystems (e.g., JAX on TPUs) to help diversify our compute
  • Collaborate closely with Applied Scientists on active research, contributing directly to experiment design and modeling

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, building state-of-the-art machine learning/deep learning systems at extreme scale

  • Expertise in Python; familiarity with Java (especially in high-performance serving systems) is a plus
  • Expertise in PyTorch or a similar ecosystem
  • Experience with accelerator-based inference systems such as Triton, and optimization backends like ONNX and TensorRT
  • Experience with cloud platforms and container orchestration using Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of deep recommender systems, including two-tower and attention-based architectures, is a plus
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning systems — including RL approaches, reward signals, and post-training feedback loops — is a plus
  • Understanding of the ads ecosystem (OpenRTB, SSPs, DSPs, ad exchanges, MMPs) is a plus
