About the job  

Who are we and What do we do?  

InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. Its businesses across advertising, marketing, data and content platforms are shaping consumer experience in a world of connected devices. InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast 

What does the team do?  

Opportunity is part of the evolving cyber security group which is laser focussed on setting up industry benchmarks in managing & guarding against digital risks in a “Cloud Native- DevOps Only” environment. It is a lean-mean-special action group where every cyber sentinel gets an opportunity to work across domain, has an independence to challenge status quo & evolve cyber practises to next level of maturity. Our core competencies revolve around “Product & Platform security”, “Cloud Native Risk Management” and “Detection & Response”.  

What will you be doing? 

This role combines technical leadership and hands-on execution: you will spend ~60% of your time performing application security testing, vulnerability assessments and penetration testing, code reviews, AI/ML security testing, and automation, and ~40% of your time managing the AppSec domain, leading the team, defining strategy, and coordinating with stakeholders.

  • Lead the Application Security program across products, platforms, and engineering teams, defining strategy, roadmap, and measurable KPIs for AppSec and AI security maturity.
  • Manage and mentor a team of AppSec engineers, ensuring effective prioritization, workload management, and continuous skill development.
  • Perform hands-on SAST, DAST, manual code review, penetration testing, and vulnerability validation across web, mobile (Android and iOS), API, and cloud platforms.
  • Perform security assessments of AI/ML and GenAI systems, including LLM applications, model endpoints, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Cloud, DevOps, and Data Science teams to embed security controls early in the SDLC and ML/AI development lifecycle through automation, guardrails, and secure-by-design principles.
  • Drive remediation governance: triage, track, and report on vulnerabilities with accountability across stakeholders; ensure closure within defined SLAs.
  • Conduct security architecture and design reviews for new applications, APIs, integrations, and AI/ML systems to ensure alignment with enterprise security standards.
  • Define and enforce secure coding guidelines, threat modeling practices (including AI/LLM threat models), and application and model hardening standards.
  • Collaborate with the GRC and Incident Response teams to ensure audit readiness, compliance evidence and support during incidents.
  • Research and adopt emerging AppSec and AI security technologies, frameworks, and practices to continuously strengthen defenses and developer experience.
  • Drive metrics and reporting to senior leadership on AppSec performance, risk posture, and progress against roadmap goals.

What is expected of you?

  • 10 to 14 years of experience.
  • Proven leadership experience in Application Security, DevSecOps, or Software Security Engineering, with the ability to lead a high-performing team while staying technically hands-on.
  • Deep hands-on understanding of SAST, DAST, and secure SDLC integration; prior experience implementing and scaling security testing automation.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML and LLM security, threat modeling and testing against frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP ML Security Top 10, and MITRE ATLAS; familiarity with securing GenAI/agentic applications and AI pipelines.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills to influence and collaborate with product, engineering, cloud, and data science teams for timely triage and remediation.
  • Experience managing AppSec tooling stack like Checkmarx, Burp Suite Enterprise, OWASP ZAP, MobSF, and open-source frameworks; exposure to AI security testing tooling (e.g., Garak, PyRIT, or equivalent) is a plus.
  • Solid grasp of secure coding, vulnerability exploitation, and mitigation techniques across web, mobile, API, and AI/ML layers.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD automation, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), and container security (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, OWASP LLM Top 10, and industry best practices.
  • Excellent communication, reporting, and presentation skills for technical and executive audiences.
  • Certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, GPEN, or equivalent are preferred; AI security certifications (e.g., CAISP) are a plus.
  • Prior experience in building or scaling AppSec or AI security programs and driving measurable security improvements is a strong plus.

You will own the development of differentiated GTM narratives, proactive market-facing collateral, and scalable frameworks that strengthen seller effectiveness and accelerate revenue growth. 

You will partner closely with Product, Sales Leadership, BI, Trading, Supply, Deal Desk, and Product Marketing,  centralized Marketing teams across North America, APAC, and EMEA. You will also remain close to execution - setting the quality bar for RFPs, client proposals, narrative decks, and strategic customer opportunities while building repeatable processes for the broader team. 

What You'll Be Doing 

GTM Strategy and Product Marketing 

  • Own the end-to-end GTM narrative and sales planning strategy for the Brand Business across North America, APAC, and EMEA. 
  • Develop differentiated positioning, messaging, value propositions, audience narratives, and customer-centric solution frameworks. 
  • Partner closely with Product Marketing and Product teams to translate platform capabilities and launches into clear market-facing stories and sales readiness programs. 
  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and advertiser needs to identify market gaps and evolving opportunities. 
  • Create and maintain messaging frameworks, persona-based narratives, use-case playbooks, and proof points that support the full sales cycle. 
  • Champion the Brand Business narrative internally and externally, ensuring consistency across regions, channels, and customer touchpoints. 

Sales Planning and Strategic Solutioning 

  • Lead the development of complex RFP responses, proposals, media strategies, and executive presentations for strategic opportunities. 
  • Translate advertiser objectives and campaign briefs into differentiated media recommendations and sophisticated client solutioning frameworks. 
  • Develop proactive GTM materials including vertical narratives, industry playbooks, tentpole collateral, one-pagers, case studies, competitive battlecards, and solution briefs. 
  • Connect insights from BI, Trading, Supply, Product, and Deal Desk into a unified and persuasive customer story. 
  • Design visually compelling, story-driven presentations for customers, agencies, Sales teams, and leadership audiences. 
  • Establish best practices and quality standards for all customer-facing deliverables across the Sales Planning team. 

Sales Enablement 

  • Build scalable sales enablement programs that improve seller productivity, solution confidence, and win rates. 
  • Equip Sales teams with best-in-class market insights, competitive intelligence, messaging frameworks, customer stories, and objection-handling tools. 
  • Partner with regional Sales leaders to identify enablement gaps and proactively develop solutions aligned to revenue priorities. 
  • Work with centralized Marketing execution teams to bring GTM strategies to life through vertical narratives, tentpole collateral, case studies, demand and supply collateral, and industry events. 

AI Transformation 

  • Lead the adoption of AI across the Sales Planning function and define an AI-first operating model for the team. 
  • Build scalable AI workflows that automate research, proposal generation, content development, presentation creation, and knowledge reuse. 
  • Develop prompt libraries, AI playbooks, and reusable frameworks that improve quality, consistency, and productivity. 
  • Evaluate and deploy tools such as Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Gamma, Canva AI, and other emerging platforms. 
  • Coach the broader Sales Planning and Sales organization on prompt engineering, responsible AI use, and high-impact business applications. 

Cross-Functional Leadership and Team Development 

  • Act as the central hub connecting Sales, Product Marketing, Product, BI, Trading, Supply, Deal Desk, and centralized Marketing teams.

  • Lead strategic initiatives from concept through execution, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery with measurable business outcomes. 
  • Mentor and coach Sales Planning professionals in storytelling, PMM fundamentals, client solutioning, AI adoption, and executive communication. 
  • Establish scalable processes, templates, operating rhythms, and measurement frameworks across the function. 
  • Balance long-term strategic planning with hands-on involvement in high-priority customer opportunities.

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Strategic Presales, Sales Enablement, GTM, Partner Marketing, or Agency Strategy roles within AdTech, MarTech, Digital Advertising, or related industries. 
  • Strong Product Marketing skill set with demonstrated ownership of messaging, positioning, GTM strategy, product launches, market intelligence, and sales enablement. 
  • Deep understanding of digital advertising, brand marketing, media planning, advertiser and agency needs, and the broader AdTech ecosystem. 
  • Experience working with global Sales organizations and cross-functional teams across multiple regions. 

Product Marketing, Storytelling, and Content 

  • Exceptional storytelling ability, with a strong command of narrative development, messaging frameworks, and customer-centric positioning. 
  • Proven ability to create GTM strategies, product launch narratives, vertical stories, use-case frameworks, and sales enablement programs.

  • Advanced presentation design skills, with a strong focus on visual storytelling, structure, clarity, and executive impact.

Process re-engineering

  • Consumer brands: Glance, an intelligent shopping agent, and 1Weather, a hyperlocal weather application.
  • Enterprise platforms: InMobi Advertising, which provides media buyers and owners with the tools, data, and expertise to grow their business on mobile and beyond.

Each business serves its own audiences and has its own identity. At group level, InMobi is the common thread: the company, the technology, and the point of view behind them. This role owns how that group is presented and understood.

Role Overview

The Social Media Manager & Community is a global, group-level position based in Bengaluru, reporting to the Global Head of Corporate Marketing. "Group level" means the role represents the InMobi Group as a whole, rather than any single business. It is responsible for social media and community across the group's ecosystem of businesses and all regions, and for building and maintaining a single, credible group narrative.

The role is primarily B2B in focus. Its purpose is to shape how the InMobi Group is perceived by the audiences that matter most to its long-term standing: prospective talent, investors, the technology community, and industry thought leaders. Consumer-facing work from Glance and 1Weather supports this objective by demonstrating scale and innovation.

The incumbent will lead the social and community team and work across teams around the world, including leadership, engineering, product, design, talent, and regional and business marketing functions. The role carries ownership of the work from the first idea to the last outcome, including the group narrative, the growth of the group's social handles, and the team that delivers them.

  • Talent: experienced professionals, engineers, and early-career candidates considering InMobi.
  • Investors and the financial community: stakeholders who assess InMobi's strategy, leadership, and long-term potential.
  • Technology community: engineers, data scientists, and product leaders who follow the work of leading technology teams.
  • Industry thought leaders: analysts, journalists, and influential voices who shape perception of the category.

Group Strategy and Narrative

  • Define and govern the InMobi Group's brand voice across platforms and regions, ensuring consistency across its businesses and across corporate, culture, and community storytelling.
  • Develop recurring narratives that establish InMobi as a credible, AI-led technology company.
  • Set the global social media strategy and roadmap in alignment with business, talent, and brand priorities.

Platform Ownership and Growth

  • Define the role, audience, and content approach for each platform, including LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  • Establish LinkedIn as InMobi's primary global channel for thought leadership, innovation, leadership visibility, and employer brand.
  • Build a long-form video programme covering engineering insights and leadership perspectives.
  • Maintain a credible presence around industry events and conversations.
  • Drive measurable growth in followers, reach, engagement, and community health across all handles.

Thought Leadership and Influence

  • Partner with senior leaders and subject-matter experts to build their presence in relevant industry conversations. Thought leadership needs to be built across all handles, not on a single platform.
  • Identify and develop internal voices across engineering, product, and business functions and across regions, using a defined framework for selection and support.

Community and Employee Advocacy

  • Grow Encore, InMobi's engineering community, through content, events, and thought leadership.
  • Establish structured advocacy programmes that enable employees to represent the company credibly.

Global Collaboration

  • Work with regional, business, talent, and engineering teams across the world to maintain a consistent group presence while reflecting local relevance.
  • Coordinate content, campaigns, and events across time zones and markets.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of content creators, designers, and video storytellers.
  • Set priorities, workflows, and quality standards for the team.
  • Manage agency and creator partnerships.

Innovation and Experimentation

  • Evaluate and pilot new formats, platforms, creator collaborations, and AI-enabled tools.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define KPIs across reach, engagement, community growth, brand sentiment, and employer brand impact.
  • Use analytics and social listening to refine strategy and report to senior leadership.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in social media, content, or brand communications within technology, media, or high-growth environments, including at least 3 years in a team leadership role.
  • Strong B2B experience, preferably in technology, SaaS, adtech, or martech, with a record of building influence among professional and technical audiences.

  • Excellent writing and editorial skills, with a clear, intelligent, and credible voice.
  • Experience in video and visual storytelling.
  • Experience working with stakeholders across regions and time zones, including senior leadership.
  • Strategic thinking combined with strong execution.
  • Experience managing agencies and creators.
  • Curiosity, courage, initiative, and accountability: the ability to act without waiting for perfect conditions and to learn quickly when an attempt does not succeed.

InMobi is suited to builders and challengers who are comfortable with ambiguity and who prefer to draw the map rather than wait for one.

The InMobi Group

The InMobi Group is the umbrella under which this ecosystem of businesses comes together. It spans:

  • Enterprise platforms: InMobi Advertising, which provides media buyers and owners with the tools, data, and expertise to grow their business on mobile and beyond.

Each business serves its own audiences and has its own identity. At group level, InMobi is the common thread: the company, the technology, and the point of view behind them. This role helps shape how that group is presented and understood.

Role Overview

The Manager, Thought Leadership & Corporate Voice is a group-level position based in Bengaluru, reporting to the Global Head of Corporate Marketing. “Group level” means the role represents the InMobi Group as a whole, rather than any single business. The incumbent is responsible for building and running the group’s thought leadership programme: the ideas, point of view, and voices through which InMobi takes part in the conversations that matter to its category.

The role is primarily B2B in focus. The incumbent’s purpose is to shape how the InMobi Group is perceived by the audiences that matter most to its long-term standing: prospective talent, investors, the technology community, and industry thought leaders.

The incumbent will work closely with the entire Corporate Marketing team and the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams, and across teams around the world, including engineering, product, design, talent, finance, and regional marketing functions. The incumbent owns the work from the first idea to the last outcome, including the point of view, the content that carries it, and the platforms that give it reach.

  • Talent: experienced professionals, engineers, and early-career candidates considering InMobi.
  • Investors and the financial community: stakeholders who assess InMobi’s strategy, leadership, and long-term potential.

  • Industry thought leaders: analysts, journalists, and influential voices who shape perception of the category.

Point of View and Corporate Voice

  • Define InMobi’s point of view on the topics that matter to its category, aligned to the group narrative and to business, talent, and brand priorities.
  • Maintain a consistent corporate voice across articles, talks, interviews, and social channels, across businesses and regions.
  • Build a thought leadership calendar that ties content and appearances to business milestones, industry moments, and corporate events.

Thought Leadership Content

  • Write and edit bylined articles, opinion pieces, talk narratives, perspectives, and long-form content in a clear, intelligent, and credible voice.
  • Turn expertise from across the business into publishable ideas, with briefs, outlines, and editorial support for contributors.
  • Work with the content and design teams to produce video, research-led pieces, and long-form formats.

Speaking, Media, and Industry Presence

  • Identify and secure speaking slots, panels, podcasts, interviews, and awards that build InMobi’s presence with priority audiences.
  • Work with PR and analyst relations partners to place InMobi’s perspectives in relevant media and industry conversations.
  • Support participants with briefs, narratives, and preparation for each appearance, and follow through on what it earns.

  • Define KPIs across reach, media and speaking outcomes, audience engagement, and brand sentiment.

  • Excellent writing and editorial skills, with a clear, intelligent, and credible voice, including long-form writing.
  • Experience with media, analyst, and industry engagement, and with managing PR agencies.
  • Experience in video and visual storytelling.
  • Experience working with stakeholders across regions and time zones, including senior stakeholders.
  • Sound judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • Strategic thinking combined with strong execution.
  • Curiosity, courage, initiative, and accountability: the ability to act without waiting for perfect conditions and to learn quickly when an attempt does not succeed.

InMobi is suited to builders and challengers who are comfortable with ambiguity and who prefer to draw the map rather than wait for one.

  • Coordinate with creative, content, communications, sales, product, and other internal teams to ensure event assets and messaging are produced accurately and on time
  • Provide onsite event support when required, including vendor coordination, setup, registration, troubleshooting, and other executional needs
  • Support post-event wrap-up, including vendor closeout, invoice reconciliation, internal debriefs, ROI, and documentation of learnings and next steps

  • Own the end-to-end vendor onboarding process, collecting required documentation, submitting onboarding requests, and ensuring new vendors are set up in company systems before work begins
  • Manage the full contract lifecycle for marketing vendors and partners: initiating requests, routing for review and approvals, tracking signatures, and maintaining a central contracts log
  • Process invoices and expense reports accurately and on time, ensuring vendors are paid according to agreed terms
  • Liaise with Finance and Legal to resolve onboarding or payment issues and keep projects moving
  • Maintain organized records of all vendor agreements, POs, and payment history

  • Provide project coordination and operational support for cross-functional marketing initiatives in close collaboration with peers and marketing management
  • Maintain standard marketing calendars, repositories, project trackers, documentation, templates, and shared resources
  • Identify recurring administrative friction and suggest ways to simplify, automate, and standardize processes
  • Coordinate inputs and deliverables across marketing teams and other internal stakeholders
  • Support marketing budget administration and help maintain accurate records of planned, committed, and actual spend
  • Assist with agency and vendor administration across the broader marketing organization
  • Support onboarding of new marketing vendors, tools, or services from an operational perspective
  • Provide ad hoc operational and project support to the marketing organization as priorities evolve

  • Demonstrated experience managing vendor relationships, contracts, and invoicing processes
  • Strong project management skills; you track the details, own the follow-up, and don't need to be reminded twice
  • Comfortable working across time zones and coordinating with global teams
  • Highly organized and accountable with a low tolerance for things falling through the cracks
  • Clear, professional spoken and written communication; you can lead a call, demonstrate a product, draft a vendor email, or fire off a sharp WhatsApp update with equal ease
  • Proficiency with project management tools (Asana, Workfront, Monday, or similar) and event management tools (Splash, Cvent, Luma, Eventbrite, or similar), as well as Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
  • Desire and ability to travel up to 50% of the time, both domestic and international

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with procurement, legal routing, or finance systems (Coupa, SAP Concur, DocuSign, Ramp, Oracle Fusion, or similar)

About the Role:

We’re looking for a high-performing SDE-III with deep backend engineering expertise and strong foundations in data engineering that power the SSP Exchange team – a next-generation, AI-powered engineering platform working towards transforming ourselves into an Omni channel exchange .. You’ll be part of a cross-functional team responsible for designing and delivering mission-critical systems with high performance, reliability, and scale.As part of the engineering team, you will work at the intersection of AI, large-scale systems, and ad tech—developing intelligent experiences that simplify and automate the digital advertising lifecycle.

Who are we and What do we do? 

InMobi is a global provider of enterprise platform for marketers. Our platforms help Marketers reach nearly 1.56 billion unique users through mobile to help them engage, acquire, re-engage, re-market and retain valuable users. InMobi is also India’s first unicorn and one of the only profitable global tech-product companies to emerge out of India. 

 At 20+ offices across the globe, InMobi employs over 1000 personnel constituting 25 nationalities. Acclaimed for its culture, InMobi has consecutively featured on the Great Places to Work (GPTW) list, with a consistent hold in the Top 50 position for the past two years. Moreover, these accolades are not just restricted to India, InMobi has also secured a ranking on the GPTW’s 2017 China List, a notable feat for an Indian startup. 

 InMobi has also regularly featured on world disruptor lists – MIT Technology Review’s 2013 50 Disruptive Companies; Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies for 2016, 2018; CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list of 2018, here InMobi was selected amongst a pool of more than 980 forward-thinking and ambitiou private companies across the globe, we now share this space with the likes of SpaceX, Airbnb, Uber and so on. 

  

What’s the InMobi family like? 

 We are an infectious bunch. Be it the way we rise up to challenges, the cutting edge products we create, the dreams we chase or the fun we have at work. We are sure that if you meet us, you will be infected too. Today, we are proud to be the leaders in Mobile advertising and are on an accelerated path of being a leader in enterprise software for marketers. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion. We are here today because a few of us did just that. 
 

What can we promise? 

We offer you an opportunity to work on building enterprise platforms that require you to acquire, hone and demonstrate your engineering skills in designing and solving for complex problems, thereby creating software that creates value for our customers in a very reliable, scalable, secure and AI-first manner. At InMobi, you get to work on cutting-edge technologies, work closely with business teams and grow as an overall technology leader. 

Modern work environment, flexible schedule and smart, creative, down-to-earth people. Internal opportunities to move roles and try out bridge assignments with different teams.  Food for your soul – free meals all days of the week, gym or Yoga class to flex those biceps, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work. 

What is the team like?

 
InMobi's Supply and Monetization Platform is one of the world's leading ad serving platforms serving 260bn ad requests a day and handling 2.5+ billion users. Our products help advertisers serve ads optimally, optimize relevance of ads to make the advertiser maximize his ROI, and monitor progress of different advertising campaigns. We handle 7M qps peak traffic for serving ads in milliseconds and manage 2 petabyte-scale data to match the pace of advertising


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop large-scale backend services, APIs, and microservices for high-throughput data systems.

  • Build and maintain real-time and batch data pipelines using technologies like Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, etc.

  • Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, data analysts and engineers to translate complex requirements into scalable solutions.

  • Optimize performance and reliability of distributed systems; ensure low-latency data ingestion and processing.

  • Champion code quality, performance, and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, containerization, observability, fault tolerance) and mentor juniors

  • Drive architectural decisions, lead technical discussions, and contribute to platform roadmap.

Qualifications:

  • 5–8 years of backend engineering experience, preferably in large-scale, high-traffic environments.

  • Strong programming skills in Java, Scala, or Go; familiarity with Python for data use cases is a plus.

  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and concurrency.

  • Experience with modern data infrastructure (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow,Databricks , Presto, ClickHouse).

  • Exposure to cloud-native architecture (GCP/Azure) and containerization (Kubernetes, Docker).

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a bias for action and ownership.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in AdTech, Martech, or E-Commerce domains.

  • Exposure to ML model lifecycle: training, serving, monitoring, and feedback loops.

  • Prior experience with AI-powered UX: conversational UI, suggestion engines, or personalization.

  • Agentic development (e.g., Cursor, LangChain, Windsurf) and building agents for business impact and dev productivity

Overview of the Role:

The Senior Account Manager is part of the Direct & Programmatic Demand team, embedded within a revenue pod alongside a dedicated Sales Manager, and working closely with agencies and advertisers across the Americas. Reporting to the VP, Ad Sales, this role will own new customer onboarding, delivering success for their campaigns and new upsell/cross-sell opportunities — while leading internal coordination with sales planning, operations, creative solutions, insights, measurement partnerships, supply partnerships, and tech teams.

Client-facing and regionally embedded, the Lead AM is a primary point of contact for the agency, owns the health of the account post-sale, and is directly responsible for identifying and closing upsell opportunities — that build on the success of the campaigns they run.

Location: This role is open to candidates based in Chicago, IL. Some travel may be required for client meetings and events as needed. 

The Impact You'll Make: 

  • Onboard new advertiser customers in your Revenue pod onto InMobi and Glance ad systems and infrastructure
  • Own the end-to-end delivery and KPI optimization of every deal sold by Sales Manager partners — coordinating research, creative, attribution, ad operations, and any other specialist teams required to execute what was sold.
  • Act as the client's day-to-day point of contact post-sale, managing quarterly account retention and growth plans, revenue and margin management, and overall account health.
  • Own upsell and cross-sell goals for your managed accounts — and track all upsell activities in Salesforce.
  • Partner with your Sales Managers to co-own the account's long-term strategy, bringing proactive, data-driven recommendations and account intelligence that support the pod's overall revenue growth targets.
  • Lead campaign analysis and reviews; provide consultative guidance to clients in weekly or bi-weekly check-ins and quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
  • Manage the full solution lifecycle for campaigns individually and across partner teams — pre-sale media planning support, client onboarding, campaign delivery, in-flight optimization, and post-campaign reporting and deliverables.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, revenue strategy, technical account management (TAM), product marketing, ad operations, creative, insights, agency development, and demand partner teams to ensure successful execution and fast resolution of client issues.
  • Work with Technical Account Management and Ops teams to troubleshoot campaign issues, and liaise directly with third-party partners such as DSPs, DMPs, and measurement vendors.
  • Escalate at-risk accounts early — pacing issues, unresolved service problems, or stakeholder changes at the client  
  • Prioritize your week around what each account in your book needs — a renewal conversation, a QBR, resolving a client issue 
  • Surface marketplace feedback and client insights to inform InMobi's broader product and go-to-market strategy 

 How You're Measured:

This role is goaled on two connected outcomes: 

  • Pod revenue growth — shared accountability with your Sales Manager partners for the overall revenue performance of the accounts in your pod
  • Individual revenue contribution — a dedicated, separately tracked upsell target generated from the deals you manage, logged and measured in Salesforce

The Experience We Need:

  • 8+ years of overall client success or account management experience, including at least 4 years in digital and/or programmatic advertising.
  • A proven track record of owning post-sale account health and driving measurable retention and growth within existing client accounts, including experience carrying or contributing to an upsell/renewal target.
  • Strong ownership instincts and proactive communication — comfortable operating as one half of a tight, paired pod (AM + Seller) rather than managing an undifferentiated account list.
  • Strong account management and client success experience, including managing complex agency and brand relationships and co-owning account strategy with a sales partner
  • Hands-on experience with major DSPs and platforms such as The Trade Desk (TTD), DV360, and Amazon DSP is a strong plus 
  • Demonstrated success partnering with cross-functional teams (Sales, Ad Ops, Creative, Insights, Product) and building trusted relationships internally 
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and analytics/BI tools  
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable interpreting campaign data to identify performance trends, risks, and upsell opportunities, and translating them into clear client recommendations  
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple clients, campaigns, and stakeholders simultaneously, and to reprioritize quickly as account needs shift  
  • Willingness and flexibility to work with global teams across several time zones  
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

 Why InMobi?

You'll be part of a global team shaping the future of the open internet's advertising ecosystem — with visible impact, a supportive and ambitious peer group, and continuous investment in your growth. InMobi offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture built on ownership, curiosity, and results.

At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…

  • Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks 

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location. 

The base salary (fixed salary) for this role ranges from $140,500 to $175,000 USD (minimum to maximum base salary). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*. In addition, an InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.

*Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the role in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of ESOPs (Employee Stock Option Plan). We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stock to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company’s best interests. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.

A quick snapshot of our U.S. benefits:

  • Competitive salary and ESOP grant (where applicable)        
  • High-quality medical, dental, and vision insurance (including company-matched HSA)       
  • 401(k) company match 
  • Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays   
  • Substantial maternity and paternity leave benefits and compassionate work environment 
  • Flexible working hours to suit everyone 
  • Wellness stipend for a healthier you!      
  • Free lunch is provided in our offices daily   
  • Pet-friendly work environment and robust pet insurance policy - because we love our animals! 
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)   

If this sounds like the kind of team, role, values, benefits, and challenges that excite you, we’d love to hear from you. Go for it!

InMobi is a place where everyone can grow. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to work.

We are looking for a hands-on Salesforce Administrator to join our Revenue Operations team. In this role, you will own the day-to-day configuration, support, and continuous improvement of our Salesforce instance. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to scale processes, eliminate technical debt, and unlock operational productivity.

As our go-to expert for declarative development, you will solve complex business problems through clean configuration, robust automation, and strict data hygiene, while collaborating with developers and architects on advanced initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration and Security

  • Access Control: Manage users, profiles, roles, permission sets/groups, public groups, queues, and sharing rules.
  • Security Architecture: Maintain Org-Wide Defaults (OWD), record-level security, and field-level security (FLS).
  • Core CRM Maintenance: Administer Sales/Service Cloud components including standard/custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, and validation rules.
  • UI Customization: Manage Lightning App Builder, Lightning record pages, and dynamic forms.
  • Org Health: Monitor storage limits, login history, and security health checks.

Automation and Configuration

  • Advanced Flow Builder: Design, build, and optimize screen flows, record-triggered flows, scheduled flows, and autolaunched flows.
  • Legacy Migration: Lead the migration of legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builders to high-performing Flows.
  • Business Logic: Configure approval processes, email alerts, custom notifications, assignment rules, complex formulas, and roll-up summaries.

Reporting, Analytics and Data Management

  • Operational Insights: Build and maintain high-impact reports, dashboards, custom report types, and list views for leadership and cross-functional Ops teams.
  • Data Hygiene: Perform mass data operations (imports, updates, deletions) using Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, and Workbench.
  • Data Governance: Lead deduplication efforts, validation rules enforcement, and ongoing data quality audits.

Release Management and Stakeholder Support

  • Environment Strategy: Manage sandbox refreshes, staging environments, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Deployment Execution: Deploy changes via Change Sets or modern deployment tooling.
  • L2 Support: Triage and resolve tier-2 platform support tickets within defined SLAs.
  • Enablement and Docs: Conduct end-user training, build SOPs in Confluence, and translate business requirements into technical documentation.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Experience: 3–4 years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience within a mid-to-large scale instance.
  • Core Cloud Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud (Service Cloud is a plus).
  • Flow Expertise: Advanced proficiency with Flow Builder, including deep debugging and optimization skills.
  • Data and Security Tooling: Mastery of the Salesforce security model and hands-on experience with Data Loaderand bulk data operations.
  • Analytics Capabilities: Strong reporting skills, including matrix/joined reports, custom report types, and bucket fields.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to translate technical configurations into clear business value.

Required Certifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM 201)

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

Advanced Certifications and Technical Skills

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder certification.
  • Exposure to Salesforce CPQ, Billing, or Revenue Cloud.
  • Read-level proficiency with Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC); basic knowledge of SOQL/SOSL.
  • Familiarity with AppExchange packages (e.g., DocuSign, LeanData, Gong, Outreach, DemandTools).

Domain and Methodology Experience

  • Ad Tech Industry Expertise: Familiarity with programmatic advertising concepts (DSP/SSP, ad exchanges), IO-to-cash workflows, advertiser/publisher account structures, and digital advertising billing models.
  • Agentforce / AI Innovation: Hands-on exposure or a strong technical interest in Salesforce Agentforce (Agent Builder, topics, actions, prompt templates) and AI-driven autonomous agents.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum frameworks using Jira and Confluence.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Short-form & Social Content

  • Work confidently with After Effects for animation and motion design.

  • Handle basic thumbnail and supporting visual design when required.

Event & Fast-Turnaround Content

  • Consumer brands: Glance, an intelligent shopping agent, and 1Weather, a hyperlocal weather application.
  • Enterprise platforms: InMobi Advertising, which provides media buyers and owners with the tools, data, and expertise to grow their business on mobile and beyond.

What is the role about?

The Senior Manager, Corporate Marketing is a group-level position based in Bengaluru, reporting to the Global Head of Corporate Marketing. “Group level” means the role represents the InMobi Group as a whole, rather than any single business. The incumbent is responsible for turning the group narrative into the flagship events and content through which the group is seen and heard.

The role is primarily B2B in focus. The incumbent’s purpose is to shape how the InMobi Group is perceived by the audiences that matter most to its long-term standing: prospective talent, investors, the technology community, and industry thought leaders.

The incumbent will be the senior operator in the Corporate Marketing team: a leader who plans, builds, and delivers. The role works closely with the entire Corporate Marketing team and with the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams, and across teams around the world, including leadership, engineering, product, design, talent, finance, and regional marketing functions. The incumbent owns the work from the first idea to the last outcome, including the flagship events that carry the group narrative and the content and creative that bring it to life.

  • Talent: experienced professionals, engineers, and early-career candidates considering InMobi.
  • Investors and the financial community: stakeholders who assess InMobi’s strategy, leadership, and long-term potential.
  • Technology community: engineers, data scientists, and product leaders who follow the work of leading technology teams.
  • Industry thought leaders: analysts, journalists, and influential voices who shape perception of the category.

  • Translate the group narrative into clear messaging, proof points, and content frameworks that every corporate programme draws on.
  • Ensure that events and content speak in one consistent group voice, across businesses and regions.
  • Partner with the wider Corporate Marketing team, including social media and community, so that what is said on stage, in print, and in the room is carried through consistently across channels.

Corporate Events and Flagship Platforms

  • Own the strategy, planning, and delivery of large-scale corporate events, including flagship group events, leadership forums, industry summits, and employee-facing moments.
  • Ensure each event brings the businesses together on one stage and gives audiences a single, coherent view of the group.
  • Manage event agencies, vendors, and budgets, and coordinate delivery across time zones and markets.
  • Extend the life of every event through content, social amplification, and follow-up with the audiences it was designed for.

Content and Creative

  • Set the editorial direction for corporate content, including long-form articles, leadership perspectives, thought-leadership pieces, case studies, and video.
  • Direct the writers, designers, and video producers who create corporate content, and maintain quality standards across everything published under the group name.
  • Develop reusable content assets, such as the corporate story and event collateral, that regional and business teams can adopt.

  • Act as the point of coordination for corporate marketing programmes across stakeholders, setting clear timelines, owners, and approvals.

  • Lead and develop a team of marketers, content creators, designers, and producers.
  • Set priorities, workflows, and quality standards for the programmes the team delivers.
  • Manage agency and external partnerships across events, content, creative, and production.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define KPIs across event reach and outcomes, content performance, and brand sentiment.
  • Use analytics and audience feedback to refine programmes and report to senior leadership.

  • Partner with Finance and sales leadership to translate annual and quarterly plans into clear goals for each team and region.

  • Maintain a current, working understanding of the North America Agency, Brand, and Performance business, including key strategic priorities, revenue composition, and areas of risk and opportunity.

  • Serve as the primary revenue operations partner to North America leadership.
  • Apply one consistent operating standard across every team you support (one planning cadence, one goal-setting process, one source of truth) while staying attuned to the dynamics specific to each business.
  • Represent these businesses in cross-functional forums with Finance, Product, and the broader Revenue Operations organization.

  • Proven stakeholder management experience, including direct communication with senior sales leaders across more than one region
  • Analytical rigor, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Background in the digital advertising or programmatic advertising industry
  • An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus, but not required

  • Communication: You raise concerns and flag gaps to senior stakeholders directly, with data to support your position.
  • Cross-regional depth: You build a working knowledge of the North America and EMEA markets, specific enough to defend the goals and territories set for each.
  • Process discipline: You write SOPs and follow them consistently.
  • Applied use of AI: You identify where automation and AI can increase your efficiency and apply them to your own workflow.

  • Develop strong customer relationships and a deep understanding of their business(es), strengths, and challenges to identify and drive new opportunities.
  • Meet or exceed revenue targets consistently while prioritizing and delivering outstanding customer experiences.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Demand, and Marketplace teams to coordinate supply and demand strategies and ensure partner success.

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

title: Senior Sales, InMobi Alliance - Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Overview of the Role:

InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.

You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.

This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.

This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

The Impact You'll Make: 

As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

  • Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions
  • Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies
  • Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients
  • Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team
  • Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth
  • Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking
  • Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

The Experience We Need: 

  • Industry experience. You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.
  • An advertising technology expert. You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.
  • A trusted advisor and consultant. You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.
  • A high-energy, passionate self-starter. You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment.
  • Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller. You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action.
  • A proactive problem solver. You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Eager, curious, and a fast learner. You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle.
  • Education. A BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline is required, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
  • Language. Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. 

At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who:

  • Think big and act fast — we're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work — we care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes — we take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability — we value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay equity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

Salary Range (Germany):

The base salary or fixed pay for this role ranges from €132,500 to €167,250 (min to max of base salary). In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible to receive variable compensation in the form of an annual or quarterly performance bonus or sales incentive, as determined per InMobi policy.

Note: Our ranges may vary based on final location and region of roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country. 

Benefits:

As an InMobi employee based in Germany, you will have access to our full EMEA benefits package. Detailed benefits information is available upon request and will be outlined in full during the hiring process.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law, including the German General Equal Treatment Act (Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz — AGG).

InMobi is proud to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace. If you require an accommodation, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword — it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

Data Privacy Notice (GDPR)

In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection law (Bundesdatenschutzgesetz — BDSG), InMobi collects and processes your personal data solely for the purpose of evaluating your application for this role.

Your data will be retained for the duration of the recruitment process and, where applicable, for a period thereafter in accordance with statutory retention obligations. Your data will not be shared with third parties outside of the recruitment process without your explicit consent.

You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time. To exercise your rights or for any data privacy enquiries, please contact: privacy@inmobi.com

By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and understood this data privacy notice and consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes.

— DEUTSCHE FASSUNG —

InMobi Advertising ist ein weltweit führendes Technologieunternehmen, das Marketingfachleuten hilft, die entscheidenden Momente zu gewinnen. Unsere Werbeplattform erreicht über 2 Milliarden Menschen in mehr als 150 Ländern und wandelt Echtzeitkontext in messbare Geschäftsergebnisse um – auf Basis datenschutzfreundlicher Grundsätze. InMobi genießt das Vertrauen von über 30.000 Marken und führenden Publishern und vereint Intelligenz, Kreativität und Verantwortlichkeit. Durch die Kombination von Sperrbildschirmen, Apps, Fernsehgeräten und dem offenen Web mit KI und maschinellem Lernen bieten wir aufmerksamkeitsstarke Werbeplatzierungen, präzise Personalisierung und messbare Wirkung.

Mit Glance AI gestalten wir die Zukunft des KI-gestützten Commerce neu und revolutionieren das E-Commerce-Erlebnis durch inspirationsgeleitete Entdeckung und Shopping. Glance AI ist darauf ausgelegt, sich nahtlos in alltägliche Verbrauchertechnologie zu integrieren und jeden Bildschirm in ein Tor für sofortige, persönliche und freudvolle Entdeckungen zu verwandeln. Glance AI bietet zutiefst personalisierte Einkaufserlebnisse in Bereichen wie Mode, Beauty, Reisen, Accessoires, Wohnen, Haustiere und mehr.

InMobi wurde als Great Place to Work ausgezeichnet und von MIT Technology Review sowie Fast Company zu den Top 10 Innovatoren gezählt. Mit Investoren wie SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins und Sherpalo Ventures unterhält InMobi Büros in San Mateo, New York, London, Singapur, Tokio, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru und weiteren Standorten weltweit.

Besuchen Sie www.inmobi.com, um mehr zu erfahren.

Über die Stelle:

InMobi sucht eine/n leidenschaftliche/n, ambitionierte/n und ergebnisorientierte/n Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, der/die die Neukundengewinnung für das App Performance Solutions-Team von InMobi in der DACH-Region und dem gesamten EMEA-Markt vorantreibt. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Identifikation, Ansprache und den Abschluss hochwertiger Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mit einigen der größten Marken in Nicht-Gaming-Verticals.

Sie werden Teil eines leistungsstarken Teams aus EMEA-Vertrieb, Client Growth und Media Buying unter App Performance Solutions, das Sie in Ihrem Wachstum und Erfolg im InMobi-Ökosystem aktiv unterstützt. Dies ist eine aufregende Möglichkeit, sichtbaren Einfluss in der EMEA-Region zu erzielen – für ein wachstumsstarkes Geschäftsfeld, das einen KI/ML-gestützten DSP, Owned-and-Operated Glance TV und Performance CTV umfasst.

Diese Stelle richtet sich an echte Hunter – Menschen, die Pipeline aus dem Nichts aufbauen, Türen öffnen, die andere nicht öffnen können, und aus kalten Erstkontakten langfristige Umsatzpartnerschaften entwickeln.

Diese Stelle ist eine vollständig remote ausgeübte Position mit Sitz in Deutschland. Fließende Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch sind erforderlich. Gelegentliche Reisetätigkeit für Kundenmeetings, Branchenveranstaltungen und persönliche Team-Meetings wird erwartet.

Ihre Aufgaben:

Als Senior Sales Manager, EMEA sind Sie verantwortlich für den Aufbau und die Entwicklung eines Portfolios aus Direktmarken und Performance-Agenturen in der DACH-Region durch den Verkauf effektiver App Performance Solutions. Darüber hinaus gestalten Sie aktiv die Vertriebsstrategie, den Go-to-Market-Ansatz und den Ausführungsplan von InMobi für Ihre Schlüsselregion innerhalb von EMEA mit.

  • Identifikation, Akquise, Beratung und Entwicklung neuer Beziehungen zu strategisch relevanten Marken, Agenturen und Partnern zur Sicherung des langfristigen Wachstums der App Performance Solutions von InMobi
  • Nutzung Ihrer Marktkenntnis und der einzigartigen Wettbewerbsvorteile von InMobi zur Entwicklung neuer und nachhaltiger Geschäftsbeziehungen mit Werbetreibenden – einschließlich der Navigation in programmatischen und Walled-Garden-Ökosystemen
  • Pflege von Beziehungen zu Ökosystem-Influencern, MMPs, Agenturen und Partnern, um InMobi bei deren Kunden stets präsent zu halten
  • Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Lifecycle – von der Outbound-Prospektion und Inbound-Lead-Qualifizierung über die Angebotserstellung, Nurturing und Aktivierung bis hin zur strategischen Wachstumsberatung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams aus Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships und Product für ein reibungsloses Onboarding und die Übergabe an das Growth-Team
  • Repräsentation von InMobi App Performance Solutions bei wichtigen Branchenveranstaltungen, Konferenzen und Networking-Events in der gesamten EMEA-Region
  • Diszipliniertes Pipeline-Management unter Nutzung von CRM-Tools für präzise Prognosen und Performance-Tracking
  • Kontinuierliches Übertreffen der vierteljährlichen Umsatzziele durch strategische Neukundengewinnung und starkes Beziehungsmanagement

Ihr Profil:

  • Branchenerfahrung. Sie verfügen über 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Hunting und Selling an App-Unternehmen und Performance-Agenturen. Sie kennen deren Herausforderungen und sind bekannt dafür, Umsatz aufzubauen – nicht nur Bestandsgeschäfte zu verwalten, sondern neue zu schaffen.
  • Advertising Technology Expertise. Sie haben mindestens 6+ Jahre Erfahrung im Ad Tech und kennen das EMEA-Ökosystem sehr gut. Erfahrung bei einem führenden Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP oder einem anderen Online-Werbunternehmen ist erforderlich.
  • Vertrauenswürdiger Berater. Sie verfügen über authentische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, schnell konsultative, glaubwürdige und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen. In einem Markt voller Anbieter denken Ihre Kunden zuerst an Sie – nicht weil Sie verkauft haben, sondern weil Sie Probleme gelöst haben.
  • Hochenergetische/r, leidenschaftliche/r Self-Starter. Sie sind von Natur aus hochmotiviert, Ehrgeiz liegt in Ihrer DNA, und Sie fühlen sich in einem schnelllebigen, risikofreudigen und oft mehrdeutigen Umfeld sehr wohl.
  • Analytische Stärke und überzeugendes Storytelling. Sie verfügen über starke analytische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, versteckte Chancen zu erkennen und daraus überzeugende Narrative zu entwickeln, die Kunden zum Handeln bewegen.
  • Proaktive/r Problemlöser/in. Sie haben nachgewiesene Fähigkeiten, Kundenschmerzpunkte und technische Herausforderungen zu lösen und durch funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit Lösungen zu entwickeln.
  • Wissbegierig und lernbereit. Sie sind von Natur aus neugierig, handeln proaktiv und suchen aktiv nach Wegen, Ihre Kollegen zu unterstützen. Die Ad-Tech-Landschaft verändert sich ständig – Signal-Verlust, KI-Disruption, verändertes Käuferverhalten – und Sie engagieren sich aktiv statt abzuwarten.
  • Ausbildung. Ein Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in einem relevanten Fachbereich ist erforderlich, oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung. Ein MBA oder ein weiterführender Masterabschluss ist von Vorteil.
  • Sprachen. Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch sind zwingend erforderlich.

Bei InMobi sind Sie umgeben von Menschen, die:

  • Groß denken und schnell handeln — wir sind unternehmerisch, gedeihen in Mehrdeutigkeit und lösen gerne wirkungsvolle Probleme
  • Leidenschaftlich sind und enormen Stolz auf ihre Arbeit legen — wir kümmern uns tief um die Wirkung, die wir erzielen
  • Ihre Ergebnisse verantworten — wir übernehmen Verantwortung, treffen mutige Entscheidungen und handeln mit Überzeugung
  • Freiheit mit Verantwortung verbinden — wir schätzen Autonomie und verstehen, dass Vertrauen mit Verantwortung einhergeht
  • An lebenslanges Lernen glauben — wir begrüßen Feedback, fordern uns selbst heraus und scheuen keine klugen Risiken

Vergütung & Benefits

Unsere Vergütungsphilosophie ermöglicht es uns, wettbewerbsfähige Gehälter anzubieten, die Hochleistung fördern und gleichzeitig Geschäftsanforderungen sowie Lohngleichheit berücksichtigen. Die Vergütung wird auf Basis einer Vielzahl von Faktoren bestimmt, darunter die Rolle, die Art der Erfahrung, Fähigkeiten und der Standort.

Microsoft and InMobi have entered into a strategic partnership. As per this, InMobi Advertising will be the exclusive partner for Microsoft Advertising's search & display inventory. Microsoft Search Advertising empowers the largest advertisers around the world to reach their maximum potential through paid search engine marketing on the Microsoft Bing Ads platform. InMobi will be responsible for complete business management/transaction across Microsoft Advertising. 

As a Regional Lead in South Africa you are expected to drive new client acquisition and grow incremental revenue against a targeted list of high potential agencies and advertisers through continuous engagement. You are expected to continually build and maintain a pipeline of clients and agencies to be onboarded to the Microsoft Advertising platform. Collaborate with internal Account Managers and Strategy teams to develop quality customer plans targeted at revenue growth and customer satisfaction. Cultivating strategic client relationships, revenue generation and delivering customized search solutions will be key to your core function. Your success will be measured by specific key performance indicators focused on driving new customer acquisition, product adoption, emphasizing customer experience and optimizing opportunities.

In the first quarter:

  • Understand the Microsoft Advertising Ecosystem in South Africa and collaborate with internal stakeholders.
  • Leverage your current relationships in the advertising ecosystem to drive revenue conversations as well as open up new relationships in the industry
  • You will be expected to build a healthy predictable pipeline of clients to initiate and successfully close partnership and onboarding discussions.
  • Consistently create high value revenue-generating opportunities that will work towards delivering quota expectations.
  • Lead regular, impactful engagements with key clients.
  • Coordinate with the required teams to help achieve targets.

  • Master and grow the activities initiated in the first quarter
  • Grow Bing’s share of wallet by continuing to onboard new clients and agencies
  • Strengthen relationships with key client and agency stakeholders like (budget decision makers, media planners and senior leadership)
  • Collaborate with internal account managers and client poc's to ensure opportunities are leveraged effectively
  • Continually strengthen your Search Industry expertise, take personal accountability for your career and personal development;
  • Complete required and recommended trainings and apply what you learn to further your growth in role and career progression

  • 12 years of work experience with 5+ years of online media sales/digital advertising experience
  • Strong network of clientele in the South African marketplace, specifically Johannesburg and an understanding of the key digital players (Brands, agencies etc.)
  • Experience and ability to build a client base from scratch.
  • Experience in lead generation, networking, and ad-agency relationship management.
  • Experienced Digital media solution seller and talented in storytelling and delivering engaging presentations across all levels of leadership
  • Ability to handle and manage key/strategic client relationships and revenue
  • Ensure a strong metrics focused approach is applied in business planning and execution
  • Proven ability to understand customer needs, create and deliver customized, customer-focused pitches and solutions
  • Proven track record of exceptional performance, high productivity, communications skills, and meeting deadlines. Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed revenue goals or targets
  • Passion for technology as an enabler for company growth
  • Effectively navigate through ambiguity and complexities related to client management
  • Practice freedom with responsibility, entrepreneurial mindset and thought leadership.
  • Possess excellent communication skills providing transparency and enabling information radiators
  • Travel to meet and strengthen partnerships with new and existing clients.

Preferred:

  • Search Engine Marketing Experience
  • Understanding of the Digital Ecosystem
  • Ad Sales Experience

Johannesburg

Together with your paired Account Manager, you'll co-own your pod's long-term account strategy, one relationship, one pipeline, one shared goal of sustained growth. 

Location: We welcome applicants based in either San Mateo, CA (SF/Bay Area) or Los Angeles, CA for this role

  • Serve as the face of InMobi to independent agencies and advertiser in-house teams in the West region: build genuine relationships through consistent presence, entertainment, and strategic engagement that goes beyond the transaction  
  • Maintain accurate, current industry intelligence to identify book expansion opportunities
  • Drive net-new business as a core focus, primarily by hunting new agencies as well as in-house clients
  • Build, advise, and grow relationships with media account teams at agencies to ensure long-term success and adoption of InMobi's suite of products (including Glance CTV, Glance mobile, InMobi Exchange solutions). Maximize face time with clients, which will involve travel to the agency territory offices.
  • Bring a strategic point of view to every account: build territory and account plans that identify where InMobi can win, and pursue them proactively rather than reactively  
  • Lead responses to advertiser/agency RFPs, ensuring clear, consistent, and comprehensive representation of InMobi's solutions and capabilities to develop custom, differentiated proposals that win competitive RFPs
  • Partner closely with your Account Manager to co-own long-term account strategy — bringing the relationship and pipeline view, while trusting your AM's data-driven recommendations on where existing accounts have room to grow
  • Represent InMobi at industry events, upfronts, and client entertainment, strengthening InMobi's presence and reputation across the agency community
  • Maintain accurate, disciplined forecasting and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce, reflecting realistic net-new and renewal mix against the SIP plan, and keeping account intelligence (org changes, competitive risk, budget cycles) current for the POD

 How You're Measured:

This role is goaled on two connected outcomes, per the SIP planning framework: 

  • Pod revenue growth — shared accountability with your Account Manager for the overall retention, renewal, and revenue performance of the accounts in your book, tracked through year-over-year (YoY) growth across both deal-based revenue and Managed Service IOs
  • Net-new business contribution — Ability to generate net new business from new agencies and in-house teams 

The Experience We Need:

  • 8+ years of advertising sales experience, with a track record of selling into independent agencies and in-house teams across programmatic and/or managed service advertising.
  • Established, verifiable relationships with independent agencies and/or client in-house teams in the US West region, validated through the interview process.
  • A demonstrated history of exceeding revenue targets, with meaningful contributions from net-new business (new logos or new campaigns), not renewals alone.
  • Strong command of both PMP/programmatic deal structures and Managed Service IO selling, with the versatility to move fluidly between the two.
  • Natural relationship-building instincts: someone who genuinely enjoys client entertainment, agency events, and being a visible, trusted presence in the market.
  • A consultative, strategic sales style — comfortable building account plans, developing custom solutions with internal partners, and leading complex RFP processes.
  • Strong collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with Account Management, Client Solutions, Sales Planning, Marketing, and Product teams.
  • Comfort with disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in Salesforce.
  • A bias for action in fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environments, with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

You'll be part of a global team shaping the future of the open internet's advertising ecosystem — with visible impact, a supportive and ambitious peer group, and continuous investment in your growth. InMobi offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture built on ownership, curiosity, and results.

This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*. In addition, an InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.

*Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

  • Architect and scale distributed systems that interact with Salesforce for real-time data synchronization, leveraging Kafka, Spark, or similar streaming technologies.
  • Write clean, testable, and high-performance backend middleware in Java that bridges CRM and cloud services at scale.

Engineering excellence

  • Experience writing optimized SOQL/SOSL and managing large datasets within Salesforce multi-tenant environments.
  • Experience writing clean, testable backend code in Java or Python for middleware services (Apache Camel, MuleSoft) bridging CRM and external cloud services.
  • Mastery of Salesforce DX, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Copado), and AI automated testing and deployment frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce data security including Data Mask, encryption, and governance in the context of agent auditability and compliance.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems and how tools like Kafka or Spark interact with Salesforce for real-time data synchronization.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at ad-tech or high-scale B2B SaaS companies.
  • Track record of building and delivering Agentic AI solutions for enterprise systems - including sophisticated Salesforce UIs and high-performance backend services.
  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud, Order Management System (OMS), Revenue Cloud, or related platforms.
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation, agent observability tooling, or RAG pipeline design.

Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun-loving, take ownership and are results-focused. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion.

We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups.
