What will you be doing?

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Manager to build and lead the ML function for Accelerate. You will own the entire ML stack - from defining the roadmap to hiring the team to shipping models into production. This is not a role where you inherit an existing ML system; you will architect and build the foundational ML capabilities that become the platform's core competitive moat: cross-channel intelligence that autonomously optimizes marketing spend. 

You will report to the engineering leadership and work closely with product, data engineering, and the existing platform engineering team. 

What You'll Build 

Cross-Channel Budget Allocation Engine Build optimization models that allocate a brand's total marketing budget across channels to maximize aggregate ROAS. Account for channel-specific dynamics: auction mechanics, audience overlap, frequency caps, diminishing returns curves. Move from static allocation to continuous rebalancing based on real-time performance signals. 

Bid Optimization & Pacing Develop bid strategy models that work across platforms with different auction types. Build spend pacing algorithms that distribute budget optimally across time (dayparting, day-of-week, seasonality). Model the response curves (spend vs. conversions) per channel and campaign type. 

Multi-Touch Attribution Build cross-channel attribution models that go beyond last-click to understand the true incremental value of each channel and touchpoint. Design incrementality testing frameworks to validate attribution models and feed insights back into budget allocation and bid optimization. 

Performance Forecasting Predict campaign performance (impressions, clicks, conversions, ROAS) before and during campaign execution. Build anomaly detection to flag underperforming campaigns or unusual spend patterns in real-time. 

Audience Intelligence Build audience segmentation and lookalike modeling that works across channel boundaries. Identify high-value audience segments and optimize targeting recommendations based on historical cross-channel conversion data. 

Creative Performance Prediction Predict creative asset performance before launch, identify creative fatigue signals, and connect creative attributes (copy, visuals, CTA type) to performance outcomes. 

What We're Looking For 

  • 8+ years in ML/Data Science, with at least 1 year in a tech lead or management role building and shipping ML systems in production
  • Strong ML breadth with depth in at least one of: optimization algorithms, recommender systems, time-series forecasting, causal inference, reinforcement learning, or auction/marketplace ML
  • Hands-on technical leader: You can architect ML systems, review model code, and mentor engineers - not just manage roadmaps
  • Production ML experience: You've taken models from research to production, dealt with data quality issues, and understand the gap between offline metrics and business impact
  • Ads/MarTech domain experience is a strong plus: bid optimization, budget allocation, attribution, audience targeting, or media mix modeling at an ad platform, DSP, or marketing platform 

Why This Role 

  • Greenfield ML with real data: The platform already has production data flowing from major ad platforms. You're not waiting for data - you're building the intelligence layer on top of a live system
  • Clear business impact: Every model you build has a direct line to ROAS improvement for brands. The feedback loop between model and revenue is short
  • The problem is genuinely hard: Cross-channel marketing optimization is a multi-objective, partially-observable, adversarial optimization problem. The ad platforms themselves are black boxes. Building intelligence across them is an unsolved problem at the industry level
  • Full ownership: You define the ML strategy, hire the team, choose the tools, and ship the models. No inherited tech debt in the ML layer
  • Scale potential: InMobi is one of the largest independent ad-tech companies globally. Accelerate is a strategic bet with executive sponsorship 

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.

title: AM/ Manager - Risk & Decision Science
description:
About the Team

Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here’s your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit and built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys, Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of 10-100-1000 journey and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
As a Financial Services team, we always look at the bottom line. And the bottom line is - in this team, you should expect to have fun as you learn and grow.
 
About the Role
 
Lending is going to be our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale. Herein also lies potentially our biggest challenge for Meesho users: How do we assess risk of borrowers without any credit history? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
The Person will be responsible for driving the Policy, DS and analytics behind all these questions, from creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and owning policy decisions.
In the early phases, your role will focus on refining initially implemented policy by Analyzing and Designing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, alternate data. Creating Scorecards and models for approval. 
Designing experiments to test cohort behavior and experimental policies.
Automate reporting and tracking of the portfolio on multiple levels , Ops performance measures, key performance indicators and associated drivers.

title: AM/M - Risk Analytics - User Lending
description:
About the Team
Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here's your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit, built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys. Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of a 10-100-1000 journey, and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
About the Role
Meesho FS runs two lines of business: SME Lending, which offers Business Loans, and User Lending, which offers BNPL and Personal Loans (PL). 
User Lending is now our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey. We have 274Mn ATU, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale - our being a captive audience means both Growth and Risk are an outcome of underwriting, which is owned by the Risk team.
Herein also lies one of our biggest challenges: how do we assess the risk of borrowers without any credit history or income data? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
This person will be responsible for driving the analytics behind these questions for User Lending - creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and recommending policy decisions, across a well-established BNPL portfolio and a Personal Loans portfolio that is still scaling.
Your role will focus on:
Owning the risk for one or more segments of the portfolio while maintaining a healthy growth.
Analyzing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, SMS data, and other alternate data.
Creating policies, scorecards and models (Application Score, B-Score, Collection Scores) for BNPL and PL.
Designing experiments to test cohort behaviour, experimental policies, and new opportunities for growth.
Identifying pockets of risk within the portfolio that don't make sense, and identifying leading indicators / EWS.
Automating reporting and tracking of the portfolio at multiple levels - Ops performance measures, key performance indicators, and their drivers.
Refining credit policies based on data and creating new policies for unexplored segments, including building day-1 policies for Personal Loans as the product scales.
Configuring and testing rules in the real-time Business Rule Engine (BRE), and working with the Bureau Feature Store to define new underwriting features.

title: Data Scientist III (Team- Valmo)
description:
About us
Meesho - Every story here begins with a spark of ambition and a touch of entrepreneurial magic. We're not just a platform — we're your partner in transforming dreams into reality.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone - Meesho started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable small businesses to succeed online. We provide sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping costs, growing their business by tapping the company's massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics at cost through third-party logistics providers and our in-house logistics arm Valmo, in an 'Everyday Low Cost' channel for sellers.
Affordable, relatable merchandise mirroring local markets has helped us make inroads with first-time internet users in the country. We cater to an underserved and unique customer base and cover every serviceable pincode in the country. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have enabled us to become the first Indian horizontal e-commerce company.
Know more about Meesho here: https://www.meesho.io/
About Valmo and the Data Science Team
Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models.
 About the Role
As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile.

title: Director – Sales, Meesho AI Services (MAS) | North India
description:
About MAS
MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. title: Engineering Manager -Backend
description:
About Meesho 
 
Mission and Vision 
 
Meesho is India’s fastest-growing internet commerce company, driven by the mission to democratize internet commerce for everyone (DICE). Our vision is to enable 100 million small businesses and entrepreneurs in India to succeed online, making online commerce accessible to all. This core purpose guides us in empowering sellers across the country and bringing a diverse range of products to first-time internet shoppers. By leveraging technology and a unique zero commission model, Meesho has opened the doors of e-commerce to millions who were previously underserved. 
 
Technological Scale & Innovation
 
 At Meesho, technology is at the heart of our success. We have invested in a scalable infrastructure and innovative solutions to meet the demands of a vast user base and complex marketplace. Some key highlights include: 
 
Massive Scale: Our backend systems handle millions of orders per day from across India, reaching about 5% of all Indian households, all with near-zero downtime to date. Achieving this level of reliability and performance in a hyper-growth environment is a testament to our engineering excellence. 
 
 Marketplace Reach: Over 1.75 million sellers are registered on Meesho’s platform, supported by our state-of-the-art tech infrastructure and pan-India logistics network. This wide reach — covering virtually every serviceable pin code in the country — presents unique engineering challenges in areas like search, personalization, and payments at scale.
 
 Scalable Architecture: We continually innovate our architecture for growth.. Our quest to serve a billion Indian users has helped us evolve our technologies from a monolith to microservices to now a high scale federated architecture. This evolution allows us to build and deploy features rapidly while maintaining stability for a fast-growing user base. 
 
Cutting-edge Tech Stack: Our platform is built using modern, open-source technologies on the cloud while ensuring high efficiency. We strategically choose proven tools (for example, Java and Golang for services, Kafka for messaging, Dragonfly and Redis for caching, ScyllaDB, MySQL and Mongo for Data) and leverage GCP infrastructure to ensure high performance, reliability, and flexibility. By focusing on the right tools for the right problems, we innovate pragmatically rather than chasing every new tech hype, which helps us solve real-world problems effectively. 
 
Engineering Culture & Challenges 
 
Engineering at Meesho is driven by a bold and inclusive culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe that building great products goes hand-in-hand with building a great team. Key aspects of our engineering culture include: 
 
Long Term Thinking: We believe in thinking for tomorrow while building for today, this approach has helped us not only to handle and evolve for scale but also focus on extensibility and stability by investing in the platform
 
Lightspeed: We prioritize rapid iteration and delivery. Engineers are encouraged to ship fast and refine continuously, as we value in order to learn and adapt quickly. 
 
Continuous Improvement: We view failures and bugs as opportunities to improve. A blameless post-mortem culture ensures that mistakes become lessons, fostering an environment where learning from failure drives resilience and innovation.
 
 Ownership Mindset: Every engineer is empowered to act like an owner. We instill a “Founder’s Mindset,” encouraging engineers to take end-to-end ownership of projects and drive them with an entrepreneurial spirit. This means our teams proactively identify problems and champion solutions, just as a founder would for their own product. 
 
Engineering at Meesho is more than just writing code – it's about solving complex, impactful problems at an unprecedented scale. Our engineers tackle challenging use cases (from enabling real-time logistics across India to optimizing a vast product catalog for the next billion users), making a tangible impact on millions of entrepreneurs and customers. We maintain a
professional, yet passionate work environment where the drive to innovate is balanced with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. 
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for Engineering Manager well-versed with emerging technologies to join our team.
 As an Engineering Manager, you will ensure consistency and quality by shaping the right strategies. You will keep an eye on all engineering projects and ensure all duties are fulfilled . You will analyse other employees’ tasks and carry on collaborations effectively. You will also transform newbies into experts and build reports on the progress of all projects.

title: Director, Digital Experience
description:
We're looking for a Director, Digital Experience to lead how customers discover, evaluate, and engage with Freshworks through our website. You'll shape the web experience roadmap, lead designers and program managers, and partner with engineering to deliver better customer journeys and measurable business results.   You're a program manager at heart who stays close to the execution. You'll run Scrum across design and engineering, turn competing priorities into clear plans, and help the team deliver with speed and quality. You'll treat the website as a product, balancing launches and publishing needs with continuous improvements to its effectiveness.  
 
 What You'll Do  
 
 Web Experience and Roadmap    Set the web roadmap and decide what to tackle next. Use customer needs and performance data to weigh improvements, redesigns, migrations, and localized experiences.   Review designs with content and engineering partners. Make sure pages are easy to use and reflect the brand, with accessibility and conversion considered during design.   Agree on web priorities with Web Revenue, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Marketing Operations. Turn campaign and product plans into work the team can deliver.     Program Delivery and Scrum    Own request intake. Before work enters a sprint, confirm the problem, required content and assets, acceptance criteria, and the person who can approve it. Check template reuse, CMS constraints, and technical feasibility with engineering before committing.   Run sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, reviews, and retrospectives with design and engineering. Keep commitments visible, remove blockers, and follow up on changes agreed in retrospectives.   Track work through design, content development, QA, and launch. Flag dependencies or capacity problems early, explain the trade-offs, and get decisions from the right people.     Team Leadership    Manage the designers and program managers. Set goals, give regular coaching and performance feedback, and keep workloads realistic.   Stay involved in major projects and help design, engineering, and marketing resolve problems that slow delivery.     Web Operations and Continuous Improvement    Run CMS and publishing operations. Keep content models, templates, and review steps documented so people know what they can publish and who needs to approve it.   Agree on who signs off on each release and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT). Decide which issues block launch and which can follow. Check accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and tracking with engineering, then verify critical journeys on the live site.   Choose experiments with conversion and analytics partners, review the results, and then use them to decide what to do next. Track delivery time and rework alongside website performance.   Partner with design and engineering to test AI-assisted workflows that improve planning, creative exploration, and delivery.   Use automation and AI tools when they save time or reduce mistakes. Keep human review and data safeguards in place.   

  Experience owning a company website or leading web programs in enterprise B2B SaaS, including work that spans design, engineering, and marketing.   Experience managing designers and program managers, including regular coaching, performance feedback, and workload planning.   Ability to turn unclear requests into workable plans and spot dependencies before they cause delays.   Experience building and improving workflows in Airtable or comparable work-management platforms; Airtable experience preferred.   Experience running Scrum or a similar agile process with designers and engineers. You can explain what you changed when the process wasn't helping the team deliver.   Good design judgment and the ability to give useful feedback. Experience using customer data and test results to decide whether a web change worked.   Hands-on experience with CMS content models, publishing and web UAT. You can work through production or quality problems with engineering and understand web integrations, accessibility, and page performance   Clear communication with technical teams and senior stakeholders, especially when scope, timing, or resourcing needs to change.   

  Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tuesday - Thursday) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.    The annual  base salary range  for this position is $210,000 - $265,000. This role is also eligible for a target bonus.   Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available.    At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.  Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Billing Platform
description:
About the Billing Platform 
The Billing Platform is a foundational platform that powers how Freshworks manages and 
monetizes its products and customer relationships. 
The platform currently owns three critical capabilities: 
● Subscription Management – managing customer subscriptions, plans, products, and 
their lifecycle. 
● Entitlements – determining what customers are entitled to access and use based on 
their subscriptions and commercial agreements. 
● Metering – capturing and processing product usage to support usage-based billing 
and evolving monetization models. 
These capabilities sit at the intersection of technology, product, pricing, finance, and 
customer experience and are consumed across multiple Freshworks products. 
As Freshworks continues to expand its product portfolio and evolve its monetization models, 
the Billing Platform will play a critical role in enabling new business models while ensuring 
scale, reliability, accuracy, and a great customer experience. 
The Opportunity 
We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the engineering organization 
responsible for Subscription Management, Entitlements, and Metering. 
This role goes beyond managing engineering execution. You will shape the technology 
strategy, platform architecture, roadmap, engineering organization, and cross-functional 
partnerships that enable Freshworks' monetization journey.  We are looking for a leader who is equally comfortable discussing distributed systems and 
architecture with engineers, business models with Product and Finance, and strategic 
priorities with senior leadership. 
Most importantly, you should enjoy stepping outside the boundaries of engineering—meeting 
stakeholders from Product, Finance, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success, and other business 
functions, understanding their problems, and turning those problems into scalable 
technology solutions. 
What You'll Do 
1. Lead Billing Platform Engineering 
● Own the engineering strategy and technical direction for Subscription Management, 
Entitlements, and Metering. 
● Build highly scalable, reliable, secure, and extensible platform capabilities. 
● Drive architecture across distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, event-driven 
systems, and integrations. 
● Design platforms that can support multiple products, subscription models, pricing 
structures, and evolving monetization strategies. 
● Establish strong engineering practices around reliability, observability, security, 
performance, and operational excellence. 
2. Shape the Platform Strategy & Roadmap 
● Partner closely with Product and business stakeholders to shape the Billing Platform 
roadmap. 
● Translate business requirements and commercial models into scalable technology 
solutions. 
● Identify opportunities to build reusable platform capabilities rather than 
product-specific solutions. 
● Balance business priorities with platform modernization, technical debt, scalability, 
reliability, and long-term engineering investments. 
● Anticipate future business and monetization needs and ensure the platform is ready 
to support them. 
3. Partner with Business & Non-Engineering Stakeholders 
This role requires strong engagement beyond engineering. 
● Build trusted relationships with Product, Finance, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success, 
Operations, and other business teams. 
● Understand the business and commercial models behind subscription and 
usage-based offerings. 
● Participate actively in business discussions and explain technical implications in 
simple terms.  ● Translate complex business problems into technology strategies and platform 
capabilities. 
● Challenge requirements constructively when necessary and help stakeholders arrive 
at better solutions. 
● Represent the Billing Platform in cross-functional and strategic initiatives. 
We are looking for a leader who is curious about the business, enjoys meeting people 
outside engineering, and wants to understand the problem behind the 
requirement—not just implement the requirement. 
4. Drive Execution & Business Outcomes 
● Lead end-to-end execution of complex, cross-functional platform initiatives. 
● Establish clear goals, milestones, ownership, and execution mechanisms. 
● Proactively manage risks, dependencies, capacity, and organizational constraints. 
● Drive predictable delivery while maintaining high engineering quality. 
● Measure and improve platform health, engineering effectiveness, reliability, and

title: Commercial Sales Director
description:
Freshworks is seeking an experienced Commercial Sales Director to lead a team of Commercial Account Executives driving new business revenue within our Commercial customer segment (250-500 employees).  Reporting directly to Mark Ripley, VP of Sales of Mid-Market and Commercial, this leader will manage a team of individual contributor sales representatives, with direct responsibility for day-to-day execution, coaching, and performance against pipeline conversion, forecast accuracy, and revenue targets.  This is a front-line sales leadership position requiring someone who has directly managed and developed individual contributor reps in a SaaS sales environment, and who thrives in a hands-on, in-the-field coaching role.  The ideal candidate combines strong sales fundamentals with hands-on coaching ability. They can set clear expectations, develop AEs’ skills, manage day-to-day execution, and partner across the organization to help the Commercial segment scale.      What You'll Do     Lead, coach, and develop a team of Commercial Account Executives, establishing a high bar for performance, accountability, and execution.    Execute Freshworks’ Commercial sales strategy within your team, aligned with broader North America and company growth objectives.    Own revenue performance for your team, including pipeline generation, forecasting, deal execution, productivity, and quota attainment.    Actively participate in and support deals including joining customer calls, reviewing proposals, and helping reps navigate objections and close business.    Establish strong pipeline inspection and forecasting discipline within your team, providing clear and accurate visibility into performance, risks, and opportunities.    Recruit, hire, onboard, and retain top sales talent as your team grows.    Partner closely with Marketing, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and other functions to support your team’s execution.    Drive consistent use of sales process, methodology, and tools (e.g., Salesforce) across the team.    Provide ongoing coaching and skill development to reps at all experience levels, from ramping new hires to seasoned individual contributors.    Foster a positive, high-energy team culture that supports collaboration, accountability, and growth.    Represent your team within the broader Commercial sales leadership organization and contribute to territory planning, headcount planning, and go-to-market execution.   

   8+ years of progressive sales and sales leadership experience, ideally within enterprise or commercial SaaS organizations.    3–5 years of sales leadership/management experience, directly managing individual contributor sales representatives.    Demonstrated success building, coaching, and leading a high-performing sales team.    Deep understanding of SaaS sales cycles, including prospecting, discovery, demo, procurement, negotiation and closing.    Proven track record of consistently delivering against revenue targets, both personally as an individual contributor and as a people leader.    Strong command of pipeline management, forecasting, and sales productivity metrics.    Demonstrated ability to coach reps of varying experience levels while creating a culture of accountability and high performance.    Strong communication skills and presence, comfortable engaging with customers and internal stakeholders.    Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, balancing team management with hands-on deal support.    Experience with CRM and sales engagement tools (e.g., Salesforce).    Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment is highly desirable.       Success in this role means building a high-performing, motivated Commercial sales team that consistently meets or exceeds quota.  You will develop reps into stronger sellers, create consistency in pipeline and forecasting accuracy, and build a repeatable sales motion that scales with the team’s growth.  Most importantly, you will build a team culture where reps want to stay, grow, and do their best work — turning individual talent into a durable competitive advantage for Freshworks.

title: Vice President, Corporate Legal & Compliance
description:
This position will report directly to the Chief Legal Officer and will be responsible for handling a wide range of corporate and securities matters related to the growth, operation and further development of this global publicly traded corporation. The role will be the primary legal support to the SEC reporting, tax, treasury, insurance, investor relations, finance and stock plan administration functions of the Company.  This role requires a person to possess a strong securities and corporate governance background, and an analytical and detail-oriented growth mindset, coupled with strong communication skills.  This role will also serve as a leader in enterprise risk management and information security compliance, working closely with business leaders on business continuity processes, compliance programs and related disclosures.  This role will also help lead the global HR compliance projects of the company in partnership with regional HR legal specialists.  This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated individual with a strong background in corporate law that has demonstrated the ability to expand to the wide breadth of areas of an in-house legal team to contribute to our organization's success.    ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:    Advise on a broad range of securities laws and corporate governance matters to ensure compliance with legal requirements and company policies generally applicable to Freshworks’ business.    Responsible for the preparation and/or review of periodic reports, earnings materials, proxy statements and other filings required by the SEC and Nasdaq, including 10-Ks, 10-Qs, 8-Ks, proxy statements, S-8s, Forms 4 and other Section 16 filings and stock based compensation plans.  Responsible for the administration of policies and procedures to ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley, Nasdaq regulations, SEC regulations (e.g., insider trading, Reg. FD, etc.) and other regulatory requirements.  Manage the planning and execution of the virtual annual stockholder meeting.  Includes responsibility for outreach to proxy advisory services to regularly update corporate data and support investor relations on communications and investor relations matters, including stockholder feedback and tracking for Board of Directors.    Advising on insider trading and Section 16 issues for directors, officers and other insiders. Responsible for review of Rule 10b5-1 plans and coordination with stock administration and external brokers on same.  Work cross-functionally to assist in preparing Board of Directors and committee meeting materials.  Responsible for maintaining corporate minute books and records for both parent and subsidiary entities.    Support subsidiary governance and legal entity management operations globally, including legal entity formation, merger and dissolution processes, and ongoing compliance with local legal requirements (e.g., UK Anti-Modern Slavery Act).  Includes close collaboration with tax department on legal entity structuring and intercompany arrangements and finance department on annual filings for subsidiaries.  Assist with, and manage, corporate governance matters, including overall corporate compliance training programs, whistleblower policies, ≠≠business continuity and escalation processes, enterprise risk management initiatives and other key corporate initiatives.  Monitor corporate governance best practices and regulatory and legislative developments and advise on compliance with applicable standards and updates to policies and training materials.  Partner with Finance, Treasury, Corporate Development, Tax, HR and across other Legal and Business teams on a variety of projects and compliance processes.  Experience working directly with HR team members on matters a plus.  Support M&A, corporate transactions, and complex strategic initiatives and acquisitions.  Work closely with the broader legal team on general corporate and legal operations, including drafting and reviewing real estate contracts, agreements, marketing review, government and agency inquiries and other corporate-wide policies.   Assist in the development and implementation of corporate policies and procedures and appropriate training materials for client groups.  Develop strong working relationships and trust by actively collaborating with others in Legal and Compliance teams and across multiple functions within the Company.    Providing high quality legal advice and counsel in a timely fashion to senior management, the legal team and non-attorney staff in the business teams.  Handling other projects and matters as may be assigned from time to time.  

  Juris doctorate degree from an accredited law school and active state bar membership in good standing.  15+ years of relevant experience practicing with national law firm, with at least 8 years in-house experience at public-traded technology companies, preferably during the growth-to-great phase of its lifecycle.   Strong securities and corporate governance experience (along with an understanding of financial statements and equity plans) to support all periodic reporting and equity plan compliance of a U.S. public company with an internal finance team.  Strong knowledge of corporate law principles, regulations, and best practices.    High level of business acumen and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify risks and help make strategic business decisions aligned with legal parameters quickly and effectively in the face of ambiguity and uncertainty.  Ability to drive your own results and “roll up sleeves” to take on any project (from admin to strategy) in a small in-house legal team environment to get stuff done.  Low ego individual that thinks like a business person (not a lawyer) and sees challenges as opportunities to develop and find innovative ways to get work done while helping shape and nurture an amazing work culture.  Demonstrated experience in providing strategic legal leadership and contributions to lead or influence operational process, procedure, and strategy to achieve business outcomes.  Demonstrated self-initiative, integrity, and resilience.  Must be committed to constant curiosity and have willingness and ability to make decisions following feedback, input and collaboration to deliver desired results for the Company.    Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively across all levels of an organization with enterprise-wide viewpoint to avoid siloed thinking.  Strong presence and the ability to work independently with business functions, external auditors, outside counsel and senior-level executives to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations in a business-oriented manner.  Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex legal concepts in a clear and concise manner to make them understandable and actionable for non-legal employees at all levels in order to drive solutions, clarity and accountability.  Adaptable and able to plan and manage multiple projects simultaneously from conception to completion in a fast-paced dynamic environment with independent follow-through.  Ability to be a proactive business partner that anticipates the needs of peers and internal client-stakeholders with strong organizational skills and ability to exercise sound legal and business judgment.   Strong work ethic and ability to produce high quality work with meticulous attention to detail under deadline pressures.  Demonstrated ability to act independently and prioritize tasks to deliver results while considering relevant risk, business, and objectives.  High ethical standards and proven ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.

title: Principal Engineer - Machine Learning
description:
About the Role:  Freshworks is building next-generation AI-driven customer and employee engagement platforms. As a Principal Engineer - Machine Learning on our AI/ML Engineering team, you will drive the architecture and technical strategy for core backend services powering our Agentic AI Platform. You will lead the development of reasoning-driven agents, multi-agent orchestration, and outcome-based workflows that directly power autonomous AI capability across our suite of enterprise products. This role is pivotal in establishing engineering standards, scaling backend infrastructure, and mentoring senior engineers as we expand our agentic capabilities at enterprise scale.   What You'll Do     Drive Platform & Runtime Architecture: Lead the architectural design and execution of agent runtime orchestration services, focusing on reasoning, planning, tool invocation, and low-latency execution.    Define API & SDK Standards: Design and establish robust, developer-friendly APIs and SDKs that enable internal engineering teams and external ecosystem partners to build, deploy, and manage complex agent workflows.    Architect Stateful & Memory Systems: Build and optimize stateful dialog management, shared context systems, and memory services for multi-turn, context-aware autonomous agents.    Implement Multi-Agent Communication Protocols: Establish scalable agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, coordination patterns, and shared memory spaces for distributed multi-agent workflows. title: Director - Demand Generation
description:
Freshworks is looking for a senior demand generation leader to help build and modernize our scaled demand engine across our product portfolio.  This role is for a hands-on operator and builder. You will own the day-to-day demand generation engine across channels, work closely with Revenue Marketing leadership on strategy and prioritization, and help rethink how demand generation should operate in an AI-forward company.  We are not looking for someone to simply run the traditional demand gen playbook faster. We want someone who can question what is working, identify what is not, build better systems, and use AI and automation to fundamentally improve how we generate, qualify, nurture, and convert demand.  You will partner closely with Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Analytics, and regional marketing teams to create an integrated demand engine that drives measurable pipeline and revenue impact.   Key Responsibilities    Own and execute the scaled demand generation roadmap across our product portfolio, balancing pipeline goals, audience priorities, channel performance, and budget.  Build and optimize always-on demand programs across SEM, SEO, AI search/GEO, content syndication, webinars, conversational marketing, lifecycle, nurture, and emerging channels.  Build AI-native and agentic workflows into the demand engine, including audience identification, campaign orchestration, lead qualification, personalization, optimization, and reporting.  Own performance across key demand generation metrics including MQCs/MQLs, SAOs, conversion rates, pipeline contribution, pipeline velocity, CAC, CPL, and channel efficiency.  Manage and continuously optimize multi-million-dollar budgets across channels and campaigns based on incremental pipeline impact and ROI.  Partner with Sales and RevOps on lead scoring, qualification, routing, SLAs, and handoff processes to improve conversion from demand through pipeline.  Partner with Product Marketing to ensure campaigns, messaging, and audience strategies are coordinated across product lines rather than fragmented.  Build a rigorous testing and experimentation culture, with clear hypotheses, measurement frameworks, and decisions on where to scale, optimize, or stop investment.  Lead and develop a high-performing demand generation team while remaining close enough to the work to diagnose problems and drive execution.  Evaluate and help evolve the demand generation martech stack, including marketing automation, intent data, conversational marketing, AI tools, and orchestration platforms.    What Success Looks Like:   In this role, success means building a demand engine that is:   Predictable in generating qualified pipeline  Efficient in how budget is deployed  Stronger at converting demand into sales opportunities  Integrated across products, regions, and channels  Increasingly automated and AI-native  Measured on business outcomes, not activity volume    The Profile We Are Looking For    You are equally comfortable looking at a pipeline dashboard, challenging a channel strategy, designing a new operating system, and getting into the details with the team.  You are not overly attached to legacy marketing playbooks. You care about what actually creates an incremental pipeline and are willing to stop programs that no longer perform.  Most importantly, you are a builder. You see demand generation as a system to continuously redesign and improve, not simply a collection of campaigns to run.  

  10+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing, ideally in enterprise SaaS.  Significant experience owning scaled demand generation programs and measurable pipeline targets.  Experience managing multi-million-dollar marketing budgets and making channel allocation decisions based on performance and ROI.  Strong understanding of demand generation economics, including CPL, CAC, conversion rates, pipeline coverage, velocity, and incremental return.  Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI-enabled or agentic workflows within a marketing or demand generation environment.  Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot and CRM platforms such as Salesforce.  Experience with intent and account intelligence platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase and conversational marketing platforms such as Qualified or Drift.  Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently diagnose performance issues using data.  Strong partnership skills across Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Analytics, and executive stakeholders.  Experience leading and developing demand generation teams.    Preferred:    Experience in a scaled, sales-led enterprise SaaS company with a multi-product portfolio.  Experience operating in both enterprise and SMB/mid-market motions.  Experience at an AI-native company or building AI-native marketing systems.  A strong point of view on AI search, GEO, and how buyer discovery is changing.  Experience with ITSM, customer support, CRM, or adjacent enterprise software categories.    

 We're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diverse world we serve. At Freshworks, you'll find inclusive teams, flexible thinking, and opportunities to grow your career - while making work better for millions.   If this sounds like a journey you want to be part of, we'd love to meet you. Let's building something refreshing together.   The annual  base salary range  for this position is $225,000 - $280,000 Base Salary.   Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available. title: Lead - Channel Sales
description:
We are looking for a  Channel Manager – Middle East & Africa (MEA)  to build, activate and grow Freshworks’ partner ecosystem across the region.  This role is responsible for creating  incremental business through the partner ecosystem  — identifying the right partners, enabling them to sell and deliver Freshworks solutions, building joint go-to-market motions, generating qualified pipeline and ensuring strong execution across the partner lifecycle.  The role requires a strong balance of  commercial ownership, partner management, sales alignment and operational discipline .  The Channel Manager will work closely with Sales, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Marketing, Alliances and other cross-functional teams to make partners a meaningful growth channel for Freshworks.   . Partner Strategy & Business Development    Develop and execute the partner strategy for assigned markets and segments across MEA.  Identify and recruit partners that can provide meaningful customer access, technical capability, industry expertise or geographic coverage.  Evaluate partners based on their ability to generate pipeline, influence customers, implement solutions and build a sustainable Freshworks practice.  Develop joint business plans with priority partners, including revenue objectives, target accounts, GTM activities and capability-building priorities.  Build relationships with senior stakeholders within the partner organization and establish clear mutual accountability.    2. Partner Activation & Readiness    Own the activation of newly recruited partners and move them from onboarding to productive engagement.  Drive partner readiness across product knowledge, sales capability, solution positioning, certifications and implementation capability.  Identify capability gaps and create focused enablement plans rather than relying on generic training.  Establish measurable activation milestones and monitor progress against them.  Ensure partners have the tools, knowledge and internal champions required to independently position and sell Freshworks.    3. Pipeline Generation & Revenue Growth    Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline generation for the assigned territory.  Build joint campaigns, account-mapping exercises, workshops, roundtables and other pipeline-generation initiatives with priority partners.  Identify opportunities where partner access or capability can create incremental Freshworks revenue.  Work with Sales teams to convert partner-generated pipeline into qualified opportunities and closed business.  Track partner contribution across the funnel — from recruitment and activation through pipeline, conversion and revenue.  Identify gaps early and build corrective action plans with partners and internal stakeholders.    4. Joint GTM & Field Alignment    Build strong relationships with Freshworks Account Executives and Sales leadership to align partner activity with territory priorities.  Facilitate joint account planning between Freshworks and partners.  Bring partners into relevant enterprise opportunities where they add customer access, technical expertise, implementation capability or commercial leverage.  Ensure the right level of partner involvement based on the opportunity rather than involving partners purely for attribution.  Support strategic partner-led and partner-assisted opportunities through the sales cycle.    5. Partner Governance & Performance Management    Establish regular operating cadences with priority partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews and action tracking.  Maintain visibility into partner performance, pipeline quality, conversion, activity and readiness.  Hold partners accountable to agreed commitments and follow through on action items.  Identify underperforming or inactive partners and develop clear activation, remediation or rationalization plans.  Maintain accurate partner and opportunity information across Freshworks systems and reporting mechanisms.    6. Opportunity & Deal Support    Support partner registration, opportunity alignment, attribution and commercial processes in accordance with Freshworks policies. title: Corporate Strategy Manager (Consulting & Strategy)
description:
Freshworks is looking for a Manager to join our global Corporate Strategy team and help shape some of the most important decisions facing the company.  This is a high-impact strategy role for someone who loves solving complex business problems but wants to get closer to the decisions, the executives making them, and the outcomes that follow.  You'll work directly with Strategy leadership and senior executives on questions spanning AI, product strategy, pricing and monetization, GTM growth, market expansion, and strategic investments. One project might involve evaluating how we monetize a new AI capability; another could focus on where Freshworks should invest to accelerate growth or how we evolve our GTM strategy.  The team operates with the rigor of a top strategy consulting firm, but with one important difference: we don't stop at the recommendation. We partner across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to help turn strategy into action and see the impact of the decisions we help shape.   What You'll Do   • Own high-priority strategic initiatives from initial question through recommendation and execution. 
• Tackle ambiguous company-level problems, develop hypotheses, and create the analytical frameworks needed to answer them. 
• Evaluate growth opportunities across AI, product, GTM, pricing, market expansion, and strategic investments. 
• Build business cases, financial models, market assessments, and scenario analyses that inform investment and resource allocation decisions. 
• Partner directly with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to shape decisions and drive alignment. 
• Translate strategy into actionable plans and stay close to execution to understand what is working and where we need to adjust. 
• Develop executive and Board-level narratives that distill complex analysis into clear choices and recommendations. 
• Bring an outside-in perspective on the SaaS and AI landscape and help identify the strategic questions Freshworks should be asking next. 

  What We're Looking For   • 4-6+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a combination of consulting and in-house strategy experience;  experience from a top-tier management consulting firm, particularly MBB (Mckinsey, Bain, BCG) is preferred  
• Experience solving growth, product, GTM, pricing, market entry, or investment strategy problems 
• Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, or technology businesses strongly preferred 
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to turn data into business insights and recommendations 
• Executive-level communication skills and the ability to influence without authority 
• Comfortable moving between high-level strategy and hands-on analysis 
• Curious, low ego, and energized by ambiguity 
• Most importantly, you want to own the outcome, not just deliver the recommendation   Why This Role   Freshworks is at an exciting point in its evolution. We're scaling a global SaaS business, expanding our enterprise presence, and navigating how AI changes the products we build, how we monetize them, and how our customers work.  For someone coming from consulting, this is an opportunity to keep the parts of the job you love—complex problems, executive exposure, analytical rigor, and variety—while gaining something that's harder to get as an advisor: ownership.  You'll see the decisions get made. You'll work alongside the teams responsible for executing them. And you'll have the opportunity to see whether the strategy actually worked.  This is a highly visible individual contributor role with exposure to senior executives and the Board, and an opportunity to build a deep understanding of how a global SaaS company operates.

title: Principal Engineer - Systems
description:
Role Overview   We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer to lead the design and evolution of the enterprise-scale platform architecture that powers Freshworks’ multi-tier SaaS products. This role will define the architecture strategy for a major platform domain, drive modernization initiatives, and establish best practices across service design, reliability, engineering quality, and cost.  The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in distributed systems, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, microservices, event-driven design, and large-scale production operations with strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities — and remains genuinely hands-on, writing production code and leading deep debugging when it matters.   Key Responsibilities    Architecture & Strategy     Define and own the platform architecture roadmap for your domain, including the target state and a realistic path to it.    Design scalable, secure, and cost-efficient architectures supporting high-throughput, low-latency, multi-tenant workloads.    Establish architecture standards, design principles, decision records, and review practices.    Evaluate emerging technologies and own build-versus-buy decisions with measurable outcomes.     Platform Engineering     Architect and build cloud-native services and APIs that scale with global growth.    Design service decomposition, API contracts, messaging and event-driven flows, caching strategies, and database-layer design.    Treat multi-tenancy as a first-class design concern: isolation models, noisy-neighbour control, per-tenant limits, and cost attribution.    Lead platform modernization — monolith decomposition, migrations, and deprecations carried through to completion.     Reliability, Performance & Operations     Drive platform reliability, availability, performance optimization, and observability.    Take ownership of complex production issues in distributed SaaS environments, leading deep root-cause analysis and implementing permanent preventive safeguards.    Define SLOs, failure modes, resilience patterns, and capacity planning for the systems you own.     Engineering Excellence & Quality     Write clean, maintainable, high-performance production code and build proof-of-concepts that settle architectural questions.    Establish rigorous engineering standards through code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD integration.    Identify architectural bottlenecks and technical debt, and drive practical, iterative refactoring without compromising business delivery.     Security, Privacy & Compliance     Ensure platform designs and team practices align with information security standards and regulatory requirements.    Design for tenant isolation, access control, auditability, and data residency from the outset.     Technical Leadership     Provide architectural guidance across multiple engineering teams.    Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making.    Mentor senior and staff engineers, raising the bar through reference implementations and sponsorship rather than authority.    Influence engineering strategy and long-term technology investments; articulate complex trade-offs to both technical panels and executive stakeholders.   

  Required Qualifications     Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience.    14+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or systems architecture within modern distributed SaaS environments.    Expert-level backend engineering in Java, Python, Go, or equivalent — currently hands-on.    Proven experience designing and operating enterprise-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, with real numbers for throughput, latency, availability, and behaviour under failure.    Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency and idempotency, retries and backpressure, concurrency, caching, and database design and optimization.    Demonstrated ownership of large-scale migrations or modernization initiatives with measurable outcomes.    Advanced production debugging skills — Linux internals, profiling, log analysis, and telemetry in distributed cloud environments.    Experience leading cross-functional architecture initiatives in SaaS or product organizations.     Good to Have    Data Platform & Analytics     Batch and real-time data ingestion, transformation, and serving architectures; streaming and CDC (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium).    Lakehouse and modern data platform technologies such as Delta Lake, Iceberg, Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud-native data services.    Reusable data models, semantic layers, and curated data products enabling self-service analytics. title: Principal - Solution Engineering
description:
As a GSI Solution Architect, you will be the technical and solution engine behind our Global Systems Integrator ecosystem, with a dedicated focus on Employee Experience and Freshservice.  You will help GSI partners find, shape, and progress new business and expansion opportunities — bringing solution credibility to early conversations, turning employee service challenges into structured opportunities, and building the assets and capability that let partners eventually run these motions themselves.  You will work day-to-day with two Business Development colleagues and our GSI Partner Managers, and partner closely with Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, and Professional Services. Support early-stage discovery with partner teams and end customers, translating service challenges into structured solution opportunities.   Required     Experience in solution architecture, presales, consulting, or partner solution engineering.    Strong understanding of Employee Experience, ITSM, ESM, service desk modernisation, and internal service delivery.    Experience working with GSIs, systems integrators, consulting firms, or other partner-led business models.    Ability to build EX, ESM, and AI solution narratives, and to support both new business and expansion motions.    Understanding of AI use cases in service management — self-service, agent assist, automation, knowledge, and ticket deflection.    Experience creating demos, discovery guides, enablement content, and reference architectures.    Comfortable being commercially aligned to partner-sourced ARR.    Strong stakeholder management across partner, sales, product, and technical teams, with excellent communication and presentation skills. Experience supporting partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue motions, or GSI-led transformation programmes.    Experience working with Indian or global GSI partners. title: Director - Global Talent Management
description:
Freshworks is rethinking how we develop, evaluate, and listen to our people — and this role is at the center of that transformation. As Director of Performance Management & Employee Listening, you will lead two of our most strategically important people practices: a comprehensive redesign of how we approach performance management, and a shift to a modern, continuous approach to employee listening.   This is a role for someone who thinks systemically, designs with the business in mind, and cares about execution as much as strategy. Ultimately, you are helping us build something lasting: a sustainable culture of high performance and an employee experience that is genuinely differentiated. You will work as part of a small, senior Workforce Strategy & Org Development team — owning your domain with a high degree of autonomy and leading through influence across a matrixed organization. You will not manage a large team, but you will need to move a lot of work through people who don't report to you.  Based at our San Mateo headquarters, you will work alongside senior leaders and represent the People team in high-visibility conversations at the VP and executive level. We need someone who commands a room, earns trust quickly, and brings both creative thinking and rigorous follow-through to everything they own. Critically, you know that even the best-designed programs fail without deliberate change management — and you build enablement, communication, and adoption into your work from the start.   What You’ll Do    Performance Management Transformation    Lead a meaningful transformation of how Freshworks approaches performance management — moving from a process-heavy, subjective model to a streamlined, AI-assisted approach that is easier for managers, more consistent in its outputs, and more tightly connected to business outcomes.  Design and own the end-to-end performance system: the methodology, the tools, the calibration approach, and the employee and manager experience.   Coordinate across HR, Total Rewards, HR Technology, and business partners to deliver an integrated solution that actually works in practice.   Build and maintain executive alignment. This work is visible to senior leadership, and you will present, defend, and iterate on it in real time.   Lead the change management and enablement strategy for the performance transformation — developing communications, training, and leader readiness plans that drive understanding and adoption across the organization.  Hold the bar on quality and detail at every stage.     Employee Listening    Own our employee listening strategy and programs, including our continuous listening platform, pulse approach, and how we translate signals into leadership action.  Drive the shift from periodic survey cycles to an always-on listening culture — designing and executing the change management strategy that moves leaders from passive recipients of survey results to active owners of the employee feedback loop.  Build leader-facing tools, frameworks, and communications that make listening data accessible and useful, not just reportable.   Track program health, participation trends, and sentiment over time; surface risks and opportunities and bring forward clear recommendations.   Stand up and lead a cross-functional employee experience working group — bringing together leaders from People Analytics, Employee Experience, and the HRBP community to build a cohesive, multi-lens view of the state of the employee experience. This group will be responsible for maturing how we aggregate and interpret employee signals, and for delivering a regular, centralized view of organizational health to senior leadership.   Continuously improve our approach as AI capabilities and listening methodologies evolve    Change Management & Enablement    Own the change management and enablement strategy across both performance and listening — from how we communicate program shifts to how we build leader capability and drive adoption at scale. The goal is not compliance with new programs; it is durable behavior change that builds a culture of high performance and an employee experience people can feel.  Apply behavioral science principles to the design of change interventions — using what we know about habit formation, social norms, loss aversion, and motivation to design programs that shift behavior, not just awareness.  Design and deliver leader enablement programs that translate program changes into concrete behaviors: what leaders need to know, do, and model differently as a result of each transformation.  Build a communication and engagement framework that keeps employees, managers, and senior leaders informed, aligned, and bought in throughout multi-year transformation cycles.  Serve as the connective tissue between program design and organizational readiness — ensuring that what we build in the design room actually lands in the field.  Measure adoption and enablement effectiveness; use data to identify where uptake is lagging and adjust approach accordingly.  

  8–12 years of progressive experience in HR, people strategy, organizational effectiveness, or a related field.   Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives from design through execution in a fast-paced environment. • Deep expertise in performance management design — you’ve built or significantly redesigned performance systems before and understand how to make them fair, scalable, and defensible.   Meaningful experience in organizational design and development — you can help leaders think through structure and effectiveness, and you know how to turn those conversations into action.   Strong change management and enablement skills — you know how to bring people along through transformation, build leader capability, and design adoption strategies that actually stick. • Familiarity with continuous listening platforms and methodology; experience driving leader adoption of listening tools is a strong plus.   An AI-first mindset — you’re curious about what AI makes possible in people practices and you bring that perspective to how you design programs and solve problems.   Exceptional executive presence — you’re comfortable presenting to C-suite leaders, you communicate with clarity and confidence, and you can hold your own in high-stakes rooms.   High attention to detail — you care deeply about getting things right and you’ll get into the weeds to make sure they are. • Strong cross-functional instincts — you build trust with Finance, Strategy, and Operations partners and you design solutions that work for the business, not just for HR. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can translate complexity into clarity for any audience.  

  Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.    The annual base salary range for this position is  $199,750 - $246,750.  This role is also eligible for a target bonus.   Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level.   Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability, and life insurance. Equity + ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits, and wellness benefits are also offered. The role will define the strategy, operating model and governance for the function, delivering workforce insights that enable strategic business decisions, organizational effectiveness and long-term workforce planning. The Senior Director will build and lead a high-performing team responsible for analytics, workforce planning and strategic decision support.      Key Responsibilities    People Analytics    Lead the People Analytics function, establishing its strategy, operating model and roadmap.  Develop enterprise workforce analytics, executive dashboards, AI-driven insights and strategic reporting to support business and talent decisions.  Advance the function from operational reporting to predictive analytics, AI-enabled decision support and strategic workforce intelligence.  Establish governance, standards and enterprise workforce metrics to ensure consistent, accurate reporting across the organization.  Leverage AI and advanced analytics to automate reporting, improve data quality, uncover workforce trends and enable faster decision-making.  Identify opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness through data-driven insights.       Strategic Workforce Planning    Establish and lead Freshworks' enterprise workforce planning capability.  Develop workforce planning methodologies, AI-assisted capacity models and scenario planning frameworks.  Partner with Finance, Corporate Strategy and other stakeholders to align workforce plans with business priorities and long-term growth objectives.  Deliver insights and recommendations on workforce composition, organizational design, productivity and future talent demand.  Leverage AI to enhance workforce forecasting, skills planning and organizational modeling.       AI Enablement    Partner with HR leadership to operationalize and advance the HR AI roadmap in alignment with the company's enterprise AI strategy.  Identify, prioritize and implement AI-enabled capabilities that improve HR productivity, decision-making and employee experience.  Establish governance, adoption measures and success metrics for AI initiatives across the People function.  Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend opportunities to enhance people analytics, workforce planning and HR operations.       Leadership    Build, develop and lead a high-performing People Analytics & Workforce Planning team.  Establish priorities, operating rhythms and delivery standards for the function.  Lead, coach and develop managers and individual contributors while fostering a culture of analytical rigor, AI adoption, innovation and continuous improvement.  Build organizational capability in analytics, workforce planning and the effective use of AI across the People function.  Serve as a strategic advisor to senior HR and business leaders on workforce strategy, organizational effectiveness and people analytics.  

  Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Analytics, Economics, Statistics or a related discipline.  15+ years of progressive experience in People Analytics, Workforce Planning, Business Analytics or a related discipline, including significant people leadership experience.  Demonstrated success building and scaling enterprise People Analytics and Workforce Planning capabilities, with a strong understanding of workforce analytics, organizational design and strategic workforce planning.  Experience partnering with senior business leaders and leading cross-functional initiatives in a global organization to influence strategic decisions through data-driven insights.  Excellent analytical, communication and executive presentation skills.  Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company, with expertise in Workday and modern people analytics platforms (e.g., Visier, Tableau or Power BI); experience leading AI-enabled transformation initiatives within HR is preferred.  

  Please note: This is a hybrid role that will be based in San Mateo, CA and requires an in-office presence three days per week (Tuesday - Thursday).    The annual base salary range for this position is $250,750 to $309,750 USD. 
 
Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. title: Technical Product Marketing Manager, AI
description:
Freshworks is looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager to bring the next generation of AI-powered IT service management to market.   The conversation around enterprise AI has gotten technical. Buyers and prospects are asking about model quality and evaluation, agent-to-agent coordination, MCP and tool-calling, retrieval and data grounding, inference economics, and where automation ends and autonomy begins. Marketing that can't engage at that level gets discounted.   You'll be the technical voice of Freshservice AI by authoring the content that stands up to scrutiny and making sure our external narrative matches what the product genuinely does. While you won't be asked to build or maintain demo infrastructure, you will be expected to get into the product yourself, run the workflows, and form your own view before you write about them.    What You'll Do:     Own the technical narrative for AI across Freshservice —how our agents work, how they're grounded in the right context, how quality is measured, and why our architectural choices matter.   Author technical content that holds up under scrutiny: architecture explainers, deep-dive blogs, whitepapers, model and evaluation narratives, and integration guides for platform teams.   Enable the technical field. Build the material that Solution Engineers, Solution Architects, and Customer Success need to win technical evaluations, POCs, and security or architecture reviews.   Support customer and prospect conversations directly when technical depth is the deciding factor, such as evaluations, advisory boards, analyst briefings, and customer interviews.   Partner with Product Management and Engineering across the lifecycle, translating technical decisions into customer value and carrying technical buyer feedback back into the roadmap.   Represent Freshworks externally at webinars, industry events, and in bylined technical writing.   Track the AI landscape, including models, agent frameworks, emerging protocols, competitive moves as well as how these trends will impact ITSM use cases.   

  What We're Looking For:     5+ years in product marketing, technical marketing, solutions engineering, or another technical customer-facing role in B2B SaaS   Real fluency in modern AI systems: agent frameworks and orchestration, tool-calling and MCP, retrieval and grounding, evaluation and quality measurement, fine-tuning, and the practical trade-offs among cost, latency, and accuracy   Comfort working hands-on in product and demo environments. You configure the workflows, run the prompts, and probe the edges yourself rather than waiting for a briefing. You don't need to be the person who builds the environment  A bias toward investigating. When you don't understand how something works, your first move is to go try it. Published writing, talks, repos, or shipped side projects tell us more than a slide library  Proven ability to write clearly and specifically for technical readers without hiding behind abstraction   Credibility with engineers. You can sit in an architecture review, follow it, and ask the question that changes the answer  A point of view. You arrive at discussions with a take, not a status update   Excellent written and verbal communication skills     Nice to Have:     Experience marketing ITSM, IT Operations, DevOps, observability, cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise infrastructure products   Familiarity with enterprise AI adoption patterns and the governance, security, and data-residency questions that gate it   Experience marketing to IT administrators, platform teams, and enterprise technology evaluators  Hands-on experience with agent development, evaluation frameworks, or automation and workflow platforms   A public footprint (e.g., writing, talks, demos, or repos) that shows how you think  

  Please note: This is a hybrid role that will be based in San Mateo, CA and requires an in-office presence three days per week (Tuesday - Thursday).    The annual base salary range for this position is $160,000 - $200,000. This role is also eligible for a target bonus.  Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available. Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability and life insurances. Equity + ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits.
