title: Enterprise Sales Director UKI
description:
Role: Regional Sales Director, Enterprise Sales (UK & Ireland)  Company: Freshworks (NASDAQ: FRSH)  Location: London, UK (Hybrid – 3 days/week in office)  The Vibe  Freshworks is disrupting legacy software giants by making enterprise tech fast, intuitive, and genuinely delightful to use. We are scaling fast across the UK and Ireland, and we’re looking for a heavy-hitting Regional Sales Director based in London to lead from the front, build an elite sales engine, and take our ITSM and CX footprint to the next level.  About the Role  Reporting directly to our Country Leader (UK & Northern Europe), you’ll be the strategic engine powering a team of top-tier Enterprise Account Executives. Operating from our flagship London hub, this isn't a sit-back-and-delegate role—it’s high-visibility, high-impact leadership. You’ll spend your time coaching sellers, co-selling in the field with executive buyers, closing six-figure deals, and turning raw UKI market potential into predictable, high-velocity ARR.  What You’ll Be Doing    Rule the Territory: Author and run the ultimate GTM blueprint to systematically land, expand, and dominate Tier-1 enterprise accounts across the UKI region.    Lead the Pack: Coach, elevate, and scale a team of 7–9 Enterprise AEs to smash a collective $4M–$6M+ ARR target.    Master the Playbook: Enforce MEDDPICC like a science to maintain razor-sharp forecasting, eliminate deal friction, and keep pipeline health bulletproof.    Co-Sell at the C-Suite: Jump into the trenches with your AEs—partnering with Solution Engineers and CS leads to negotiate and close multi-year, strategic agreements.    Own the Narrative: Serve as the primary voice of the region, delivering market insights, growth plays, and bold revenue projections directly to global executive leadership.    Tech-Driven Execution: Run a tight operational cadence using best-in-class tools (Salesforce, Clari, Gong) for seamless, predictable revenue execution.    Build a Magnet Culture: Partner with Talent Acquisition to build a team culture that top 1% enterprise sales talent actually wants to join.   

 Who You Are    The Veteran Leader: 10+ years in SaaS sales, with 5+ years leading front-line enterprise teams closing six-figure +    Domain Native: Deep knowledge of CX, ITSM, CRM, or Enterprise Service Management (ESM) landscapes.    Networked in UKI: You know the regional enterprise landscape inside and out and bring an active, well-established executive network.    Deal Strategist: Master of procurement, MSAs, and complex stakeholder politics—you know how to turn standard deals into massive expansion plays.    Cultural Anchor: You champion transparency, sharp execution, and long-term team growth over quick, messy wins.    Perks & Benefits    Top-of-market base salary with aggressive over-achievement accelerators.    Real skin in the game with public company equity (RSUs).    Premium UK benefits: Top-tier private healthcare, competitive pension, wellness stipends, and a vibrant, collaborative London office culture.

title: Channel Partner Manager - France & Nordics
description:
This is a pivotal individual contributor role at the heart of Freshworks' channel growth strategy. As a Channel Manager, you will own the full lifecycle of our CX partner business across France and the Nordics — from managing strategic partners in the region, signing new partners, through to driving active pipeline, resale revenue, and installed base expansion through those relationships.  The opportunity is significant. Freshworks is building a strategic partner motion to displace incumbent CX platforms through partners who already sell into the mid-market. France is a large channel-led market where the majority of mid-market Customer Support spend transacts through resellers, and this role sits at the centre of that effort. You will work closely with field sales, pre-sales, and marketing, as well as directly with partner sales leaders and owners, to build a reseller base that generates repeatable, run-rate revenue.  The right person combines a hunter's instinct for:    Accelerating revenue with existing partners by building a strong strategic win-win partnership motion.    Working directly on large deals with the customers along with partners on the ground.     Signing the right partners with the commercial discipline to hold those partners accountable to joint business plans and pipeline commitments.     You know how partners make money, how they compensate their sellers, and how to get from first conversation to first transacted deal quickly.         Responsibilities:     Pipeline & Revenue     Own and actively manage a partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, working with field AEs to progress and close Partner-originated opportunities    Set and hold partners to joint pipeline targets, resale revenue commitments, and expansion targets in the installed base through structured QBR and business planning rhythms    Drive deal progression through CRM monitoring — not reactive deal registration    Co-sell alongside partners on key opportunities, providing commercial, technical, and executive support as required    Track and report on partner pipeline health, conversion velocity, and revenue contribution through Salesforce, ensuring accurate and up-to-date forecasting     Partner Enablement & Acceleration     Build partner capability across sales and pre-sales so partners can position, scope, quote, and close Freshworks solutions without vendor dependency    Develop joint go-to-market plans with each partner, including target verticals, solution plays, and co-sell motions with Freshworks field teams    Drive participation in Freshworks enablement programmes, including accreditation, demo certification, and deal support resources    Act as the primary relationship owner into partner sales leadership and seller communities, building multi-threaded engagement across sales, marketing, and ownership    Deploy MDF and campaign investment against agreed pipeline outcomes, not activity     RSI / VAR / SI Recruitment & Onboarding     Identify, target, and sign key strategic Regional SI’s aligned to Freshworks' France & Nordics CX growth priorities     Strategy & Ecosystem Development     Contribute to the France & Nordics Partner strategy, including partner selection criteria, tiering, margin design, and investment allocation    Identify resellers with existing Zendesk, Salesforce, or Legacy CX books as priority displacement targets and develop engagement plans accordingly    Work cross-functionally with marketing, product, and pre-sales to develop reseller-specific content, campaign assets, and quoting tools    Feed market and competitive intelligence back into channel leadership, including partner sentiment, competitor margin structures, and whitespace opportunity   

  Required     7+ years' experience in Sales,  channel, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software environment     Fluent in French and English, written and spoken     Demonstrable track record of working with partners in the French & Nordics market, not just managing existing relationships    Strong understanding of Partner economics: margin expectations, seller compensation, distribution relationships, and how resellers decide where to invest sales capacity    Experience working in or adjacent to CX categories — familiarity with the Zendesk or Salesforce reseller ecosystems is a strong advantage    Commercially rigorous: comfortable building joint business plans, setting pipeline targets, and holding partners accountable to commitments    Ability to build and maintain senior relationships within reseller organisations — sales directors, managing directors, and owners    Strong pipeline management discipline — fluent in Salesforce or equivalent CRM for partner opportunity tracking and forecasting    Effective at working cross-functionally: comfortable aligning field sales, pre-sales, and marketing behind partner-led motions     Preferred     Prior experience at a vendor in a channel role targeting Zendesk or Salesforce displacement through resale    Existing reseller network across France, Nordics    Experience building a resale motion from early stage, including margin and incentive design    Familiarity with distribution and marketplace dynamics as a complement to direct Partner management    Background in solution or pre-sales that gives you credibility in technical conversations with partner sellers     Personal Attributes     Hunter mentality: energised by finding and opening new relationships, not just managing the existing book    High commercial IQ — able to quickly assess partner fit, investment appetite, and revenue potential    Direct and confident communicator — able to influence without authority across both internal and partner organisations    Disciplined operator: tracks commitments, follows through, and manages a structured pipeline without prompting    Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage programme building — this role will shape the mid-market resale motion, not inherit a mature one   

  The role is based in the Paris office with a hybrid setup (3 days in the office: Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays).

title: Lead - Product Marketing
description:
Freshworks is hiring a Lead Product Marketer to drive go-to-market strategies, positioning, and adoption across the Freshdesk portfolio. As customer service software rapidly evolves alongside advances in AI and modern CX capabilities, proactive automation, and shifting buyer expectations, staying ahead of market alternatives is critical.  We’re looking for a seasoned SaaS product marketer who can bridge product capabilities with business value, enjoys translating complex AI technology into clear messaging, and thrives working cross-functionally in a fast-moving SaaS environment.    What you'll do      Develop crisp product positioning and value-driven messaging that differentiates Freshworks solutions in the customer service market.    Frame technical capabilities into clear, compelling narratives tailored to buyer personas, CX leaders, and executives.    Lead cross-functional product launches in close collaboration with Product Management, Sales, Marketing, and Enablement teams.    Lead competitive intelligence across the CX landscape, tracking competitor feature launches, pricing, and GTM moves.    Develop, scale, and maintain actionable competitive enablement assets, including battlecards, competitive matrices, demos, FAQs, displacement pitch decks, and win/loss analysis. Create high-impact sales tools, pitch decks, FAQs, demos, and collateral to equip GTM teams with targeted strategies for handling competitor objections, feature gaps, and displacement throughout the buyer journey.     Partner with Product Management to feed real-time competitive gap insights back into the product roadmap.      Partner with Demand Generation, Lifecycle Marketing teams, and other PMMs to inject product and competitive positioning into field campaigns, web, content, webinars, and any customer-facing collateral and campaigns.    Integrate modern AI tools into daily marketing workflows to automate content creation, market research, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data analysis, thereby accelerating output and asset development.    Stay current on emerging AI technologies and competitive offerings to help shape Freshworks' AI narrative.   

   Any graduate degree (MBA preferred) with 7 to 9 years of prior experience in a similar position.    Excellent English written, verbal, and presentation skills, with an eye for quality and attention to detail.    An ability to understand AI, tech, and the customer service domain, including buyer behavior and ideal customer profiles, and translate tech content into marketing material    Proven track record of planning and executing end-to-end marketing strategies, product launches, customer research, and messaging frameworks.    Strong messaging and positioning skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for both business and technical audiences, complemented by a customer-first mindset supported by strong market research and storytelling abilities.    Strong expertise in integrating AI into product marketing processes, with hands-on experience using modern AI tools to enhance marketing tasks, content creation, and research workflows.    Strength in collaborating with cross-functional teams, across geographies, including executive management, product management, operations, sales, and marketing

title: Director, Integrated Marketing
description:
Freshworks is seeking a Director of Integrated Marketing to lead how our brand strategy shows up in the market, turning strategic positioning into coordinated, full-funnel campaigns across products, regions, and buyer audiences. This role owns the connective tissue between brand and demand: the person who makes sure a single narrative holds together across every campaign, vertical, and channel it touches, rather than fragmenting at the point of execution.  You'll build and run the integrated campaign engine that translates strategy into work that actually moves pipeline, partnering closely with brand, product marketing, content, and field teams to keep Freshworks speaking with one voice at enterprise scale.  If you're a marketing leader who thinks in systems, moves fluidly between brand and demand, and wants to shape how a global SaaS company shows up cohesively everywhere it competes, you'll feel right at home. 
    Responsibilities    Translate Freshworks' brand strategy into integrated, full-funnel campaigns across regions, products, and audience segments  Partner with Product Marketing to align campaign messaging across distinct buyer motions into a single, coherent campaign architecture  Build and lead vertical and persona-based campaign variants that all trace back to one strategic core, avoiding message drift at the point of execution  Collaborate directly with the content, SEO/AEO, and thought leadership team to ensure campaign messaging and long-form narrative stay in lockstep  Own campaign planning, briefing, and cross-functional orchestration across creative, field marketing, demand gen, and regional teams  Define and report on campaign-level success metrics, tying integrated campaign performance back to pipeline and brand awareness goals  Manage relationships with external creative and agency partners as needed for brand refresh or campaign production work  Represent the voice of coordinated brand execution in CMO-level strategy reviews  

  10+ years of B2B marketing leadership spanning both brand strategy and integrated/demand campaign execution — not one or the other  A demonstrated track record of unifying marketing narrative across multiple products or a post-merger/post-acquisition product suite into one coherent go-to-market story  Experience building vertical or segment-specific campaign variants without losing a central brand thread  Direct experience marketing into enterprise IT, HR/EX, or service-operations categories, ideally with exposure to competitors like ServiceNow, Zendesk, or comparable enterprise SaaS players  Comfort operating in ambiguity — this role exists because a strategic tension needs resolving in market, not because a playbook already exists  Hands-on fluency with marketing automation and campaign tooling (HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce, or equivalent)  Experience managing or closely partnering with external creative/brand agencies  A bias toward execution: this is a builder role, not a strategist-only seat

title: Senior Director, Engineering - AI Studio (CX & EX)
description:
At Freshworks, we are building the future of customer and employee engagement - and AI agents are at the center of it. The AI Agent Platform is the foundation on which our next generation of autonomous and assistive experiences are built. AI Studio is the product surface that brings that platform to life: the place where builders design, test, deploy, observe, and continuously optimize AI agents that ship inside our CX and EX products. 
We are looking for a visionary engineering leader to own AI Studio end to end. As the Senior Director of Engineering for AI Studio, you will lead a dynamic, multi-disciplinary organization that builds the front-end experience and the Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layer for the AI Agent Platform, and embeds these capabilities natively within our CX and EX product lines. This is a pivotal, high-visibility role with the opportunity to shape how thousands of businesses build and operate AI agents - setting the bar for craftsmanship, developer experience, reliability, and scale.   Key Responsibilities    Lead a dynamic, multi-disciplinary organization of engineers and engineering managers spanning front-end, BFF/services, and platform integration.  Own the vision and technical execution for AI Studio - the end-to-end experience to build, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents on the AI Agent Platform.  Deliver a best-in-class front end and a robust Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layer that expose the AI Agent Platform’s capabilities to builders with speed, trust, and clarity.  Embed AI Studio natively within both CX and EX product lines, ensuring a seamless, consistent builder and end-user experience across surfaces.  Establish the agent lifecycle as a first-class product: authoring and configuration, testing and evaluation, safe deployment, live observability, and data-driven optimization.  Partner deeply with the AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, and Data Science teams to surface state-of-the-art models, tools, and orchestration capabilities through intuitive workflows.  Define and track impact: agent build velocity, time-to-deploy, adoption, agent quality and containment/deflection, reliability, and measurable ROI for CX and EX customers.  Establish governance and trust: access controls, guardrails, data classification, privacy/PII handling, auditability, and compliance-ready practices for agent workflows.    What You’ll Do     Set the AI Studio vision:  Define the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for a unified studio experience that lets builders create, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents across CX and EX.   Own the full builder journey:  Ship the front-end and BFF that make agent authoring, configuration, and iteration fast, intuitive, and reliable - from first prototype to production at scale. Lead & inspire:  Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive culture across a multi-tiered organization of engineers and managers. Mentor the next generation of technical leaders and build a team known for technical excellence and execution velocity.   Execute with excellence:  Master the full development lifecycle, from strategic planning and roadmap management to deployment and operations. Champion agile, iterative delivery to ship exceptional products under ambitious deadlines and evolving priorities.   Drive technical & architectural strategy:  Act as the technical authority for AI Studio. Guide teams in building large-scale, distributed cloud systems, performant front-end architectures, and resilient BFF/API layers, adopting best practices and emerging AI technologies.   Collaborate to win:  Build powerful partnerships with AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, Product, Design, and GTM leaders so the AI Studio roadmap is aligned with platform capabilities, business needs, and customer expectations. Strong technical foundation in building and operating large-scale, distributed systems on public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including modern front-end architectures and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF)/API design.  Hands-on understanding of the AI/agent landscape: LLMs, agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation and observability for AI systems, and the practical realities of shipping AI features into production.  Track record of delivering builder- or developer-facing products (studios, low-code/no-code tooling, or platform consoles) with excellent UX and reliability at scale. title: Channel Partner Manager -  DACH (m/f/d)
description:
This is a pivotal individual contributor role at the heart of Freshworks channel growth strategy. As a Channel Manager, you will own the full lifecycle of our mid-market reseller business across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland — from prospecting and signing new value-added resellers through to driving active pipeline, resale revenue, and installed base expansion through those relationships.  The opportunity is significant. Freshworks is building a volume resale motion to displace incumbent ITSM platforms through partners who already sell into the mid-market. DACH is a channel-led market where the majority of mid-market IT spend transacts through resellers, and this role sits at the centre of that effort. You will work closely with field sales, pre-sales, and marketing, as well as directly with VAR sales leaders and owners, to build a reseller base that generates repeatable, run-rate revenue.  The right person combines a hunter's instinct for signing the right resellers with the commercial discipline to hold those partners accountable to joint business plans and pipeline commitments. You know how VARs make money, how they compensate their sellers, and how to get from first conversation to first transacted deal quickly.   Responsibilities:    VAR Recruitment & Onboarding     Identify, target, and sign mid-market VARs aligned to Freshworks' DACH ITSM, ITAM, and CX growth priorities    Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective resellers, drawing on market mapping, distribution networks, competitor partner rosters, and ex-incumbent relationships    Lead the end-to-end recruitment process — from initial outreach and business case development through to contract execution and onboarding    Design and execute structured onboarding that brings new VARs to first-deal-ready status inside 90 days: product knowledge, resale terms and margin structure, deal registration, quoting, pre-sales support model     Partner Enablement & Acceleration     Build VAR capability across sales and pre-sales so partners can position, scope, quote, and close Freshworks solutions without vendor dependency    Develop joint go-to-market plans with each partner, including target verticals, solution plays, and co-sell motions with Freshworks field teams    Drive participation in Freshworks enablement programmes, including accreditation, demo certification, and deal support resources    Act as the primary relationship owner into VAR sales leadership and seller communities, building multi-threaded engagement across sales, marketing, and ownership    Deploy MDF and campaign investment against agreed pipeline outcomes, not activity     Pipeline & Revenue     Own and actively manage a partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, working with field AEs to progress and close VAR-originated opportunities    Set and hold partners to joint pipeline targets, resale revenue commitments, and expansion targets in the installed base through structured QBR and business planning rhythms    Drive deal progression through CRM monitoring — not reactive deal registration    Co-sell alongside partners on key opportunities, providing commercial, technical, and executive support as required    Track and report on VAR pipeline health, conversion velocity, and revenue contribution through Salesforce, ensuring accurate and up-to-date forecasting     Strategy & Ecosystem Development     Contribute to the DACH VAR strategy, including partner selection criteria, tiering, margin design, and investment allocation    Identify resellers with existing ServiceNow, ManageEngine, or legacy ITSM books as priority displacement targets and develop engagement plans accordingly    Work cross-functionally with marketing, product, and pre-sales to develop reseller-specific content, campaign assets, and quoting tools    Feed market and competitive intelligence back into channel leadership, including partner sentiment, competitor margin structures, and whitespace opportunity   

  Required     7+ years' experience in channel, alliances, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software environment     Fluent German and English, written and spoken     Demonstrable track record of recruiting and activating resale partners in the DACH market, not just managing existing relationships    Strong understanding of VAR economics: margin expectations, seller compensation, distribution relationships, and how resellers decide where to invest sales capacity    Experience working in or adjacent to ITSM, ITAM, EX, or CX categories — familiarity with the ServiceNow or ManageEngine reseller ecosystems is a strong advantage    Commercially rigorous: comfortable building joint business plans, setting pipeline targets, and holding partners accountable to commitments    Ability to build and maintain senior relationships within reseller organisations — sales directors, managing directors, and owners    Strong pipeline management discipline — fluent in Salesforce or equivalent CRM for partner opportunity tracking and forecasting    Effective at working cross-functionally: comfortable aligning field sales, pre-sales, and marketing behind partner-led motions     Preferred     Prior experience at a vendor in a channel role targeting ServiceNow or legacy ITSM displacement through resale    Existing DACH reseller network across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland    Experience building a resale motion from early stage, including margin and incentive design    Familiarity with distribution and marketplace dynamics as a complement to direct VAR management    Background in solution or pre-sales that gives you credibility in technical conversations with partner sellers     Personal Attributes     Hunter mentality: energised by finding and opening new relationships, not just managing the existing book    High commercial IQ — able to quickly assess partner fit, investment appetite, and revenue potential    Direct and confident communicator — able to influence without authority across both internal and partner organisations    Disciplined operator: tracks commitments, follows through, and manages a structured pipeline without prompting    Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage programme building — this role will shape the mid-market resale motion, not inherit a mature one

title: Vice President - Corporate Communications
description:
We're looking for a Sr/Vice President of Corporate Communications to own and evolve Freshworks' narrative in the market globally, across every channel, and at every altitude. This is a rare seat: one where you're expected to think in long-term story arcs and get in the weeds on a Reddit thread or a niche IT newsletter. You'll partner directly with the C-suite, run a high-performing global team, and set the omnichannel communications strategy that fuels our growth among agile enterprises and IT leaders worldwide.  This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. We want someone who takes big swings to land the Wall Street Journal and knows which Subreddits your buyers actually trust.    What You'll Own:     Communications Strategy & Narrative    Define and scale the Freshworks corporate narrative across earned media, executive communications, social channels, influencer programming, content, and emerging LLM/AI search surfaces  Build a clear, differentiated market position that drives Freshworks' perception as the leader in midmarket IT service management and a force multiplier of AI-powered service  Translate complex product and business stories into sharp, accessible narratives that resonate with IT decision-makers, CX leaders, and enterprise buyers  Own the company news calendar and global PR drumbeat that balances quarterly rhythms with the agility to capitalize on breaking news and cultural moments    Omnichannel Execution    Lead a modern press office program that earns coverage in Tier 1 business and trade outlets while also driving engagement in niche communities including industry newsletters, podcasts, and LinkedIn groups  Build and execute an influencer title: Lead - Solution Engineer
description:
Freshservice is expanding what “AI-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.  This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post-sale. You'll be the AI subject-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.  You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.   What You'll Do    Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch. title: GTM Engineer, Revenue Operations
description:
At Freshworks, we're introducing AI across our GTM organization to accelerate how we understand buyers and act on revenue signals.   As a key member of the Web & Revenue Marketing team, you will build the agents, automations, and intelligence systems that help our frontline teams operate more effectively.   We're looking for a GTM operator who is also a hands-on builder—someone who deeply understands how revenue teams work and can turn those problems into AI-powered workflows and systems.   Our buyer signals currently live across Salesforce, Marketo, Outreach, product usage data, intent platforms, and other systems. You'll connect those signals, add context and intelligence, and build workflows that help revenue teams determine who to engage, why, when, and what action to take.   You may come from Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, Revenue Technology, Marketing Operations, or a similar technical GTM function. You don't need to be a traditional software engineer, but you do need to be someone who has personally built solutions, not just managed the tools or processes around them.   You'll have executive sponsorship, high-impact problems to solve, and a blank canvas to help shape how AI is applied across the Freshworks GTM organization.  
 
 What You'll Do:      Build AI-powered GTM Workflows:  Design and deploy agents and automations across lead management, account research, routing, scoring, prioritization, personalization, seller briefings, and follow-up    Turn Buyer Signals into Action:  Connect and enrich signals across web activity, intent, product usage, CRM history, engagement data, and third-party sources to identify high-value accounts and recommend actions   Automate the GTM Stack:  Build integrations and workflows across systems like Salesforce, Clay, Marketo, sales engagement platforms, enrichment provides, internal data sources, and AI tools   Build Agents and Internal Tools:  Use LLMs, APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, and scripting to create tools that make sellers and revenue teams faster and more effective    Solve Frontline GTM Problems:  Partner directly with Sales, SDR/BDR, Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, RevOps, and Demand Gen teams to understand workflow friction and translate business needs into working solutions    Prototype and Iterate Quickly:  Build solutions, get them into users' hands, measure their effectiveness, and iterate based on real-world feedback    Make AI Workflows Reliable:  Implement validation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, monitoring, error handling, and other mechanisms needed to move successful prototypes into production  

  What We're Looking For     Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations, GTM Systems, Revenue Technology, Marketing Operations, or a similar GTM function   Strong understanding of B2B revenue workflows including lead management, routing, enrichment, qualification, account prioritization, prospecting, and pipeline generation  A hands-on builder who has personally created automations, integrations, internal tools, or data workflows—not just managed the systems or processes around them   Experience working with GTM platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, or similar  Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered workflows or agents using Claude, OpenAI, Relevance, MCP, n8n, Workato, or similar tools   Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, data integrations, automation platforms, or scripting to connect systems and bring ideas to life   Ability to partner directly with Sales, Marketing, SDR/BDR, and RevOps teams and translate business problems into working technical solutions    Nice to Have    Experience with SQL, Python, JavaScript, or data warehouses  Experience building account intelligence, enrichment, scoring, routing, or signal-based GTM workflows  Experience taking AI or automation workflow from prototype through production and adoption   

  Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.    The annual base salary range for this position is  $202,000 - $250,000.  This role is also eligible for a target bonus.   Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level.   Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability, and life insurance. Equity + ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits, and wellness benefits are also offered. title: Lead - Solution Engineer
description:
We are looking for a passionate and technically skilled  Solution Engineer  to be part of our SMBC Sales Support team for Freshservice. You will be instrumental in solving complex customer problems, designing tailored solutions — including AI-driven use cases built on Freddy AI and Agent Studio — and delivering impactful demonstrations of the Freshworks platform. This role suits individuals with strong pre-sales experience who thrive on customer interaction, solutioning, and collaborating with internal teams to drive business outcomes, and who are genuinely curious about applying AI to real customer problems rather than just talking about it.   Pre-Sales Engagement & Customer Solutions:    Engage with SMB, mid-market customers to understand their business and technical challenges.  Conduct discovery sessions, architect solutions, and deliver tailored product demonstrations and Proofs of Concept (POCs).  Address technical objections and ensure alignment with customer needs.    AI Solutioning & Positioning:    Understand and clearly explain core AI/LLM concepts (prompting, agents, model context/tooling) to both technical and business audiences without over-selling or over-simplifying.  Position Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, and Agent Studio within customer discovery, tying AI capabilities to concrete outcomes (ticket deflection, resolution time, agent productivity) rather than generic AI messaging.  Build and configure simple AI agents and automated workflows in Agent Studio (or comparable agent-builder tools) to bring AI use cases to life in demos and POCs.  Field technical AI questions on integration, data handling, and governance, looping in specialists for deeper architecture discussions when needed.    Solution Design & Documentation:    Participate in gathering requirements and scoping complex engagements.  Create technical documentation including solution proposals, SoWs, and RFP/RFI responses.  Evaluate opportunities from a technical feasibility standpoint and proactively mitigate risks.    Collaboration & Execution:    Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams.  Align technical strategies with sales initiatives to accelerate deal closures.  Continuously improve pre-sales tools, processes, and enablement assets.    Customer Advocacy & Product Evangelism:    Articulate the value and capabilities of the Freshworks platform to both technical and business audiences.  Represent Freshworks at customer meetings, events, and forums as a trusted technical advisor.  Keep abreast of product developments and industry trends to provide relevant, up-to-date guidance.  

   5–8 years  of experience in pre-sales/solution engineering, technical consulting, or a similar customer-facing technical role.  Strong background in SaaS, cloud technologies, APIs, and enterprise software environments.  Proven experience designing and delivering technical demonstrations and POCs.  Ability to work with mid-market and enterprise customers, understand their pain points, and craft effective solutions.  Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).  Familiarity with ITSM products and market is a must.  Solid conceptual understanding of AI/LLM technology — prompting, RAG, agentic workflows, and how AI features are typically integrated into SaaS products; hands-on experience configuring or building AI agents/copilots (e.g., Agent Studio, similar low-code agent builders, or LLM APIs) is strongly preferred.  Ability to credibly position and sell AI value to both business and technical stakeholders, including addressing common AI concerns (accuracy, data privacy, change management).  This is a Night Shift role only, prior North America Market experience is a must    Key Skills:    Pre-sales consulting & technical storytelling  Solution architecture & demo delivery  API, integrations, SaaS product understanding  Discovery, qualification & objection handling  RFP/RFI response and technical documentation  Stakeholder collaboration (Sales/Product/Engineering)  Strong communication & relationship-building  AI/LLM concepts (prompting, RAG, agentic workflows) & positioning  Hands-on AI agent/copilot building (Agent Studio or equivalent)

title: Deal Desk Strategy Manager
description:
Freshworks is looking for an experienced Deal Desk Strategy Manager to play a critical role in shaping and accelerating some of our largest and most strategic deals. Reporting to the Senior Director of Deal Desk, this senior individual contributor will partner directly with Account Executives and regional sales leaders to develop deal strategy early, navigate complex commercial decisions, and drive transactions from initial opportunity through close. This is more than a traditional Deal Desk role — you’ll operate as a trusted advisor to Sales, bring together the right partners across Legal, Finance, and Operations, and help remove the friction that can stand between a great opportunity and a closed deal. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence how Deal Desk operates at scale, mentor others on the team, and build toward future people leadership as the organization continues to grow.     Run point on Deal Desk activities for the largest and most strategic transactions in your region, embedded directly with assigned AEs and RVPs    Proactively initiate deal strategy conversations with sellers before paperwork or approvals are required — not after    Document the sequence of events required to close each assigned deal, and drive the cadence needed to hit it    Establish a regular meeting cadence with account teams to drive deal velocity from inception to closure    Own deal strategy and structuring end-to-end, including all order form updates and documentation    Exercise judgment to triage deal complexity — resolving strategic, high-stakes deals personally while routing standardized work to our shared services Deal Desk team; this prioritization skill is a core part of growing into people leadership    Identify and secure all necessary internal approvals; own correspondence with Legal on contract terms and redlines, and partner with Finance, Sales Ops, and other cross-functional teams as needed on pricing, revenue recognition, and deal terms    Join customer calls as needed, speaking directly to deal structure and terms to accelerate turnaround time and remove friction to close    Serve as an escalation point for complex or stalled deals across the region, stepping in to unblock and drive resolution    Provide ongoing, proactive deal enablement for your regional account teams (not just reactive deal support)    Act as a go-to resource and informal mentor for newer Deal Desk team members, sharing deal strategy best practices and coaching on deal structuring    Identify recurring friction points across deals and recommend process, template, or workflow improvements to Deal Desk leadership    Support quarter-end and month-end close crunch periods, including flexibility for after-hours support during peak close windows    Contribute directly to team targets across deal cycle time, approval turnaround, accuracy, escalation rate, and Sales satisfaction   

   7–10+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar deal-support function, including direct experience with enterprise or strategic-tier deals    Demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted advisor to AEs and RVPs — shaping deal strategy proactively, not just processing paperwork    Strong working knowledge of contract structuring, order forms, pricing and discounting frameworks, and standard commercial terms    Comfort partnering directly with Legal, Finance, and Sales Ops to resolve complex contract, pricing, or revenue recognition questions    Sound independent judgment for triaging deal complexity and knowing when to escalate, delegate, or resolve personally    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience speaking directly to customers on deal structure and terms    A track record of informally mentoring or supporting peers, and genuine interest in growing into a people leadership role    Ability to manage a high volume of concurrent deals under tight deadlines, particularly during month-end and quarter-end close    An analytical, process-oriented mindset — comfortable spotting patterns across deals and proposing scalable fixes    Flexibility to provide after-hours support during peak close windows as needed

title: Senior Value Engineer
description:
About the Team    Our Value Engineering team is growing, and we're looking for a Senior Value Engineer to join our team in London. This is a role for someone who loves building rigorous business cases, can hold their own in a room with CFOs and CIOs, and gets genuine satisfaction from turning a complex technical story into a number a customer can act on.    As a Senior Value Engineer, you'll partner directly with our sales account teams to build and defend value-based business cases across moderate to large sized deals, primarily around our ITSM, ITAM, ITOM and Freddy AI product lines. You'll act as a trusted advisor to both prospects and internal stakeholders — translating technical capability into financial outcomes that make it obvious why Freshworks is the right investment.    What You'll Do    Lead value discovery sessions with prospects and customers, digging into their objectives and pain points to build a defensible, quantified picture of business value    Build detailed financial models — cost-benefit analyses, ROI calculations, competitive differentiation models — that hold up to scrutiny from finance and technical stakeholders alike    Craft and deliver compelling value presentations for audiences ranging from technical buyers to C-suite executives    Continuously sharpen our value engineering methodology, discovery frameworks, and tools to keep pace with an evolving ITSM / ITAM / ITOM / AI landscape    Partner closely with sales, product management, marketing, and customer success to shape value propositions tailored to different customer segments and industries   

   5+ years in value engineering, management consulting, financial analysis, equity research, or a related discipline within SaaS or technology     Strong discovery instincts — you know how to ask the right questions, synthesize scattered data, and get to the real business driver fast    Confidence designing original value propositions and modelling multiple scenarios against a customer's specific goals    Experience with ROI/TCO modelling, value discovery frameworks, or competitive value frameworks    Exceptional communication skills — you can make a complex model make sense to a sceptical CFO in five minutes, and hold your ground when they push back on your assumptions    A natural collaborator who builds trust easily across sales, product, and customer-facing teams    A track record of running projects with rigor: clean deliverables, tight deadlines, and the ability to take feedback and iterate quickly

title: Senior Analyst - Cybersecurity
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE   Freshworks is looking for a Senior Analyst- Cybersecurity to join our GTM (Go-To-Market) Cybersecurity team. You'll sit at the intersection of Cybersecurity, customer trust, and go-to-market — acting as a subject matter expert who gives prospective and existing customers confidence and assurance in Freshworks' security posture.  Reporting to the Manager, Cybersecurity, you'll be a hands-on technical security advisor: fielding customer questions, responding to RFPs and security questionnaires, and partnering with Security Engineering and Product Engineering to translate technical security detail into clear, customer-ready answers. This is an execution-focused role within a growing team — you'll work inside the playbooks, templates, and systems the team builds, sharpening them through direct customer contact.   WHAT YOU'LL DO     Be a trusted technical security advisor.  Serve as a subject matter expert on cloud security, AWS architecture, and product security posture for prospective and existing customers.   Own the customer security dialogue.  Respond to cybersecurity questionnaires, RFIs/RFPs, and other due diligence documents, and join customer calls jointly with Sales, Pre-Sales, Channel Sales, Customer Success, and Deals Desk teams.   Be the single point of contact for cloud security asks.  Work closely with Security Engineering and Product Engineering as the primary liaison for cloud security and AWS architecture-related customer questions.   Create reusable security collateral.  Partner with Security Engineering and Product Engineering to build customer-shareable technical security content based on recurring customer asks.   Review contracts with a security lens.  Perform contract reviews (MSA, DPA, BAA, and related agreements) for cybersecurity obligations relevant to the role.   Coach and upskill the team.  Support existing team members in strengthening their technical security knowledge.   Work across time zones.  Align to different regions/shifts as needed, given the breadth of time zones Freshworks' customers span.  

  4–7 years of experience in Cybersecurity, with depth in Application Security Architecture, Security Pre-Sales, or Solutioning.  Experience with cloud services/technology (AWS) as it relates to cybersecurity.  Good understanding of web frameworks and architecture.  Any experience in Pre-Sales or Solution Engineering within a SaaS setup is a plus.  Strong verbal and written communication skills — able to communicate concisely and unambiguously with both technical and non-technical audiences.  Comfort working in a dynamic, fast-growing environment, with the discipline to respond to customers contextually and on time.  Self-sufficient and able to work with minimal direct supervision.  Flexibility to work different shifts/regions — this is a mandatory requirement of the role.    Technical Skills    Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals on AWS (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub).  Familiarity with web application security fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC basics, API security, and encryption standards (TLS, AES-256, key management).  General understanding of SaaS security models, multi-tenant architecture, and shared responsibility frameworks.  Exposure to security questionnaire and trust center platforms (e.g., Loopio, Responsive, SafeBase) and GRC tools (e.g., Drata, Vanta) is a plus.  Ability to read and interpret security documentation, SOC 2 audit reports, and architecture diagrams.  Good with automation — comfortable using scripting, workflow builders, or no-code/low-code tools to speed up repetitive tasks.  Working understanding of AI/GenAI concepts and how they intersect with data security and privacy, to speak confidently to customer questions in this area.    Certifications (Nice to have)    CompTIA Security+ or equivalent foundational certification  AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect – Associate  ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)  Certified Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK)    Soft Skills    Clear communication: able to distill security topics for technical and non-technical audiences alike.  Cross-functional collaboration: comfortable working with Security Engineering, Legal, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.  Customer empathy: understands that behind every questionnaire is a customer trying to make a trust decision.  Reliability under pressure: able to triage competing customer requests across time zones and deliver consistently.  Coachability and a growth mindset, with willingness to mentor others as experience grows.    NICE TO HAVE    Prior experience in Pre-Sales or Solution Engineering at a SaaS company.  Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or HIPAA.  Exposure to trust center platforms (e.g., SafeBase) or security questionnaire tools (e.g., Loopio, Responsive).    WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS   Enterprise customers don't just buy products — they buy trust. At Freshworks, the Cybersecurity GTM function is the front line of that trust, and this role puts you directly in front of the customers who depend on it. Every questionnaire you close, every call you join, and every piece of collateral you help build moves deals forward and strengthens the confidence customers place in Freshworks. If you want hands-on ownership of real customer security conversations at a fast-growing company, this is the role.

title: Staff Program Manager - Voice of the Customer Programs
description:

In this role, you will serve as the strategic owner of our VoC infrastructure, turning quantitative metrics and qualitative customer insights into actionable business and product strategies. You will directly manage customer-facing survey initiatives, act as a primary platform administrator and power user for Qualtrics, monitor our product feedback channels, and support our qualitative research efforts including customer focus groups. Design, launch, and manage customer-facing survey programs across the lifecycle, including NPS, CSAT, CES, onboarding, and post-interaction surveys. Establish data collection best practices to reduce survey fatigue and ensure high response rates and representative sampling. Connect OvC data to ChurnZero Health Scores. Aggregate insights from direct surveys and customer-facing teams to translate customer feedback into prioritized product backlog items and feature enhancements. Design a close-loop process to communicate how feedback drives change both internally (with cross-functional teams) and externally (with customers). Synthesize qualitative findings alongside quantitative data to create unified story-driven reports for leadership.   Playbooks & Enablement  — Educate customer-facing teams on our survey initiatives and feedback processes. Design playbooks for pre- and post-survey outreach that align with best practices on responding to customer feedback in a supportive manner.    Program Strategy & Analytics  — Build executive dashboards and quarterly reporting to track core CX metrics, customer sentiment trends, and the ROI of VoC initiatives. Establish automated workflows to flag and address detractor issues in real time.   Program Goals    Deliver quarterly executive Root-Cause Analysis for key CX surveys  10+ NPS improvement in year one  90% adherence to Detractor Close-Loop Response target of 48 hours  25% of Product Roadmap VoC-driven  Consolidate all CX surveys into Qualtrics

title: Deal Desk Strategy Manager
description:
Freshworks is looking for an experienced Deal Desk Strategy Manager to play a critical role in shaping and accelerating some of our largest and most strategic deals. Reporting to the Senior Director of Deal Desk, this senior individual contributor will partner directly with Account Executives and regional sales leaders to develop deal strategy early, navigate complex commercial decisions, and drive transactions from initial opportunity through close.  This is more than a traditional Deal Desk role — you’ll operate as a trusted advisor to Sales, bring together the right partners across Legal, Finance, and Operations, and help remove the friction that can stand between a great opportunity and a closed deal. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence how Deal Desk operates at scale, mentor others on the team, and build toward future people leadership as the organization continues to grow.   Run point on Deal Desk activities for the largest and most strategic transactions in your region, embedded directly with assigned AEs and RVPs  Proactively initiate deal strategy conversations with sellers before paperwork or approvals are required — not after  Document the sequence of events required to close each assigned deal, and drive the cadence needed to hit it  Establish a regular meeting cadence with account teams to drive deal velocity from inception to closure  Own deal strategy and structuring end-to-end, including all order form updates and documentation  Exercise judgment to triage deal complexity — resolving strategic, high-stakes deals personally while routing standardized work to our shared services Deal Desk team; this prioritization skill is a core part of growing into people leadership  Identify and secure all necessary internal approvals; own correspondence with Legal on contract terms and redlines, and partner with Finance, Sales Ops, and other cross-functional teams as needed on pricing, revenue recognition, and deal terms  Join customer calls as needed, speaking directly to deal structure and terms to accelerate turnaround time and remove friction to close  Serve as an escalation point for complex or stalled deals across the region, stepping in to unblock and drive resolution  Provide ongoing, proactive deal enablement for your regional account teams (not just reactive deal support)  Act as a go-to resource and informal mentor for newer Deal Desk team members, sharing deal strategy best practices and coaching on deal structuring  Identify recurring friction points across deals and recommend process, template, or workflow improvements to Deal Desk leadership  Support quarter-end and month-end close crunch periods, including flexibility for after-hours support during peak close windows  Contribute directly to team targets across deal cycle time, approval turnaround, accuracy, escalation rate, and Sales satisfaction  

  7–10+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar deal-support function, including direct experience with enterprise or strategic-tier deals  Demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted advisor to AEs and RVPs — shaping deal strategy proactively, not just processing paperwork  Strong working knowledge of contract structuring, order forms, pricing and discounting frameworks, and standard commercial terms  Comfort partnering directly with Legal, Finance, and Sales Ops to resolve complex contract, pricing, or revenue recognition questions  Sound independent judgment for triaging deal complexity and knowing when to escalate, delegate, or resolve personally  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience speaking directly to customers on deal structure and terms  A track record of informally mentoring or supporting peers, and genuine interest in growing into a people leadership role  Ability to manage a high volume of concurrent deals under tight deadlines, particularly during month-end and quarter-end close  An analytical, process-oriented mindset — comfortable spotting patterns across deals and proposing scalable fixes  Flexibility to provide after-hours support during peak close windows as needed

title: Senior Corporate PR Manager
description:
We're looking for a Sr. Manager of Executive Communications to be the primary architect and manager of our CEO, CTO, CIO, and CMO’s external voice. You will own the editorial strategy, calendar and output that turns Freshworks' narrative into category-shaping thought leadership — across executive social media handles, keynotes, podcasts, media.  This role  sits in the Corporate Communications function and is critical in driving clarity on the business strategy and in amplifying definitive points of view on the future of AI-powered service operations. You will work across the marketing organization and directly with the Freshworks management team to amplify POVs from these leaders and evolve the marketing operations and infrastructure to do it at scale.    What You Will Own :    1. Category Leadership    You are the strategic owner of our executive POVs — ensuring our C-suite defines the market narrative around AI-powered service operations and the mid-market EX category.  Build and maintain the Executive Communications Narrative Stack — the definitive source code for executive POV across keynotes, bylines, analyst briefings, media, and sales surfaces.  Develop and execute the executive thought leadership program positioning the CEO and leadership bench as the primary category voices for the future of Employee and Customer Experience.  Help drive the PR engine for EX category creation: earned media placements, opinion bylines, and the executive podcast circuit — at volume and with velocity.  Coordinate with Analyst Relations to leverage Freshworks positioning through each analyst cycle.  Establish Freshworks as the credible, practical alternative to legacy platforms by grounding all executive content in mid-market simplicity, AI productivity, and time-to-value.    2. Executive Narrative Stack & Messaging    Own the narrative architecture that connects platform capabilities to market-facing executive communication — translating AI-powered service operations into simple, credible business value.  Deliver updated messaging source code for use across sales enablement, event keynotes, analyst relations, and media — ensuring every GTM surface reflects a unified executive point of view.   Align executive storytelling with vertical GTM programs across priority industries (technology, financial services, healthcare, professional services) as Freshworks scales its upmarket motion.  Partner with Product Marketing to integrate platform launches, competitive differentiation, and customer proof points into executive narratives that drive market confidence.    3. Social & Influencer Amplification Engine    One strong POV becomes dozens of targeted assets. You will evolve and operate the flywheel that turns executive perspective into measurable reach.  Manage the executive social amplification engine across LinkedIn and YouTube, targeting growth in AEO traffic and share-of-voice in the service software space   Convert thought leadership content into platform-specific assets modulated for audience segment and buyer stage — from C-suite prospects to mid-market practitioners.  Build and maintain relationships with influencers, community leaders, and industry voices to extend Freshworks' executive reach organically.  Actively monitor the enterprise tech zeitgeist — surfacing moments where our executives can enter conversations with insight, not noise.  Support the AI influencer and social amplification programs that are central to the marketing growth engine, including creator partnerships and content series on LinkedIn and YouTube.    4. Integrated Corporate Narrative    Support the Sr. Director, Corporate Communications to ensure executive comms supports and amplifies the company's premium brand investments, partner programs, and flagship events.  Partner with Brand, Product Marketing, Enterprise Field Marketing, Digital Marketing, Investor Relations, and Employee Engagement to ensure executive messaging is precisely aligned with the broader narrative at each phase of the Marketing roadmap.  Support corporate milestone communications — funding announcements, product launches, analyst report placements, and strategic partnerships — with executive-ready narratives.       5. AI-Powered Execution at Marketing Velocity    Our Marketing organization operates on an MVP model: ship fast, test resonance, iterate, and scale what works. You will bring this discipline to executive communications.  Build AI-assisted content workflows that multiply executive output — from first-draft generation and message testing to social scheduling and performance tracking — without sacrificing strategic quality.  Operate with product-style development cycles: launch content quickly, measure resonance with press, analysts, and customers, and iterate based on signal rather than assumption.  Implement an editorial calendar infrastructure that integrates with campaign rhythms, product releases, analyst cycles, and event schedules across the full marketing calendar.  Instrument and report on executive communications impact: earned media coverage, analyst sentiment, executive social growth, and contribution to brand awareness and pipeline.  

  Experience & Domain    Minimum 8 years in executive communications, PR, or corporate communications, with the majority of that time in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.  Deep fluency in the IT service management, Employee Experience, or HR tech landscape — you understand the buyer, the influencer ecosystem, and the analyst community.  Demonstrated track record of building and executing C-suite thought leadership programs that generated measurable brand impact.  Experience driving executive narrative through category-creation or company-repositioning moments, not just sustaining existing brand presence.    Strategic & Creative Capability    Exceptional writing and editing — you can translate complex AI and platform concepts into precise, resonant executive language that works across media, analyst, and social contexts.  Strong narrative architecture skills: you build messaging frameworks, not just individual pieces of content.  Proven ability to develop and execute against an editorial calendar under pressure, with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.  Experience partnering with analyst relations teams to develop and deliver executive briefing narratives.    AI Proficiency & Operating Model Fit    AI-native operator: you actively use AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, testing, and workflow automation — and you are always looking for new leverage points.  Comfortable with data: you track what resonates, report on performance, and adapt content strategy based on signal.  Thrives in an MVP model: you ship, learn, and iterate rather than waiting for perfection.  High EQ and executive presence: you build trusted relationships with C-level leaders and navigate their preferences with confidence and discretion.

title: Channel Sales Manager - UK
description:
About this role:   This is a pivotal individual contributor role at the heart of Freshworks’ UK channel growth strategy. As a Channel Sales Manager, you will own the full lifecycle of our Systems Integrator business in the UK — from prospecting and signing new mid-tier SI partners through to driving active pipeline and revenue through those relationships.  The UK SI opportunity is significant. Freshworks is building a strategic motion to displace incumbent ITSM and CX platforms through SI-led delivery, and this role sits at the centre of that effort. You will work closely with field sales, pre-sales, and marketing, as well as directly with SI practice leads, to build a partner ecosystem that generates meaningful, repeatable revenue.  The right person for this role combines a hunter’s instinct for identifying and signing the right partners with the commercial discipline to hold those partners accountable to joint business plans and pipeline commitments. You know how SIs operate, how they build practices, and how to get from first conversation to active GTM motion.   Responsibilities:    SI Recruitment & Onboarding    Identify, target, and sign mid-tier SI partners (e.g., Capgemini, CGI, Unisys) aligned to Freshworks’ UK ITSM and CX growth priorities  Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective SI partners, drawing on market mapping, ex-ServiceNow and ex-incumbent networks, and competitive intelligence  Lead the end-to-end partner recruitment process — from initial outreach and business case development through to contract execution and onboarding  Design and execute structured onboarding programmes that bring new SIs to first-deal-ready status quickly: product knowledge, commercial terms, deal registration, pre-sales support model    Partner Enablement & Acceleration    Build and maintain SI partner capability across sales, pre-sales, and delivery —ensuring partners can self-sufficiently position, scope, and close Freshworks-based solutions  Develop joint go-to-market plans with each SI partner, including target verticals, solution plays, and co-sell motions with Freshworks field teams  Drive participation in Freshworks enablement programmes, including accreditation, demo certification, and deal support resources  Act as the primary relationship owner into SI practice leads and partner alliances teams, building multi-threaded engagement across sales, delivery, and leadership    Pipeline & Revenue    Own and actively manage a partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, working with CAMs and field AEs to progress and close SI-originated opportunities  Set and hold partners to joint pipeline targets and revenue commitments through structured QBR and business planning rhythms  Co-sell alongside SI partners on key opportunities, providing commercial, technical, and executive support as required  Track and report on SI pipeline health, deal velocity, and revenue contribution through Salesforce, ensuring accurate and up-to-date forecasting    Strategy & Ecosystem Development    Contribute to the UK SI partner strategy, including partner selection criteria, tiering, and investment allocation  Identify SI partners with existing ServiceNow or legacy ITSM practices as priority displacement targets and develop engagement plans accordingly  Work cross-functionally with marketing, product, and pre-sales to develop SI-specific content, solution briefs, and campaign assets  Feed market and competitive intelligence back into channel leadership, including partner sentiment, competitor partner programmes, and whitespace opportunity  

  Required    7+ years’ experience in channel, alliances, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software environment  Demonstrable track record of recruiting and activating SI partners, not just managing existing relationships  Strong understanding of how mid-tier SIs operate: practice structures, P&L dynamics, delivery models, and how they make partner investment decisions  Experience working in or adjacent to ITSM, EX, or CX categories — familiarity with the ServiceNow ecosystem is a strong advantage  Commercially rigorous: comfortable building joint business plans, setting pipeline targets, and holding partners accountable to commitments  Ability to build and maintain senior relationships within SI organisations — practice leads, alliance directors, and C-level stakeholders  Strong pipeline management discipline — fluent in Salesforce or equivalent CRM for partner opportunity tracking and forecasting  Effective at working cross-functionally: comfortable aligning field sales, pre-sales, and marketing behind partner-led motions    Preferred    Prior experience at a vendor in a channel or alliance role targeting ServiceNow displacement or competing against legacy ITSM platforms  Existing network within UK mid-tier SI community (Capgemini, CGI, Unisys, Computacenter, or equivalent)  Experience building net-new SI practices around a vendor platform from early stage  Familiarity with co-sell and marketplace dynamics as a complement to SI-led GTM  Background in solution or pre-sales that gives you credibility in technical and delivery conversations with SI partners  Fluent in Dutch &/or any Nordic language is an advantage.    Personal Attributes    Hunter mentality: energised by finding and opening new relationships, not just managing the existing book  High commercial IQ — able to quickly assess partner fit, investment appetite, and revenue potential  Direct and confident communicator — able to influence without authority across both internal and partner organisations  Disciplined operator: tracks commitments, follows through, and manages a structured pipeline without prompting  Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage programme building — this is a role that will shape the SI motion, not inherit a mature one

title: Solution Architect
description:
Solution Architect (SA) role is a critical internally and externally-facing role within Freshworks Professional Services (FPS) which acts the senior technical SME heavily involved in Sales, Delivery and Expansion phases of the customer lifecycle.  FPS SA is a trusted advisor internally and externally working with the highest level functional and technical resources within Freshworks and the customer organizations to translate business outcome requirements into scalable solutions.   Your role and responsibilities:     During the Sales cycle, FPS SA will work closely with the Freshworks Presales team to understand a prospects pain points and solutions discussed to address them, and then directly interacts with the prospects leadership and functional owners to devise the best implementation approach for the identified solutions in line with industry and FPS best practices.    During the Delivery phase, FPS SA will be the key resource who translates the high-level solution provided during the sales cycle into detailed design information to meet the customer’s objectives and also for the FPS technical resources to implement the final solution.    In the Expansion phase, FPS SA will work with the customer to adjust or expand their deployed capabilities by adjusting their implemented solutions to the customer’s updated needs and organizational changes.     Some of the specific SA deliverables and activities are:     Product Champion: Act as a product leader in the region, instilling confidence in prospects during the sales cycle, devising innovative solutions during implementation, assessing existing enterprise customer health for improvement suggestions, and providing valuable customer feedback to the product team.    Solution Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop custom Freshworks product solutions in line with business goals and industry standards. Create architecture diagrams for proposed designs and deliver presentations.    Technical Implementation: Configure, customize, and deploy Freshworks products, encompassing workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting.    AI and Automation Solutioning: Identify opportunities for prospects and customers to leverage AI, automation, and agentic capabilities to achieve measurable business outcomes. Advise customers on the data readiness, governance, security, accuracy, adoption, and operational ownership required to successfully deploy and manage AI-enabled solutions.    Process Optimization: Identify areas for enhancement, proposing efficient solutions to improve operational efficiency.    Training and Support: Provide training to customers’ support agents, administrators, and relevant teams, ensuring the proficient use of Freshworks products during deployments.    Issue Resolution: Liaise with the Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges and implementation issues related to Freshworks products.    Integrations Design: Create and integrate Freshworks products with other systems and third-party applications to streamline 3rd-party integrations and facilitate data flow.    Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical and architectural documentation, covering system configurations, integrations, and customizations.    Stay Informed: Stay updated on industry trends, Freshworks product updates, and best practices to continually enhance the capabilities of the customer support ecosystem.     What success in this role looks like:   Success in this role means opportunities are accurately scoped, proposed solutions are technically feasible and supportable, delivery teams receive clear and actionable designs, architecture decisions are made quickly, risks are surfaced early, and customers have confidence in you and that the solution will meet their intended business outcomes. 

   10+ years of professional experience in ITSM, ESM, ITOM, ITAM    Strong technical background with custom script development and presales experience    Ability to read complex situations with several competing constraints and identify solutions that benefit both the customers and Freshworks    Excellent listening and presentation skills    5+ years working directly with Functional and organizational leaders internally and externally    Proficient in handling ambiguity and objections    Skilled in negotiation and objection handling    Experience with guiding customers in organization change management (OCM) to improve technology adoption is highly desirable.     Experience navigating difficult technical decisions and communicating tradeoffs to executives, architects, administrators, and delivery teams. title: Director - GTM Systems Architecture
description:
Freshworks is looking for a strategic, systems-minded leader to architect the future of our global Go-to-Market operating model.  As Director, GTM Systems Architecture, you'll sit at the intersection of business strategy, process design, data, and technology. Your role is not simply to optimize our systems—but to define how our commercial organization should operate and design the technology architecture that enables it.  You'll partner closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Product, IT, and Engineering to translate business strategy into scalable operating models, connected workflows, and modern technology capabilities. Working across Salesforce and the broader GTM technology ecosystem, you'll ensure our platforms, data, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows evolve together to create a simpler, smarter, and more scalable commercial engine.  This role defines the architectural direction for our GTM ecosystem while partnering closely with CRM Operations, IT, GTM Tech Operations, and AI Operations to bring that vision to life. Success requires systems thinking, strong business acumen, technical depth, and the ability to influence across functions without direct ownership of implementation teams.      What You'll Do    Design the Future of our GTM Operating Model    Translate business strategy into scalable business capabilities, processes, and technology architecture.  Design future-state operating models that simplify how our commercial teams work while improving customer and employee experiences.  Identify opportunities to eliminate complexity, standardize processes, and improve productivity across the customer lifecycle.  Partner with executive stakeholders to shape how Freshworks evolves its GTM organization over time.    Define our GTM Technology Architecture    Own the long-term architectural vision and roadmap for the GTM technology ecosystem.  Design how Salesforce and adjacent platforms work together as a connected commercial platform.  Define scalable approaches for data, integrations, automation, and platform interoperability.  Evaluate new technologies and recommend investments that support business priorities and long-term scalability.    Build an AI-Ready Commercial Platform    Design technology capabilities that enable intelligent automation, AI-powered workflows, and future AI innovations across the GTM organization.  Partner with AI Operations to ensure AI initiatives are supported by scalable systems, trusted data, and connected workflows. Serve as a trusted advisor on commercial technology strategy and investment decisions.    Partner Across the Organization    Partner with CRM Operations to translate architectural vision into scalable platform configurations and ongoing platform governance.  Partner with IT to align enterprise standards, security, integrations, and implementation priorities.  Collaborate with Revenue Operations, Enablement, Analytics, and Business Systems teams to ensure technology decisions support business outcomes. Deep expertise with Salesforce and the broader GTM technology ecosystem, including how commercial platforms integrate to support end-to-end business processes. Strong understanding of modern GTM business processes across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner organizations.  Experience designing enterprise integrations, automation strategies, APIs, and data architectures. Exceptional systems thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and connect complex initiatives across multiple functions.  Strong executive communication skills with experience influencing senior business and technical leaders.       Preferred Qualifications    Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, or Technical Architect certification.
